#### OAuth2 {#v1-oauth2}

OAuth2 defines OAuth2 configuration parameters
with optional references to secrets with corresponding sensitive values

Appears in: [VLAgentRemoteWriteSpec (v1)](#v1-vlagentremotewritespec), [VLDistributedZoneRemoteWriteSpec (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneremotewritespec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| clientIDFile<a href="#v1-oauth2-clientidfile" id="v1-oauth2-clientidfile">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ClientIDFile defines path to pre-mounted OAuth2 client id |
| clientIDSecret<a href="#v1-oauth2-clientidsecret" id="v1-oauth2-clientidsecret">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ClientIDSecret defines secret or configmap containing the OAuth2 client id |
| clientSecret<a href="#v1-oauth2-clientsecret" id="v1-oauth2-clientsecret">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The secret containing the OAuth2 client secret |
| clientSecretFile<a href="#v1-oauth2-clientsecretfile" id="v1-oauth2-clientsecretfile">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ClientSecretFile defines path to pre-mounted OAuth2 client secret |
| endpointParams<a href="#v1-oauth2-endpointparams" id="v1-oauth2-endpointparams">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EndpointParams to append to the token URL |
| scopes<a href="#v1-oauth2-scopes" id="v1-oauth2-scopes">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Scopes used for the token request |
| tokenURL<a href="#v1-oauth2-tokenurl" id="v1-oauth2-tokenurl">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>TokenURL defines URL to fetch the token from |

#### VLAgentRemoteWriteSettings {#v1-vlagentremotewritesettings}

VLAgentRemoteWriteSettings - defines global settings for all remoteWrite urls.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |

| maxBlockSize<a href="#v1-vlagentremotewritesettings-maxblocksize" id="v1-vlagentremotewritesettings-maxblocksize">#</a><br/>_[BytesString (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-bytesstring)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The maximum size of unpacked request to send to remote storage |
| maxDiskUsagePerURL<a href="#v1-vlagentremotewritesettings-maxdiskusageperurl" id="v1-vlagentremotewritesettings-maxdiskusageperurl">#</a><br/>_[BytesString (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-bytesstring)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The maximum file-based buffer size in bytes at -remoteWrite.tmpDataPath |

| extraEnvs<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-extraenvs" id="v1-vlagentspec-extraenvs">#</a><br/>_[EnvVar (v1)](#v1-envvar) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvs that will be passed to the application container |

| hostAliases<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-hostaliases" id="v1-vlagentspec-hostaliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliases provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork. |
| hostNetwork<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-hostnetwork" id="v1-vlagentspec-hostnetwork">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostNetwork controls whether the pod may use the node network namespace |
| host_aliases<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-host_aliases" id="v1-vlagentspec-host_aliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliasesUnderScore provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork.<br />Has Priority over hostAliases field |
| image<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-image" id="v1-vlagentspec-image">#</a><br/>_[Image (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-image)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Image - docker image settings<br />if no specified operator uses default version from operator config |
| imagePullSecrets<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-imagepullsecrets" id="v1-vlagentspec-imagepullsecrets">#</a><br/>_[LocalObjectReference (v1)](#v1-localobjectreference) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ImagePullSecrets An optional list of references to secrets in the same namespace<br />to use for pulling images from registries<br />see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images/#specifying-imagepullsecrets-on-a-pod |
| initContainers<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-initcontainers" id="v1-vlagentspec-initcontainers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InitContainers allows adding initContainers to the pod definition.<br />Any errors during the execution of an initContainer will lead to a restart of the Pod.<br />More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/ |
| k8sCollector<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-k8scollector" id="v1-vlagentspec-k8scollector">#</a><br/>_[VLAgentK8sCollector (v1)](#v1-vlagentk8scollector)_ | _(Required)_<br/>K8sCollector configures VLAgent logs collection from K8s pods |
| license<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-license" id="v1-vlagentspec-license">#</a><br/>_[License (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-license)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>License allows to configure license key to be used for enterprise features.<br />See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/enterprise/#victorialogs-enterprise-features) |
| livenessProbe<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-livenessprobe" id="v1-vlagentspec-livenessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LivenessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| logFormat<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-logformat" id="v1-vlagentspec-logformat">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogFormat for VLAgent to be configured with. |
| logLevel<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-loglevel" id="v1-vlagentspec-loglevel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogLevel for VLAgent to be configured with.<br />INFO, WARN, ERROR, FATAL, PANIC |
| managedMetadata<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-managedmetadata" id="v1-vlagentspec-managedmetadata">#</a><br/>_[ManagedObjectsMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-managedobjectsmetadata)_ | _(Required)_<br/>ManagedMetadata defines metadata that will be added to the all objects<br />created by operator for the given CustomResource |
| minReadySeconds<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-minreadyseconds" id="v1-vlagentspec-minreadyseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MinReadySeconds defines a minimum number of seconds to wait before starting update next pod<br />if previous in healthy state<br />Has no effect for VLogs and VMSingle |
| networkPolicy<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-networkpolicy" id="v1-vlagentspec-networkpolicy">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedNetworkPolicy (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddednetworkpolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NetworkPolicy defines network access rules for pods created by this CR. |
| nodeSelector<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-nodeselector" id="v1-vlagentspec-nodeselector">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeSelector Define which Nodes the Pods are scheduled on. |
| paused<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-paused" id="v1-vlagentspec-paused">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Paused If set to true all actions on the underlying managed objects are not<br />going to be performed, except for delete actions. |
| persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-persistentvolumeclaimretentionpolicy" id="v1-vlagentspec-persistentvolumeclaimretentionpolicy">#</a><br/>_[StatefulSetPersistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy (v1)](#v1-statefulsetpersistentvolumeclaimretentionpolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PersistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy allows configuration of PVC retention policy |
| podDisruptionBudget<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-poddisruptionbudget" id="v1-vlagentspec-poddisruptionbudget">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedPodDisruptionBudgetSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedpoddisruptionbudgetspec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodDisruptionBudget created by operator |
| podMetadata<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-podmetadata" id="v1-vlagentspec-podmetadata">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedObjectMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedobjectmetadata)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodMetadata configures Labels and Annotations which are propagated to the vlagent pods. |
| port<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-port" id="v1-vlagentspec-port">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Port listen address |
| preStopSleepSeconds<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-prestopsleepseconds" id="v1-vlagentspec-prestopsleepseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PreStopSleepSeconds defines the number of seconds to sleep in the preStop lifecycle hook.<br />It gives time for load balancers to remove the pod from rotation before the pod is terminated.<br />Defaults to 15 for applicable components. Set to 0 to disable. |
| priorityClassName<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-priorityclassname" id="v1-vlagentspec-priorityclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PriorityClassName class assigned to the Pods |
| readinessGates<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-readinessgates" id="v1-vlagentspec-readinessgates">#</a><br/>_[PodReadinessGate (v1)](#v1-podreadinessgate) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>ReadinessGates defines pod readiness gates |
| readinessProbe<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-readinessprobe" id="v1-vlagentspec-readinessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReadinessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| remoteWrite<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-remotewrite" id="v1-vlagentspec-remotewrite">#</a><br/>_[VLAgentRemoteWriteSpec (v1)](#v1-vlagentremotewritespec) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>RemoteWrite list of victoria logs endpoints<br />for victorialogs it must looks like: http://victoria-logs-single:9428/<br />or for cluster different url<br />https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/vlagent/#replication-and-high-availability |
| remoteWriteSettings<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-remotewritesettings" id="v1-vlagentspec-remotewritesettings">#</a><br/>_[VLAgentRemoteWriteSettings (v1)](#v1-vlagentremotewritesettings)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RemoteWriteSettings defines global settings for all remoteWrite urls. |
| replicaCount<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-replicacount" id="v1-vlagentspec-replicacount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReplicaCount is the expected size of the Application. |
| resources<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-resources" id="v1-vlagentspec-resources">#</a><br/>_[ResourceRequirements (v1)](#v1-resourcerequirements)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Resources container resource request and limits, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/<br />if not defined default resources from operator config will be used |
| revisionHistoryLimitCount<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-revisionhistorylimitcount" id="v1-vlagentspec-revisionhistorylimitcount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The number of old ReplicaSets to retain to allow rollback in deployment or<br />maximum number of revisions that will be maintained in the Deployment revision history.<br />Has no effect at StatefulSets<br />Defaults to 10. |
| rollingUpdateStrategy<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-rollingupdatestrategy" id="v1-vlagentspec-rollingupdatestrategy">#</a><br/>_[StatefulSetUpdateStrategyType (v1)](#v1-statefulsetupdatestrategytype)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RollingUpdateStrategy allows configuration for strategyType<br />set it to RollingUpdate for disabling operator statefulSet rollingUpdate |
| runtimeClassName<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-runtimeclassname" id="v1-vlagentspec-runtimeclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RuntimeClassName - defines runtime class for kubernetes pod.<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/ |
| schedulerName<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-schedulername" id="v1-vlagentspec-schedulername">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SchedulerName - defines kubernetes scheduler name |
| secrets<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-secrets" id="v1-vlagentspec-secrets">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Secrets is a list of Secrets in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/secrets/SECRET_NAME folder |
| securityContext<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-securitycontext" id="v1-vlagentspec-securitycontext">#</a><br/>_[SecurityContext (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-securitycontext)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SecurityContext holds pod-level security attributes and common container settings.<br />This defaults to the default PodSecurityContext. |
| serviceAccountName<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-serviceaccountname" id="v1-vlagentspec-serviceaccountname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceAccountName is the name of the ServiceAccount to use to run the pods |
| serviceScrapeSpec<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-servicescrapespec" id="v1-vlagentspec-servicescrapespec">#</a><br/>_[VMServiceScrapeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeSpec that will be added to vlagent VMServiceScrape spec |
| serviceSpec<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-servicespec" id="v1-vlagentspec-servicespec">#</a><br/>_[AdditionalServiceSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-additionalservicespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceSpec that will be added to vlagent service spec |
| startupProbe<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-startupprobe" id="v1-vlagentspec-startupprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StartupProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| storage<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-storage" id="v1-vlagentspec-storage">#</a><br/>_[StorageSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-storagespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Storage configures storage for StatefulSet |
| syslogSpec<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-syslogspec" id="v1-vlagentspec-syslogspec">#</a><br/>_[SyslogServerSpec (v1)](#v1-syslogserverspec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SyslogSpec defines syslog listener configuration |
| terminationGracePeriodSeconds<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-terminationgraceperiodseconds" id="v1-vlagentspec-terminationgraceperiodseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TerminationGracePeriodSeconds period for container graceful termination |
| tmpDataPath<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-tmpdatapath" id="v1-vlagentspec-tmpdatapath">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Path to directory where temporary data for vlagent stored<br />Defaults to /vlagent-data or /var/lib/vlagent-data in collector mode<br />If defined, operator ignores spec.storage field and skips adding volume and volumeMount for tmp data |
| tolerations<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-tolerations" id="v1-vlagentspec-tolerations">#</a><br/>_[Toleration (v1)](#v1-toleration) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Tolerations If specified, the pod's tolerations. |
| topologySpreadConstraints<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-topologyspreadconstraints" id="v1-vlagentspec-topologyspreadconstraints">#</a><br/>_[TopologySpreadConstraint (v1)](#v1-topologyspreadconstraint) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TopologySpreadConstraints embedded kubernetes pod configuration option,<br />controls how pods are spread across your cluster among failure-domains<br />such as regions, zones, nodes, and other user-defined topology domains<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/ |
| useDefaultResources<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-usedefaultresources" id="v1-vlagentspec-usedefaultresources">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseDefaultResources controls resource settings<br />By default, operator sets built-in resource requirements |
| useLegacyNaming<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-uselegacynaming" id="v1-vlagentspec-uselegacynaming">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseLegacyNaming uses standalone Helm chart naming for managed resources:<br />the CR name is used directly instead of the default "<type>-<name>" convention.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0730">v0.73.0</a> |
| useStrictSecurity<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-usestrictsecurity" id="v1-vlagentspec-usestrictsecurity">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseStrictSecurity enables strict security mode for component<br />it restricts disk writes access<br />uses non-root user out of the box<br />drops not needed security permissions |
| volumeMounts<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-volumemounts" id="v1-vlagentspec-volumemounts">#</a><br/>_[VolumeMount (v1)](#v1-volumemount) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VolumeMounts allows configuration of additional VolumeMounts on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />VolumeMounts specified will be appended to other VolumeMounts in the Application container |
| volumes<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-volumes" id="v1-vlagentspec-volumes">#</a><br/>_[Volume (v1)](#v1-volume) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Volumes allows configuration of additional volumes on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />Volumes specified will be appended to other volumes that are generated. |
| vpa<a href="#v1-vlagentspec-vpa" id="v1-vlagentspec-vpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedVPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedvpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configures vertical pod autoscaling. |

#### VLCluster {#v1-vlcluster}

VLCluster is fast, cost-effective and scalable logs database.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| apiVersion<br/>_string_ | (Required)<br/>`operator.victoriametrics.com/v1` |
| kind<br/>_string_ | (Required)<br/>`VLCluster` |
| metadata<a href="#v1-vlcluster-metadata" id="v1-vlcluster-metadata">#</a><br/>_[ObjectMeta (v1)](#v1-objectmeta)_ | _(Required)_<br/>Refer to Kubernetes API documentation for fields of `metadata`. |

#### VLClusterSpec {#v1-vlclusterspec}

VLClusterSpec defines the desired state of VLCluster

Appears in: [VLCluster (v1)](#v1-vlcluster), [VLDistributedZoneCluster (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vldistributedzonecluster)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| clusterDomainName<a href="#v1-vlclusterspec-clusterdomainname" id="v1-vlclusterspec-clusterdomainname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ClusterDomainName defines domain name suffix for in-cluster dns addresses<br />aka .cluster.local<br />used by vlinsert and vlselect to build vlstorage address |
| clusterVersion<a href="#v1-vlclusterspec-clusterversion" id="v1-vlclusterspec-clusterversion">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ClusterVersion defines default images tag for all components.<br />it can be overwritten with component specific image.tag value. |
| imagePullSecrets<a href="#v1-vlclusterspec-imagepullsecrets" id="v1-vlclusterspec-imagepullsecrets">#</a><br/>_[LocalObjectReference (v1)](#v1-localobjectreference) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ImagePullSecrets An optional list of references to secrets in the same namespace<br />to use for pulling images from registries<br />see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images/#specifying-imagepullsecrets-on-a-pod |
| license<a href="#v1-vlclusterspec-license" id="v1-vlclusterspec-license">#</a><br/>_[License (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-license)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>License allows to configure license key to be used for enterprise features.<br />See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/enterprise/#victorialogs-enterprise-features) |
| managedMetadata<a href="#v1-vlclusterspec-managedmetadata" id="v1-vlclusterspec-managedmetadata">#</a><br/>_[ManagedObjectsMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-managedobjectsmetadata)_ | _(Required)_<br/>ManagedMetadata defines metadata that will be added to the all objects<br />created by operator for the given CustomResource |
| paused<a href="#v1-vlclusterspec-paused" id="v1-vlclusterspec-paused">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Paused If set to true all actions on the underlying managed objects are not<br />going to be performed, except for delete actions. |
| requestsLoadBalancer<a href="#v1-vlclusterspec-requestsloadbalancer" id="v1-vlclusterspec-requestsloadbalancer">#</a><br/>_[VMAuthLoadBalancer (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancer)_ | _(Required)_<br/>RequestsLoadBalancer configures load-balancing for vlinsert and vlselect requests.<br />It helps to evenly spread load across pods.<br />Usually it's not possible with Kubernetes TCP-based services. |
| serviceAccountName<a href="#v1-vlclusterspec-serviceaccountname" id="v1-vlclusterspec-serviceaccountname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceAccountName is the name of the ServiceAccount to use to run the<br />VLSelect, VLInsert and VLStorage Pods. |
| useLegacyNaming<a href="#v1-vlclusterspec-uselegacynaming" id="v1-vlclusterspec-uselegacynaming">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseLegacyNaming switches component resource naming from the default prefix convention<br />(<component>-<name>, e.g. "vlselect-myapp") to a suffix convention (<name>-<component>,<br />e.g. "myapp-vlselect"). Useful when migrating from standalone Helm charts.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0730">v0.73.0</a> |
| useStrictSecurity<a href="#v1-vlclusterspec-usestrictsecurity" id="v1-vlclusterspec-usestrictsecurity">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseStrictSecurity enables strict security mode for component<br />it restricts disk writes access<br />uses non-root user out of the box<br />drops not needed security permissions |
| vlinsert<a href="#v1-vlclusterspec-vlinsert" id="v1-vlclusterspec-vlinsert">#</a><br/>_[VLInsert (v1)](#v1-vlinsert)_ | _(Required)_<br/> |
| vlselect<a href="#v1-vlclusterspec-vlselect" id="v1-vlclusterspec-vlselect">#</a><br/>_[VLSelect (v1)](#v1-vlselect)_ | _(Required)_<br/> |
| vlstorage<a href="#v1-vlclusterspec-vlstorage" id="v1-vlclusterspec-vlstorage">#</a><br/>_[VLStorage (v1)](#v1-vlstorage)_ | _(Required)_<br/> |

#### VLInsert {#v1-vlinsert}

VLInsert defines vlinsert component configuration at victoria-logs cluster

Appears in: [VLClusterSpec (v1)](#v1-vlclusterspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| affinity<a href="#v1-vlinsert-affinity" id="v1-vlinsert-affinity">#</a><br/>_[Affinity (v1)](#v1-affinity)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Affinity If specified, the pod's scheduling constraints. |
| componentVersion<a href="#v1-vlinsert-componentversion" id="v1-vlinsert-componentversion">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ComponentVersion defines default images tag for this component.<br />it can be overwritten with component specific image.tag value. |
| configMaps<a href="#v1-vlinsert-configmaps" id="v1-vlinsert-configmaps">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigMaps is a list of ConfigMaps in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/configs/CONFIGMAP_NAME folder |
| containers<a href="#v1-vlinsert-containers" id="v1-vlinsert-containers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Containers property allows to inject additions sidecars or to patch existing containers.<br />It can be useful for proxies, backup, etc. |
| disableAutomountServiceAccountToken<a href="#v1-vlinsert-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken" id="v1-vlinsert-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableAutomountServiceAccountToken whether to disable serviceAccount auto mount by Kubernetes<br />Operator will conditionally create volumes and volumeMounts for containers if it requires k8s API access.<br />For example, vmagent and vm-config-reloader requires k8s API access.<br />Operator creates volumes with name: "kube-api-access", which can be used as volumeMount for extraContainers if needed.<br />And also adds VolumeMounts at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0540">v0.54.0</a> |
| disableSelfServiceScrape<a href="#v1-vlinsert-disableselfservicescrape" id="v1-vlinsert-disableselfservicescrape">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableSelfServiceScrape controls creation of VMServiceScrape by operator<br />for the application.<br />Has priority over `VM_DISABLESELFSERVICESCRAPECREATION` operator env variable |
| dnsConfig<a href="#v1-vlinsert-dnsconfig" id="v1-vlinsert-dnsconfig">#</a><br/>_[PodDNSConfig (v1)](#v1-poddnsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Specifies the DNS parameters of a pod.<br />Parameters specified here will be merged to the generated DNS<br />configuration based on DNSPolicy. |
| dnsPolicy<a href="#v1-vlinsert-dnspolicy" id="v1-vlinsert-dnspolicy">#</a><br/>_[DNSPolicy (v1)](#v1-dnspolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DNSPolicy sets DNS policy for the pod |
| enableServiceLinks<a href="#v1-vlinsert-enableservicelinks" id="v1-vlinsert-enableservicelinks">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableServiceLinks indicates whether information about services should be injected into pod's<br />environment variables, matching the syntax of Docker links.<br />Optional: Defaults to true. |
| extraArgs<a href="#v1-vlinsert-extraargs" id="v1-vlinsert-extraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraArgs that will be passed to the application container<br />for example remoteWrite.tmpDataPath: /tmp |
| extraEnvs<a href="#v1-vlinsert-extraenvs" id="v1-vlinsert-extraenvs">#</a><br/>_[EnvVar (v1)](#v1-envvar) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvs that will be passed to the application container |
| extraEnvsFrom<a href="#v1-vlinsert-extraenvsfrom" id="v1-vlinsert-extraenvsfrom">#</a><br/>_[EnvFromSource (v1)](#v1-envfromsource) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvsFrom defines source of env variables for the application container<br />could either be secret or configmap |
| hostAliases<a href="#v1-vlinsert-hostaliases" id="v1-vlinsert-hostaliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliases provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork. |
| hostNetwork<a href="#v1-vlinsert-hostnetwork" id="v1-vlinsert-hostnetwork">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostNetwork controls whether the pod may use the node network namespace |
| host_aliases<a href="#v1-vlinsert-host_aliases" id="v1-vlinsert-host_aliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliasesUnderScore provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork.<br />Has Priority over hostAliases field |
| hpa<a href="#v1-vlinsert-hpa" id="v1-vlinsert-hpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedHPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedhpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configures horizontal pod autoscaling. |
| image<a href="#v1-vlinsert-image" id="v1-vlinsert-image">#</a><br/>_[Image (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-image)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Image - docker image settings<br />if no specified operator uses default version from operator config |
| imagePullSecrets<a href="#v1-vlinsert-imagepullsecrets" id="v1-vlinsert-imagepullsecrets">#</a><br/>_[LocalObjectReference (v1)](#v1-localobjectreference) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ImagePullSecrets An optional list of references to secrets in the same namespace<br />to use for pulling images from registries<br />see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images/#specifying-imagepullsecrets-on-a-pod |
| initContainers<a href="#v1-vlinsert-initcontainers" id="v1-vlinsert-initcontainers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InitContainers allows adding initContainers to the pod definition.<br />Any errors during the execution of an initContainer will lead to a restart of the Pod.<br />More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/ |
| livenessProbe<a href="#v1-vlinsert-livenessprobe" id="v1-vlinsert-livenessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LivenessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| logFormat<a href="#v1-vlinsert-logformat" id="v1-vlinsert-logformat">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogFormat for VLSelect to be configured with.<br />default or json |

Set to 0 to disable. |

#### VLSelect {#v1-vlselect}

VLSelect defines vlselect component configuration at victoria-logs cluster

Appears in: [VLClusterSpec (v1)](#v1-vlclusterspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| affinity<a href="#v1-vlselect-affinity" id="v1-vlselect-affinity">#</a><br/>_[Affinity (v1)](#v1-affinity)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Affinity If specified, the pod's scheduling constraints. |
| componentVersion<a href="#v1-vlselect-componentversion" id="v1-vlselect-componentversion">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ComponentVersion defines default images tag for this component.<br />it can be overwritten with component specific image.tag value. |
| configMaps<a href="#v1-vlselect-configmaps" id="v1-vlselect-configmaps">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigMaps is a list of ConfigMaps in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/configs/CONFIGMAP_NAME folder |
| containers<a href="#v1-vlselect-containers" id="v1-vlselect-containers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Containers property allows to inject additions sidecars or to patch existing containers.<br />It can be useful for proxies, backup, etc. |
| disableAutomountServiceAccountToken<a href="#v1-vlselect-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken" id="v1-vlselect-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableAutomountServiceAccountToken whether to disable serviceAccount auto mount by Kubernetes<br />Operator will conditionally create volumes and volumeMounts for containers if it requires k8s API access.<br />For example, vmagent and vm-config-reloader requires k8s API access.<br />Operator creates volumes with name: "kube-api-access", which can be used as volumeMount for extraContainers if needed.<br />And also adds VolumeMounts at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0540">v0.54.0</a> |
| disableSelfServiceScrape<a href="#v1-vlselect-disableselfservicescrape" id="v1-vlselect-disableselfservicescrape">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableSelfServiceScrape controls creation of VMServiceScrape by operator<br />for the application.<br />Has priority over `VM_DISABLESELFSERVICESCRAPECREATION` operator env variable |
| dnsConfig<a href="#v1-vlselect-dnsconfig" id="v1-vlselect-dnsconfig">#</a><br/>_[PodDNSConfig (v1)](#v1-poddnsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Specifies the DNS parameters of a pod.<br />Parameters specified here will be merged to the generated DNS<br />configuration based on DNSPolicy. |
| dnsPolicy<a href="#v1-vlselect-dnspolicy" id="v1-vlselect-dnspolicy">#</a><br/>_[DNSPolicy (v1)](#v1-dnspolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DNSPolicy sets DNS policy for the pod |
| enableServiceLinks<a href="#v1-vlselect-enableservicelinks" id="v1-vlselect-enableservicelinks">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableServiceLinks indicates whether information about services should be injected into pod's<br />environment variables, matching the syntax of Docker links.<br />Optional: Defaults to true. |
| extraArgs<a href="#v1-vlselect-extraargs" id="v1-vlselect-extraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraArgs that will be passed to the application container<br />for example remoteWrite.tmpDataPath: /tmp |
| extraEnvs<a href="#v1-vlselect-extraenvs" id="v1-vlselect-extraenvs">#</a><br/>_[EnvVar (v1)](#v1-envvar) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvs that will be passed to the application container |
| extraEnvsFrom<a href="#v1-vlselect-extraenvsfrom" id="v1-vlselect-extraenvsfrom">#</a><br/>_[EnvFromSource (v1)](#v1-envfromsource) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvsFrom defines source of env variables for the application container<br />could either be secret or configmap |
| extraStorageNodes<a href="#v1-vlselect-extrastoragenodes" id="v1-vlselect-extrastoragenodes">#</a><br/>_[VLStorageNode (v1)](#v1-vlstoragenode) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>ExtraStorageNodes - defines additional storage nodes to VLSelect |

| hostNetwork<a href="#v1-vlselect-hostnetwork" id="v1-vlselect-hostnetwork">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostNetwork controls whether the pod may use the node network namespace |

| minReadySeconds<a href="#v1-vlselect-minreadyseconds" id="v1-vlselect-minreadyseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MinReadySeconds defines a minimum number of seconds to wait before starting update next pod<br />if previous in healthy state<br />Has no effect for VLogs and VMSingle |

| nodeSelector<a href="#v1-vlselect-nodeselector" id="v1-vlselect-nodeselector">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeSelector Define which Nodes the Pods are scheduled on. |

| podMetadata<a href="#v1-vlselect-podmetadata" id="v1-vlselect-podmetadata">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedObjectMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedobjectmetadata)_ | _(Required)_<br/>PodMetadata configures Labels and Annotations which are propagated to the VLSelect pods. |

#### VLSingle {#v1-vlsingle}

VLSingle is fast, cost-effective and scalable logs database.
VLSingle is the Schema for the API

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| apiVersion<br/>_string_ | (Required)<br/>`operator.victoriametrics.com/v1` |
| kind<br/>_string_ | (Required)<br/>`VLSingle` |
| metadata<a href="#v1-vlsingle-metadata" id="v1-vlsingle-metadata">#</a><br/>_[ObjectMeta (v1)](#v1-objectmeta)_ | _(Required)_<br/>Refer to Kubernetes API documentation for fields of `metadata`. |
| spec<a href="#v1-vlsingle-spec" id="v1-vlsingle-spec">#</a><br/>_[VLSingleSpec (v1)](#v1-vlsinglespec)_ | _(Required)_<br/> |

#### VLSingleSpec {#v1-vlsinglespec}

VLSingleSpec defines the desired state of VLSingle

Appears in: [VLDistributedZoneSingle (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vldistributedzonesingle), [VLSingle (v1)](#v1-vlsingle)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| affinity<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-affinity" id="v1-vlsinglespec-affinity">#</a><br/>_[Affinity (v1)](#v1-affinity)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Affinity If specified, the pod's scheduling constraints. |
| componentVersion<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-componentversion" id="v1-vlsinglespec-componentversion">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ComponentVersion defines default images tag for all components.<br />it can be overwritten with component specific image.tag value. |
| configMaps<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-configmaps" id="v1-vlsinglespec-configmaps">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigMaps is a list of ConfigMaps in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/configs/CONFIGMAP_NAME folder |
| containers<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-containers" id="v1-vlsinglespec-containers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Containers property allows to inject additions sidecars or to patch existing containers.<br />It can be useful for proxies, backup, etc. |
| disableAutomountServiceAccountToken<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken" id="v1-vlsinglespec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableAutomountServiceAccountToken whether to disable serviceAccount auto mount by Kubernetes<br />Operator will conditionally create volumes and volumeMounts for containers if it requires k8s API access.<br />For example, vmagent and vm-config-reloader requires k8s API access.<br />Operator creates volumes with name: "kube-api-access", which can be used as volumeMount for extraContainers if needed.<br />And also adds VolumeMounts at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0540">v0.54.0</a> |
| disableSelfServiceScrape<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-disableselfservicescrape" id="v1-vlsinglespec-disableselfservicescrape">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableSelfServiceScrape controls creation of VMServiceScrape by operator<br />for the application.<br />Has priority over `VM_DISABLESELFSERVICESCRAPECREATION` operator env variable |
| dnsConfig<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-dnsconfig" id="v1-vlsinglespec-dnsconfig">#</a><br/>_[PodDNSConfig (v1)](#v1-poddnsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Specifies the DNS parameters of a pod.<br />Parameters specified here will be merged to the generated DNS<br />configuration based on DNSPolicy. |
| dnsPolicy<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-dnspolicy" id="v1-vlsinglespec-dnspolicy">#</a><br/>_[DNSPolicy (v1)](#v1-dnspolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DNSPolicy sets DNS policy for the pod |
| enableServiceLinks<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-enableservicelinks" id="v1-vlsinglespec-enableservicelinks">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableServiceLinks indicates whether information about services should be injected into pod's<br />environment variables, matching the syntax of Docker links.<br />Optional: Defaults to true. |
| extraArgs<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-extraargs" id="v1-vlsinglespec-extraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraArgs that will be passed to the application container<br />for example remoteWrite.tmpDataPath: /tmp |
| extraEnvs<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-extraenvs" id="v1-vlsinglespec-extraenvs">#</a><br/>_[EnvVar (v1)](#v1-envvar) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvs that will be passed to the application container |
| extraEnvsFrom<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-extraenvsfrom" id="v1-vlsinglespec-extraenvsfrom">#</a><br/>_[EnvFromSource (v1)](#v1-envfromsource) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvsFrom defines source of env variables for the application container<br />could either be secret or configmap |
| futureRetention<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-futureretention" id="v1-vlsinglespec-futureretention">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>FutureRetention for the stored logs<br />Log entries with timestamps bigger than now+futureRetention are rejected during data ingestion; see https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/#retention |
| hostAliases<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-hostaliases" id="v1-vlsinglespec-hostaliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliases provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork. |
| hostNetwork<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-hostnetwork" id="v1-vlsinglespec-hostnetwork">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostNetwork controls whether the pod may use the node network namespace |
| host_aliases<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-host_aliases" id="v1-vlsinglespec-host_aliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliasesUnderScore provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork.<br />Has Priority over hostAliases field |
| image<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-image" id="v1-vlsinglespec-image">#</a><br/>_[Image (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-image)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Image - docker image settings<br />if no specified operator uses default version from operator config |
| imagePullSecrets<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-imagepullsecrets" id="v1-vlsinglespec-imagepullsecrets">#</a><br/>_[LocalObjectReference (v1)](#v1-localobjectreference) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ImagePullSecrets An optional list of references to secrets in the same namespace<br />to use for pulling images from registries<br />see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images/#specifying-imagepullsecrets-on-a-pod |
| initContainers<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-initcontainers" id="v1-vlsinglespec-initcontainers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InitContainers allows adding initContainers to the pod definition.<br />Any errors during the execution of an initContainer will lead to a restart of the Pod.<br />More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/ |
| license<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-license" id="v1-vlsinglespec-license">#</a><br/>_[License (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-license)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>License allows to configure license key to be used for enterprise features.<br />See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/enterprise/#victorialogs-enterprise-features) |
| livenessProbe<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-livenessprobe" id="v1-vlsinglespec-livenessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LivenessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| logFormat<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-logformat" id="v1-vlsinglespec-logformat">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogFormat for VLSingle to be configured with. |
| logIngestedRows<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-logingestedrows" id="v1-vlsinglespec-logingestedrows">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>Whether to log all the ingested log entries; this can be useful for debugging of data ingestion; see https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/data-ingestion/ |
| logLevel<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-loglevel" id="v1-vlsinglespec-loglevel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogLevel for VictoriaLogs to be configured with. |
| logNewStreams<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-lognewstreams" id="v1-vlsinglespec-lognewstreams">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>LogNewStreams Whether to log creation of new streams; this can be useful for debugging of high cardinality issues with log streams; see https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/keyconcepts/#stream-fields |
| managedMetadata<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-managedmetadata" id="v1-vlsinglespec-managedmetadata">#</a><br/>_[ManagedObjectsMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-managedobjectsmetadata)_ | _(Required)_<br/>ManagedMetadata defines metadata that will be added to the all objects<br />created by operator for the given CustomResource |
| minReadySeconds<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-minreadyseconds" id="v1-vlsinglespec-minreadyseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MinReadySeconds defines a minimum number of seconds to wait before starting update next pod<br />if previous in healthy state<br />Has no effect for VLogs and VMSingle |
| networkPolicy<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-networkpolicy" id="v1-vlsinglespec-networkpolicy">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedNetworkPolicy (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddednetworkpolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NetworkPolicy defines network access rules for pods created by this CR. |
| nodeSelector<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-nodeselector" id="v1-vlsinglespec-nodeselector">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeSelector Define which Nodes the Pods are scheduled on. |
| paused<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-paused" id="v1-vlsinglespec-paused">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Paused If set to true all actions on the underlying managed objects are not<br />going to be performed, except for delete actions. |
| podMetadata<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-podmetadata" id="v1-vlsinglespec-podmetadata">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedObjectMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedobjectmetadata)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodMetadata configures Labels and Annotations which are propagated to the VLSingle pods. |
| port<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-port" id="v1-vlsinglespec-port">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Port listen address |
| preStopSleepSeconds<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-prestopsleepseconds" id="v1-vlsinglespec-prestopsleepseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PreStopSleepSeconds defines the number of seconds to sleep in the preStop lifecycle hook.<br />It gives time for load balancers to remove the pod from rotation before the pod is terminated.<br />Defaults to 15 for applicable components. Set to 0 to disable. |
| priorityClassName<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-priorityclassname" id="v1-vlsinglespec-priorityclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PriorityClassName class assigned to the Pods |
| readinessGates<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-readinessgates" id="v1-vlsinglespec-readinessgates">#</a><br/>_[PodReadinessGate (v1)](#v1-podreadinessgate) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>ReadinessGates defines pod readiness gates |
| readinessProbe<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-readinessprobe" id="v1-vlsinglespec-readinessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReadinessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| replicaCount<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-replicacount" id="v1-vlsinglespec-replicacount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReplicaCount is the expected size of the Application. |
| resources<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-resources" id="v1-vlsinglespec-resources">#</a><br/>_[ResourceRequirements (v1)](#v1-resourcerequirements)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Resources container resource request and limits, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/<br />if not defined default resources from operator config will be used |
| retentionMaxDiskSpaceUsageBytes<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-retentionmaxdiskspaceusagebytes" id="v1-vlsinglespec-retentionmaxdiskspaceusagebytes">#</a><br/>_[BytesString (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-bytesstring)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RetentionMaxDiskSpaceUsageBytes for the stored logs<br />VictoriaLogs keeps at least two last days of data in order to guarantee that the logs for the last day can be returned in queries.<br />This means that the total disk space usage may exceed the -retention.maxDiskSpaceUsageBytes,<br />if the size of the last two days of data exceeds the -retention.maxDiskSpaceUsageBytes.<br />https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/#retention-by-disk-space-usage |
| retentionPeriod<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-retentionperiod" id="v1-vlsinglespec-retentionperiod">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RetentionPeriod for the stored logs<br />https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/#retention |
| revisionHistoryLimitCount<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-revisionhistorylimitcount" id="v1-vlsinglespec-revisionhistorylimitcount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The number of old ReplicaSets to retain to allow rollback in deployment or<br />maximum number of revisions that will be maintained in the Deployment revision history.<br />Has no effect at StatefulSets<br />Defaults to 10. |
| runtimeClassName<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-runtimeclassname" id="v1-vlsinglespec-runtimeclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RuntimeClassName - defines runtime class for kubernetes pod.<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/ |
| schedulerName<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-schedulername" id="v1-vlsinglespec-schedulername">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SchedulerName - defines kubernetes scheduler name |
| secrets<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-secrets" id="v1-vlsinglespec-secrets">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Secrets is a list of Secrets in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/secrets/SECRET_NAME folder |
| securityContext<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-securitycontext" id="v1-vlsinglespec-securitycontext">#</a><br/>_[SecurityContext (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-securitycontext)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SecurityContext holds pod-level security attributes and common container settings.<br />This defaults to the default PodSecurityContext. |
| serviceAccountName<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-serviceaccountname" id="v1-vlsinglespec-serviceaccountname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceAccountName is the name of the ServiceAccount to use to run the pods |
| serviceScrapeSpec<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-servicescrapespec" id="v1-vlsinglespec-servicescrapespec">#</a><br/>_[VMServiceScrapeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeSpec that will be added to vlsingle VMServiceScrape spec |
| serviceSpec<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-servicespec" id="v1-vlsinglespec-servicespec">#</a><br/>_[AdditionalServiceSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-additionalservicespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceSpec that will be added to vlsingle service spec |
| startupProbe<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-startupprobe" id="v1-vlsinglespec-startupprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StartupProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| storage<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-storage" id="v1-vlsinglespec-storage">#</a><br/>_[PersistentVolumeClaimSpec (v1)](#v1-persistentvolumeclaimspec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Storage is the definition of how storage will be used by the VLSingle<br />by default it`s empty dir |
| storageDataPath<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-storagedatapath" id="v1-vlsinglespec-storagedatapath">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StorageDataPath disables spec.storage option and overrides arg for victoria-logs binary --storageDataPath,<br />its users responsibility to mount proper device into given path. |
| storageMetadata<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-storagemetadata" id="v1-vlsinglespec-storagemetadata">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedObjectMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedobjectmetadata)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StorageMeta defines annotations and labels attached to PVC for given vlsingle CR |
| syslogSpec<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-syslogspec" id="v1-vlsinglespec-syslogspec">#</a><br/>_[SyslogServerSpec (v1)](#v1-syslogserverspec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SyslogSpec defines syslog listener configuration |
| terminationGracePeriodSeconds<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-terminationgraceperiodseconds" id="v1-vlsinglespec-terminationgraceperiodseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TerminationGracePeriodSeconds period for container graceful termination |
| tolerations<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-tolerations" id="v1-vlsinglespec-tolerations">#</a><br/>_[Toleration (v1)](#v1-toleration) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Tolerations If specified, the pod's tolerations. |
| topologySpreadConstraints<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-topologyspreadconstraints" id="v1-vlsinglespec-topologyspreadconstraints">#</a><br/>_[TopologySpreadConstraint (v1)](#v1-topologyspreadconstraint) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TopologySpreadConstraints embedded kubernetes pod configuration option,<br />controls how pods are spread across your cluster among failure-domains<br />such as regions, zones, nodes, and other user-defined topology domains<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/ |
| useDefaultResources<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-usedefaultresources" id="v1-vlsinglespec-usedefaultresources">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseDefaultResources controls resource settings<br />By default, operator sets built-in resource requirements |
| useLegacyNaming<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-uselegacynaming" id="v1-vlsinglespec-uselegacynaming">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseLegacyNaming uses standalone Helm chart naming for managed resources:<br />the CR name is used directly instead of the default "<type>-<name>" convention.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0730">v0.73.0</a> |
| useStrictSecurity<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-usestrictsecurity" id="v1-vlsinglespec-usestrictsecurity">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseStrictSecurity enables strict security mode for component<br />it restricts disk writes access<br />uses non-root user out of the box<br />drops not needed security permissions |
| volumeMounts<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-volumemounts" id="v1-vlsinglespec-volumemounts">#</a><br/>_[VolumeMount (v1)](#v1-volumemount) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VolumeMounts allows configuration of additional VolumeMounts on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />VolumeMounts specified will be appended to other VolumeMounts in the Application container |
| volumes<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-volumes" id="v1-vlsinglespec-volumes">#</a><br/>_[Volume (v1)](#v1-volume) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Volumes allows configuration of additional volumes on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />Volumes specified will be appended to other volumes that are generated. |
| vpa<a href="#v1-vlsinglespec-vpa" id="v1-vlsinglespec-vpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedVPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedvpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configures vertical pod autoscaling. |

#### VLStorage {#v1-vlstorage}

VLStorage defines vlstorage component configuration at victoria-logs cluster

Appears in: [VLClusterSpec (v1)](#v1-vlclusterspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| affinity<a href="#v1-vlstorage-affinity" id="v1-vlstorage-affinity">#</a><br/>_[Affinity (v1)](#v1-affinity)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Affinity If specified, the pod's scheduling constraints. |
| claimTemplates<a href="#v1-vlstorage-claimtemplates" id="v1-vlstorage-claimtemplates">#</a><br/>_[PersistentVolumeClaim (v1)](#v1-persistentvolumeclaim) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>ClaimTemplates allows adding additional VolumeClaimTemplates for StatefulSet |
| componentVersion<a href="#v1-vlstorage-componentversion" id="v1-vlstorage-componentversion">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ComponentVersion defines default images tag for this component.<br />it can be overwritten with component specific image.tag value. |
| configMaps<a href="#v1-vlstorage-configmaps" id="v1-vlstorage-configmaps">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigMaps is a list of ConfigMaps in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/configs/CONFIGMAP_NAME folder |
| containers<a href="#v1-vlstorage-containers" id="v1-vlstorage-containers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Containers property allows to inject additions sidecars or to patch existing containers.<br />It can be useful for proxies, backup, etc. |
| disableAutomountServiceAccountToken<a href="#v1-vlstorage-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken" id="v1-vlstorage-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableAutomountServiceAccountToken whether to disable serviceAccount auto mount by Kubernetes<br />Operator will conditionally create volumes and volumeMounts for containers if it requires k8s API access.<br />For example, vmagent and vm-config-reloader requires k8s API access.<br />Operator creates volumes with name: "kube-api-access", which can be used as volumeMount for extraContainers if needed.<br />And also adds VolumeMounts at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0540">v0.54.0</a> |
| disableSelfServiceScrape<a href="#v1-vlstorage-disableselfservicescrape" id="v1-vlstorage-disableselfservicescrape">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableSelfServiceScrape controls creation of VMServiceScrape by operator<br />for the application.<br />Has priority over `VM_DISABLESELFSERVICESCRAPECREATION` operator env variable |
| dnsConfig<a href="#v1-vlstorage-dnsconfig" id="v1-vlstorage-dnsconfig">#</a><br/>_[PodDNSConfig (v1)](#v1-poddnsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Specifies the DNS parameters of a pod.<br />Parameters specified here will be merged to the generated DNS<br />configuration based on DNSPolicy. |
| dnsPolicy<a href="#v1-vlstorage-dnspolicy" id="v1-vlstorage-dnspolicy">#</a><br/>_[DNSPolicy (v1)](#v1-dnspolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DNSPolicy sets DNS policy for the pod |
| enableServiceLinks<a href="#v1-vlstorage-enableservicelinks" id="v1-vlstorage-enableservicelinks">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableServiceLinks indicates whether information about services should be injected into pod's<br />environment variables, matching the syntax of Docker links.<br />Optional: Defaults to true. |
| extraArgs<a href="#v1-vlstorage-extraargs" id="v1-vlstorage-extraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraArgs that will be passed to the application container<br />for example remoteWrite.tmpDataPath: /tmp |
| extraEnvs<a href="#v1-vlstorage-extraenvs" id="v1-vlstorage-extraenvs">#</a><br/>_[EnvVar (v1)](#v1-envvar) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvs that will be passed to the application container |
| extraEnvsFrom<a href="#v1-vlstorage-extraenvsfrom" id="v1-vlstorage-extraenvsfrom">#</a><br/>_[EnvFromSource (v1)](#v1-envfromsource) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvsFrom defines source of env variables for the application container<br />could either be secret or configmap |
| futureRetention<a href="#v1-vlstorage-futureretention" id="v1-vlstorage-futureretention">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>FutureRetention for the stored logs<br />Log entries with timestamps bigger than now+futureRetention are rejected during data ingestion; see https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/#retention |
| hostAliases<a href="#v1-vlstorage-hostaliases" id="v1-vlstorage-hostaliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliases provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork. |
| hostNetwork<a href="#v1-vlstorage-hostnetwork" id="v1-vlstorage-hostnetwork">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostNetwork controls whether the pod may use the node network namespace |
| host_aliases<a href="#v1-vlstorage-host_aliases" id="v1-vlstorage-host_aliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliasesUnderScore provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork.<br />Has Priority over hostAliases field |
| hpa<a href="#v1-vlstorage-hpa" id="v1-vlstorage-hpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedHPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedhpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configures horizontal pod autoscaling.<br />Note, downscaling is not supported. |
| image<a href="#v1-vlstorage-image" id="v1-vlstorage-image">#</a><br/>_[Image (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-image)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Image - docker image settings<br />if no specified operator uses default version from operator config |
| imagePullSecrets<a href="#v1-vlstorage-imagepullsecrets" id="v1-vlstorage-imagepullsecrets">#</a><br/>_[LocalObjectReference (v1)](#v1-localobjectreference) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ImagePullSecrets An optional list of references to secrets in the same namespace<br />to use for pulling images from registries<br />see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images/#specifying-imagepullsecrets-on-a-pod |
| initContainers<a href="#v1-vlstorage-initcontainers" id="v1-vlstorage-initcontainers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InitContainers allows adding initContainers to the pod definition.<br />Any errors during the execution of an initContainer will lead to a restart of the Pod.<br />More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/ |
| livenessProbe<a href="#v1-vlstorage-livenessprobe" id="v1-vlstorage-livenessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LivenessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| logFormat<a href="#v1-vlstorage-logformat" id="v1-vlstorage-logformat">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogFormat for VLStorage to be configured with.<br />default or json |
| logIngestedRows<a href="#v1-vlstorage-logingestedrows" id="v1-vlstorage-logingestedrows">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>Whether to log all the ingested log entries; this can be useful for debugging of data ingestion; see https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/data-ingestion/ |
| logLevel<a href="#v1-vlstorage-loglevel" id="v1-vlstorage-loglevel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogLevel for VLStorage to be configured with. |
| logNewStreams<a href="#v1-vlstorage-lognewstreams" id="v1-vlstorage-lognewstreams">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>LogNewStreams Whether to log creation of new streams; this can be useful for debugging of high cardinality issues with log streams; see https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/keyconcepts/#stream-fields |
| maintenanceInsertNodeIDs<a href="#v1-vlstorage-maintenanceinsertnodeids" id="v1-vlstorage-maintenanceinsertnodeids">#</a><br/>_integer array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MaintenanceInsertNodeIDs - excludes given node ids from insert requests routing, must contain pod suffixes - for pod-0, id will be 0 and etc.<br />lets say, you have pod-0, pod-1, pod-2, pod-3. to exclude pod-0 and pod-3 from insert routing, define nodeIDs: [0,3].<br />Useful at storage expanding, when you want to rebalance some data at cluster. |
| maintenanceSelectNodeIDs<a href="#v1-vlstorage-maintenanceselectnodeids" id="v1-vlstorage-maintenanceselectnodeids">#</a><br/>_integer array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MaintenanceSelectNodeIDs - excludes given node ids from select requests routing, must contain pod suffixes - for pod-0, id will be 0 and etc. |
| minReadySeconds<a href="#v1-vlstorage-minreadyseconds" id="v1-vlstorage-minreadyseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MinReadySeconds defines a minimum number of seconds to wait before starting update next pod<br />if previous in healthy state<br />Has no effect for VLogs and VMSingle |
| networkPolicy<a href="#v1-vlstorage-networkpolicy" id="v1-vlstorage-networkpolicy">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedNetworkPolicy (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddednetworkpolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NetworkPolicy defines network access rules for pods created by this CR. |
| nodeSelector<a href="#v1-vlstorage-nodeselector" id="v1-vlstorage-nodeselector">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeSelector Define which Nodes the Pods are scheduled on. |
| paused<a href="#v1-vlstorage-paused" id="v1-vlstorage-paused">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Paused If set to true all actions on the underlying managed objects are not<br />going to be performed, except for delete actions. |
| persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy<a href="#v1-vlstorage-persistentvolumeclaimretentionpolicy" id="v1-vlstorage-persistentvolumeclaimretentionpolicy">#</a><br/>_[StatefulSetPersistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy (v1)](#v1-statefulsetpersistentvolumeclaimretentionpolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PersistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy allows configuration of PVC retention policy |
| podDisruptionBudget<a href="#v1-vlstorage-poddisruptionbudget" id="v1-vlstorage-poddisruptionbudget">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedPodDisruptionBudgetSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedpoddisruptionbudgetspec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodDisruptionBudget created by operator |
| podMetadata<a href="#v1-vlstorage-podmetadata" id="v1-vlstorage-podmetadata">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedObjectMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedobjectmetadata)_ | _(Required)_<br/>PodMetadata configures Labels and Annotations which are propagated to the VLStorage pods. |
| port<a href="#v1-vlstorage-port" id="v1-vlstorage-port">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Port listen address |
| preStopSleepSeconds<a href="#v1-vlstorage-prestopsleepseconds" id="v1-vlstorage-prestopsleepseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PreStopSleepSeconds defines the number of seconds to sleep in the preStop lifecycle hook.<br />It gives time for load balancers to remove the pod from rotation before the pod is terminated.<br />Defaults to 15 for applicable components. Set to 0 to disable. |
| priorityClassName<a href="#v1-vlstorage-priorityclassname" id="v1-vlstorage-priorityclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PriorityClassName class assigned to the Pods |
| readinessGates<a href="#v1-vlstorage-readinessgates" id="v1-vlstorage-readinessgates">#</a><br/>_[PodReadinessGate (v1)](#v1-podreadinessgate) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>ReadinessGates defines pod readiness gates |
| readinessProbe<a href="#v1-vlstorage-readinessprobe" id="v1-vlstorage-readinessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReadinessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| replicaCount<a href="#v1-vlstorage-replicacount" id="v1-vlstorage-replicacount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReplicaCount is the expected size of the Application. |
| resources<a href="#v1-vlstorage-resources" id="v1-vlstorage-resources">#</a><br/>_[ResourceRequirements (v1)](#v1-resourcerequirements)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Resources container resource request and limits, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/<br />if not defined default resources from operator config will be used |
| retentionMaxDiskSpaceUsageBytes<a href="#v1-vlstorage-retentionmaxdiskspaceusagebytes" id="v1-vlstorage-retentionmaxdiskspaceusagebytes">#</a><br/>_[BytesString (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-bytesstring)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RetentionMaxDiskSpaceUsageBytes for the stored logs<br />VictoriaLogs keeps at least two last days of data in order to guarantee that the logs for the last day can be returned in queries.<br />This means that the total disk space usage may exceed the -retention.maxDiskSpaceUsageBytes,<br />if the size of the last two days of data exceeds the -retention.maxDiskSpaceUsageBytes.<br />https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/#retention-by-disk-space-usage |
| retentionPeriod<a href="#v1-vlstorage-retentionperiod" id="v1-vlstorage-retentionperiod">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RetentionPeriod for the stored logs<br />https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/#retention |
| revisionHistoryLimitCount<a href="#v1-vlstorage-revisionhistorylimitcount" id="v1-vlstorage-revisionhistorylimitcount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The number of old ReplicaSets to retain to allow rollback in deployment or<br />maximum number of revisions that will be maintained in the Deployment revision history.<br />Has no effect at StatefulSets<br />Defaults to 10. |
| rollingUpdateStrategy<a href="#v1-vlstorage-rollingupdatestrategy" id="v1-vlstorage-rollingupdatestrategy">#</a><br/>_[StatefulSetUpdateStrategyType (v1)](#v1-statefulsetupdatestrategytype)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RollingUpdateStrategy defines strategy for application updates<br />Default is OnDelete, in this case operator handles update process<br />Can be changed for RollingUpdate |
| rollingUpdateStrategyBehavior<a href="#v1-vlstorage-rollingupdatestrategybehavior" id="v1-vlstorage-rollingupdatestrategybehavior">#</a><br/>_[StatefulSetUpdateStrategyBehavior (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-statefulsetupdatestrategybehavior)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RollingUpdateStrategyBehavior defines customized behavior for rolling updates.<br />It applies if the RollingUpdateStrategy is set to OnDelete, which is the default. |
| runtimeClassName<a href="#v1-vlstorage-runtimeclassname" id="v1-vlstorage-runtimeclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RuntimeClassName - defines runtime class for kubernetes pod.<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/ |
| schedulerName<a href="#v1-vlstorage-schedulername" id="v1-vlstorage-schedulername">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SchedulerName - defines kubernetes scheduler name |
| secrets<a href="#v1-vlstorage-secrets" id="v1-vlstorage-secrets">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Secrets is a list of Secrets in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/secrets/SECRET_NAME folder |
| securityContext<a href="#v1-vlstorage-securitycontext" id="v1-vlstorage-securitycontext">#</a><br/>_[SecurityContext (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-securitycontext)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SecurityContext holds pod-level security attributes and common container settings.<br />This defaults to the default PodSecurityContext. |
| serviceScrapeSpec<a href="#v1-vlstorage-servicescrapespec" id="v1-vlstorage-servicescrapespec">#</a><br/>_[VMServiceScrapeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeSpec that will be added to vlselect VMServiceScrape spec |
| serviceSpec<a href="#v1-vlstorage-servicespec" id="v1-vlstorage-servicespec">#</a><br/>_[AdditionalServiceSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-additionalservicespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceSpec that will be added to vlselect service spec |
| startupProbe<a href="#v1-vlstorage-startupprobe" id="v1-vlstorage-startupprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StartupProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| storage<a href="#v1-vlstorage-storage" id="v1-vlstorage-storage">#</a><br/>_[StorageSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-storagespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Storage configures persistent volume for VLStorage |
| storageDataPath<a href="#v1-vlstorage-storagedatapath" id="v1-vlstorage-storagedatapath">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StorageDataPath - path to storage data |
| terminationGracePeriodSeconds<a href="#v1-vlstorage-terminationgraceperiodseconds" id="v1-vlstorage-terminationgraceperiodseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TerminationGracePeriodSeconds period for container graceful termination |
| tolerations<a href="#v1-vlstorage-tolerations" id="v1-vlstorage-tolerations">#</a><br/>_[Toleration (v1)](#v1-toleration) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Tolerations If specified, the pod's tolerations. |
| topologySpreadConstraints<a href="#v1-vlstorage-topologyspreadconstraints" id="v1-vlstorage-topologyspreadconstraints">#</a><br/>_[TopologySpreadConstraint (v1)](#v1-topologyspreadconstraint) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TopologySpreadConstraints embedded kubernetes pod configuration option,<br />controls how pods are spread across your cluster among failure-domains<br />such as regions, zones, nodes, and other user-defined topology domains<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/ |
| useDefaultResources<a href="#v1-vlstorage-usedefaultresources" id="v1-vlstorage-usedefaultresources">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseDefaultResources controls resource settings<br />By default, operator sets built-in resource requirements |
| useStrictSecurity<a href="#v1-vlstorage-usestrictsecurity" id="v1-vlstorage-usestrictsecurity">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseStrictSecurity enables strict security mode for component<br />it restricts disk writes access<br />uses non-root user out of the box<br />drops not needed security permissions |
| volumeMounts<a href="#v1-vlstorage-volumemounts" id="v1-vlstorage-volumemounts">#</a><br/>_[VolumeMount (v1)](#v1-volumemount) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VolumeMounts allows configuration of additional VolumeMounts on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />VolumeMounts specified will be appended to other VolumeMounts in the Application container |
| volumes<a href="#v1-vlstorage-volumes" id="v1-vlstorage-volumes">#</a><br/>_[Volume (v1)](#v1-volume) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Volumes allows configuration of additional volumes on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />Volumes specified will be appended to other volumes that are generated. |
| vpa<a href="#v1-vlstorage-vpa" id="v1-vlstorage-vpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedVPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedvpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configures vertical pod autoscaling. |

#### VMAnomalyReadersSpec {#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec}

VMAnomalyReadersSpec defines reader configuration for VMAnomaly

Appears in: [VMAnomalySpec (v1)](#v1-vmanomalyspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| basicAuth<a href="#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-basicauth" id="v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-basicauth">#</a><br/>_[BasicAuth (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-basicauth)_ | _(Required)_<br/>Basic auth defines basic authorization configuration |
| bearer<a href="#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-bearer" id="v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-bearer">#</a><br/>_[BearerAuth (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-bearerauth)_ | _(Required)_<br/>BearerAuth defines authorization with Authorization: Bearer header |
| dataRange<a href="#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-datarange" id="v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-datarange">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Required)_<br/>Optional argumentallows defining valid data ranges for input of all the queries in queries |
| datasourceURL<a href="#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-datasourceurl" id="v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-datasourceurl">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>DatasourceURL address<br />datasource must serve /api/v1/query and /api/v1/query_range APIs |
| extraFilters<a href="#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-extrafilters" id="v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-extrafilters">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Required)_<br/>List of strings with series selector. |
| fetchTimeout<a href="#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-fetchtimeout" id="v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-fetchtimeout">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>FetchTimeout limits each datasource read request. It falls back to timeout when omitted. |
| healthPath<a href="#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-healthpath" id="v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-healthpath">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>HealthPath defines absolute or relative URL address where to check availability of the remote webserver |
| latencyOffset<a href="#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-latencyoffset" id="v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-latencyoffset">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>It allows overriding the default -search.latencyOffsetflag of VictoriaMetrics |
| maxPointsPerQuery<a href="#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-maxpointsperquery" id="v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-maxpointsperquery">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Required)_<br/>Optional argoverrides how search.maxPointsPerTimeseries flagimpacts vmanomaly on splitting long fitWindow queries into smaller sub-intervals |
| offset<a href="#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-offset" id="v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-offset">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Offset adds a time shift to the query window for all queries, e.g. to account for delayed data ingestion |
| processingTimeout<a href="#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-processingtimeout" id="v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-processingtimeout">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProcessingTimeout limits post-fetch preparation for fit and infer stages. It falls back to timeout when omitted. |
| queryFromLastSeenTimestamp<a href="#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-queryfromlastseentimestamp" id="v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-queryfromlastseentimestamp">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>If True, then query will be performed from the last seen timestamp for a given series. |
| queryLastSeenMaxLookback<a href="#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-querylastseenmaxlookback" id="v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-querylastseenmaxlookback">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>QueryLastSeenMaxLookback caps how far last-seen recovery may move a query start into the past. |
| queryRangePath<a href="#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-queryrangepath" id="v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-queryrangepath">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Performs PromQL/MetricsQL range query |
| samplingPeriod<a href="#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-samplingperiod" id="v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-samplingperiod">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Frequency of the points returned |
| seriesProcessingBatchSize<a href="#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-seriesprocessingbatchsize" id="v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-seriesprocessingbatchsize">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SeriesProcessingBatchSize controls how many series are prepared together for fit and infer stages. |
| tenantID<a href="#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-tenantid" id="v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-tenantid">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>TenantID defines for VictoriaMetrics Cluster version only, tenants are identified by accountID, accountID:projectID or multitenant. |
| timeout<a href="#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-timeout" id="v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-timeout">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Timeout for the requests, passed as a string |
| tlsConfig<a href="#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-tlsconfig" id="v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-tlsconfig">#</a><br/>_[TLSConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-tlsconfig)_ | _(Required)_<br/>TLSConfig defines tls connection configuration |
| tz<a href="#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-tz" id="v1-vmanomalyreadersspec-tz">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Optional argument specifies the IANA timezone to account for local shifts, like DST, in models sensitive to seasonal patterns |

| affinity<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-affinity" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-affinity">#</a><br/>_[Affinity (v1)](#v1-affinity)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Affinity If specified, the pod's scheduling constraints. |
