| componentVersion<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-componentversion" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-componentversion">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ComponentVersion defines default images tag for all components.<br />it can be overwritten with component specific image.tag value. |
| configMaps<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-configmaps" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-configmaps">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigMaps is a list of ConfigMaps in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/configs/CONFIGMAP_NAME folder |
| configNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-confignamespaceselector" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-confignamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigNamespaceSelector defines VMAnomalyConfig object namespace selector. |
| configRawYaml<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-configrawyaml" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-configrawyaml">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigRawYaml - raw configuration for anomaly,<br />it helps it to start without secret.<br />priority -> hardcoded ConfigRaw -> ConfigRaw, provided by user -> ConfigSecret. |
| configSecret<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-configsecret" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-configsecret">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigSecret is the name of a Kubernetes Secret in the same namespace as the<br />VMAnomaly object, which contains configuration for this VMAnomaly,<br />configuration must be inside secret key: anomaly.yaml.<br />It must be created by user.<br />instance. Defaults to 'vmanomaly-<anomaly-name>'<br />The secret is mounted into /etc/anomaly/config. |
| configSelector<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-configselector" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-configselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigSelector defines VMAnomalyConfig object selector. |
| containers<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-containers" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-containers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Containers property allows to inject additions sidecars or to patch existing containers.<br />It can be useful for proxies, backup, etc. |
| disableAutomountServiceAccountToken<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableAutomountServiceAccountToken whether to disable serviceAccount auto mount by Kubernetes<br />Operator will conditionally create volumes and volumeMounts for containers if it requires k8s API access.<br />For example, vmagent and vm-config-reloader requires k8s API access.<br />Operator creates volumes with name: "kube-api-access", which can be used as volumeMount for extraContainers if needed.<br />And also adds VolumeMounts at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0540">v0.54.0</a> |
| disableSelfServiceScrape<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-disableselfservicescrape" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-disableselfservicescrape">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableSelfServiceScrape controls creation of VMServiceScrape by operator<br />for the application.<br />Has priority over `VM_DISABLESELFSERVICESCRAPECREATION` operator env variable |
| dnsConfig<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-dnsconfig" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-dnsconfig">#</a><br/>_[PodDNSConfig (v1)](#v1-poddnsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Specifies the DNS parameters of a pod.<br />Parameters specified here will be merged to the generated DNS<br />configuration based on DNSPolicy. |
| dnsPolicy<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-dnspolicy" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-dnspolicy">#</a><br/>_[DNSPolicy (v1)](#v1-dnspolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DNSPolicy sets DNS policy for the pod |
| enableServiceLinks<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-enableservicelinks" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-enableservicelinks">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableServiceLinks indicates whether information about services should be injected into pod's<br />environment variables, matching the syntax of Docker links.<br />Optional: Defaults to true. |
| extraArgs<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-extraargs" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-extraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraArgs that will be passed to the application container<br />for example remoteWrite.tmpDataPath: /tmp |
| extraEnvs<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-extraenvs" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-extraenvs">#</a><br/>_[EnvVar (v1)](#v1-envvar) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvs that will be passed to the application container |
| extraEnvsFrom<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-extraenvsfrom" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-extraenvsfrom">#</a><br/>_[EnvFromSource (v1)](#v1-envfromsource) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvsFrom defines source of env variables for the application container<br />could either be secret or configmap |
| hostAliases<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-hostaliases" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-hostaliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliases provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork. |
| hostNetwork<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-hostnetwork" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-hostnetwork">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostNetwork controls whether the pod may use the node network namespace |
| host_aliases<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-host_aliases" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-host_aliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliasesUnderScore provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork.<br />Has Priority over hostAliases field |
| image<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-image" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-image">#</a><br/>_[Image (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-image)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Image - docker image settings<br />if no specified operator uses default version from operator config |
| imagePullSecrets<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-imagepullsecrets" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-imagepullsecrets">#</a><br/>_[LocalObjectReference (v1)](#v1-localobjectreference) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ImagePullSecrets An optional list of references to secrets in the same namespace<br />to use for pulling images from registries<br />see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images/#specifying-imagepullsecrets-on-a-pod |
| initContainers<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-initcontainers" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-initcontainers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InitContainers allows adding initContainers to the pod definition.<br />Any errors during the execution of an initContainer will lead to a restart of the Pod.<br />More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/ |
| license<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-license" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-license">#</a><br/>_[License (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-license)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>License allows to configure license key to be used for enterprise features.<br />Using license key is supported starting from VictoriaMetrics v1.94.0.<br />See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/enterprise/) |
| livenessProbe<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-livenessprobe" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-livenessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LivenessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| logLevel<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-loglevel" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-loglevel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogLevel for VMAnomaly to be configured with.<br />INFO, WARN, ERROR, FATAL, PANIC |
| managedMetadata<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-managedmetadata" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-managedmetadata">#</a><br/>_[ManagedObjectsMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-managedobjectsmetadata)_ | _(Required)_<br/>ManagedMetadata defines metadata that will be added to the all objects<br />created by operator for the given CustomResource |
| minReadySeconds<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-minreadyseconds" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-minreadyseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MinReadySeconds defines a minimum number of seconds to wait before starting update next pod<br />if previous in healthy state<br />Has no effect for VLogs and VMSingle |
| monitoring<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-monitoring" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-monitoring">#</a><br/>_[VMAnomalyMonitoringSpec (v1)](#v1-vmanomalymonitoringspec)_ | _(Required)_<br/>Monitoring configures how expose anomaly metrics<br />See https://docs.victoriametrics.com/anomaly-detection/components/monitoring/ |
| networkPolicy<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-networkpolicy" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-networkpolicy">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedNetworkPolicy (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddednetworkpolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NetworkPolicy defines network access rules for pods created by this CR. |
| nodeSelector<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-nodeselector" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-nodeselector">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeSelector Define which Nodes the Pods are scheduled on. |
| paused<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-paused" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-paused">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Paused If set to true all actions on the underlying managed objects are not<br />going to be performed, except for delete actions. |
| persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-persistentvolumeclaimretentionpolicy" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-persistentvolumeclaimretentionpolicy">#</a><br/>_[StatefulSetPersistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy (v1)](#v1-statefulsetpersistentvolumeclaimretentionpolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PersistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy allows configuration of PVC retention policy |
| podDisruptionBudget<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-poddisruptionbudget" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-poddisruptionbudget">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedPodDisruptionBudgetSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedpoddisruptionbudgetspec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodDisruptionBudget created by operator |
| podMetadata<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-podmetadata" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-podmetadata">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedObjectMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedobjectmetadata)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodMetadata configures Labels and Annotations which are propagated to the vmanomaly pods. |
| port<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-port" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-port">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Port listen address |
| preStopSleepSeconds<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-prestopsleepseconds" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-prestopsleepseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PreStopSleepSeconds defines the number of seconds to sleep in the preStop lifecycle hook.<br />It gives time for load balancers to remove the pod from rotation before the pod is terminated.<br />Defaults to 15 for applicable components. Set to 0 to disable. |
| priorityClassName<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-priorityclassname" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-priorityclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PriorityClassName class assigned to the Pods |
| reader<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-reader" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-reader">#</a><br/>_[VMAnomalyReadersSpec (v1)](#v1-vmanomalyreadersspec)_ | _(Required)_<br/>Metrics source for VMAnomaly<br />See https://docs.victoriametrics.com/anomaly-detection/components/reader/ |
| readinessGates<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-readinessgates" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-readinessgates">#</a><br/>_[PodReadinessGate (v1)](#v1-podreadinessgate) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>ReadinessGates defines pod readiness gates |
| readinessProbe<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-readinessprobe" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-readinessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReadinessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| replicaCount<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-replicacount" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-replicacount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReplicaCount is the expected size of the Application. |
| resources<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-resources" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-resources">#</a><br/>_[ResourceRequirements (v1)](#v1-resourcerequirements)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Resources container resource request and limits, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/<br />if not defined default resources from operator config will be used |
| revisionHistoryLimitCount<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-revisionhistorylimitcount" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-revisionhistorylimitcount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The number of old ReplicaSets to retain to allow rollback in deployment or<br />maximum number of revisions that will be maintained in the Deployment revision history.<br />Has no effect at StatefulSets<br />Defaults to 10. |
| rollingUpdateStrategy<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-rollingupdatestrategy" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-rollingupdatestrategy">#</a><br/>_[StatefulSetUpdateStrategyType (v1)](#v1-statefulsetupdatestrategytype)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RollingUpdateStrategy allows configuration for strategyType<br />set it to RollingUpdate for disabling operator statefulSet rollingUpdate |
| runtimeClassName<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-runtimeclassname" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-runtimeclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RuntimeClassName - defines runtime class for kubernetes pod.<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/ |
| schedulerName<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-schedulername" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-schedulername">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SchedulerName - defines kubernetes scheduler name |
| secrets<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-secrets" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-secrets">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Secrets is a list of Secrets in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/secrets/SECRET_NAME folder |
| securityContext<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-securitycontext" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-securitycontext">#</a><br/>_[SecurityContext (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-securitycontext)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SecurityContext holds pod-level security attributes and common container settings.<br />This defaults to the default PodSecurityContext. |
| selectAllByDefault<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-selectallbydefault" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-selectallbydefault">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SelectAllByDefault changes default behavior for empty configSelector and configNamespaceSelector.<br />with selectAllByDefault: true and empty object and namespace selectors<br />Operator selects all existing VMAnomalyConfig objects<br />with selectAllByDefault: false - selects nothing |
| server<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-server" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-server">#</a><br/>_[VMAnomalyServerSpec (v1)](#v1-vmanomalyserverspec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Server configures HTTP server for VMAnomaly |
| serviceAccountName<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-serviceaccountname" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-serviceaccountname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceAccountName is the name of the ServiceAccount to use to run the pods |
| serviceScrapeSpec<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-servicescrapespec" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-servicescrapespec">#</a><br/>_[VMServiceScrapeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeSpec that will be added to vmanomaly VMPodScrape spec |
| shardCount<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-shardcount" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-shardcount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ShardCount - numbers of shards of VMAnomaly<br />in this case operator will use 1 sts per shard with<br />replicas count according to spec.replicas. |
| startupProbe<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-startupprobe" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-startupprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StartupProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| storage<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-storage" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-storage">#</a><br/>_[StorageSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-storagespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Storage configures storage for StatefulSet |
| terminationGracePeriodSeconds<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-terminationgraceperiodseconds" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-terminationgraceperiodseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TerminationGracePeriodSeconds period for container graceful termination |
| tolerations<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-tolerations" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-tolerations">#</a><br/>_[Toleration (v1)](#v1-toleration) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Tolerations If specified, the pod's tolerations. |
| topologySpreadConstraints<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-topologyspreadconstraints" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-topologyspreadconstraints">#</a><br/>_[TopologySpreadConstraint (v1)](#v1-topologyspreadconstraint) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TopologySpreadConstraints embedded kubernetes pod configuration option,<br />controls how pods are spread across your cluster among failure-domains<br />such as regions, zones, nodes, and other user-defined topology domains<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/ |
| useDefaultResources<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-usedefaultresources" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-usedefaultresources">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseDefaultResources controls resource settings<br />By default, operator sets built-in resource requirements |
| useLegacyNaming<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-uselegacynaming" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-uselegacynaming">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseLegacyNaming uses standalone Helm chart naming for managed resources:<br />the CR name is used directly instead of the default "<type>-<name>" convention.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0730">v0.73.0</a> |
| useStrictSecurity<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-usestrictsecurity" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-usestrictsecurity">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseStrictSecurity enables strict security mode for component<br />it restricts disk writes access<br />uses non-root user out of the box<br />drops not needed security permissions |
| volumeMounts<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-volumemounts" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-volumemounts">#</a><br/>_[VolumeMount (v1)](#v1-volumemount) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VolumeMounts allows configuration of additional VolumeMounts on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />VolumeMounts specified will be appended to other VolumeMounts in the Application container |
| volumes<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-volumes" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-volumes">#</a><br/>_[Volume (v1)](#v1-volume) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Volumes allows configuration of additional volumes on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />Volumes specified will be appended to other volumes that are generated. |
| vpa<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-vpa" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-vpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedVPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedvpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VPA defines configuration for the VerticalPodAutoscaler. |
| writer<a href="#v1-vmanomalyspec-writer" id="v1-vmanomalyspec-writer">#</a><br/>_[VMAnomalyWritersSpec (v1)](#v1-vmanomalywritersspec)_ | _(Required)_<br/>Metrics destination for VMAnomaly<br />See https://docs.victoriametrics.com/anomaly-detection/components/writer/ |

#### VMAnomalyVMWriterMetricFormatSpec {#v1-vmanomalyvmwritermetricformatspec}

VMAnomalyVMWriterMetricFormatSpec defines the desired state of VMAnomalyVMWriterMetricFormat

Appears in: [VMAnomalyWritersSpec (v1)](#v1-vmanomalywritersspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| __name__<a href="#v1-vmanomalyvmwritermetricformatspec-__name__" id="v1-vmanomalyvmwritermetricformatspec-__name__">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Name of result metric<br />Must have a value with $VAR placeholder in it to distinguish between resulting metrics |
| extraLabels<a href="#v1-vmanomalyvmwritermetricformatspec-extralabels" id="v1-vmanomalyvmwritermetricformatspec-extralabels">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Required)_<br/>ExtraLabels defines additional labels to be added to the resulting metrics |
| for<a href="#v1-vmanomalyvmwritermetricformatspec-for" id="v1-vmanomalyvmwritermetricformatspec-for">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>For is a special label with $QUERY_KEY placeholder |

#### VMAnomalyWritersSpec {#v1-vmanomalywritersspec}

VMAnomalyWritersSpec defines writer configuration for VMAnomaly

Appears in: [VMAnomalySpec (v1)](#v1-vmanomalyspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| basicAuth<a href="#v1-vmanomalywritersspec-basicauth" id="v1-vmanomalywritersspec-basicauth">#</a><br/>_[BasicAuth (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-basicauth)_ | _(Required)_<br/>Basic auth defines basic authorization configuration |
| bearer<a href="#v1-vmanomalywritersspec-bearer" id="v1-vmanomalywritersspec-bearer">#</a><br/>_[BearerAuth (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-bearerauth)_ | _(Required)_<br/>BearerAuth defines authorization with Authorization: Bearer header |
| connectionRetryAttempts<a href="#v1-vmanomalywritersspec-connectionretryattempts" id="v1-vmanomalywritersspec-connectionretryattempts">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConnectionRetryAttempts defines the number of attempts to retry the connection in case of failure |
| datasourceURL<a href="#v1-vmanomalywritersspec-datasourceurl" id="v1-vmanomalywritersspec-datasourceurl">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>DatasourceURL defines remote write url for write requests<br />provided endpoint must serve /api/v1/import path<br />vmanomaly joins datasourceURL + "/api/v1/import" |
| healthPath<a href="#v1-vmanomalywritersspec-healthpath" id="v1-vmanomalywritersspec-healthpath">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>HealthPath defines absolute or relative URL address where to check availability of the remote webserver |
| metricFormat<a href="#v1-vmanomalywritersspec-metricformat" id="v1-vmanomalywritersspec-metricformat">#</a><br/>_[VMAnomalyVMWriterMetricFormatSpec (v1)](#v1-vmanomalyvmwritermetricformatspec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Metrics to save the output (in metric names or labels) |
| tenantID<a href="#v1-vmanomalywritersspec-tenantid" id="v1-vmanomalywritersspec-tenantid">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>TenantID defines for VictoriaMetrics Cluster version only, tenants are identified by accountID, accountID:projectID or multitenant. |
| timeout<a href="#v1-vmanomalywritersspec-timeout" id="v1-vmanomalywritersspec-timeout">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Timeout for the requests, passed as a string |
| tlsConfig<a href="#v1-vmanomalywritersspec-tlsconfig" id="v1-vmanomalywritersspec-tlsconfig">#</a><br/>_[TLSConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-tlsconfig)_ | _(Required)_<br/>TLSConfig defines tls connection configuration |

| managedMetadata<a href="#v1-vtclusterspec-managedmetadata" id="v1-vtclusterspec-managedmetadata">#</a><br/>_[ManagedObjectsMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-managedobjectsmetadata)_ | _(Required)_<br/>ManagedMetadata defines metadata that will be added to the all objects<br />created by operator for the given CustomResource |
| paused<a href="#v1-vtclusterspec-paused" id="v1-vtclusterspec-paused">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Paused If set to true all actions on the underlying managed objects are not<br />going to be performed, except for delete actions. |
| requestsLoadBalancer<a href="#v1-vtclusterspec-requestsloadbalancer" id="v1-vtclusterspec-requestsloadbalancer">#</a><br/>_[VMAuthLoadBalancer (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancer)_ | _(Required)_<br/>RequestsLoadBalancer configures load-balancing for vtinsert and vtselect requests.<br />It helps to evenly spread load across pods.<br />Usually it's not possible with Kubernetes TCP-based services. |
| select<a href="#v1-vtclusterspec-select" id="v1-vtclusterspec-select">#</a><br/>_[VTSelect (v1)](#v1-vtselect)_ | _(Required)_<br/> |
| serviceAccountName<a href="#v1-vtclusterspec-serviceaccountname" id="v1-vtclusterspec-serviceaccountname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceAccountName is the name of the ServiceAccount to use to run the<br />VTSelect, VTInsert and VTStorage Pods. |
| storage<a href="#v1-vtclusterspec-storage" id="v1-vtclusterspec-storage">#</a><br/>_[VTStorage (v1)](#v1-vtstorage)_ | _(Required)_<br/> |
| useLegacyNaming<a href="#v1-vtclusterspec-uselegacynaming" id="v1-vtclusterspec-uselegacynaming">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseLegacyNaming switches component resource naming from the default prefix convention<br />(<component>-<name>, e.g. "vtselect-myapp") to a suffix convention (<name>-<component>,<br />e.g. "myapp-vtselect"). Useful when migrating from standalone Helm charts.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0730">v0.73.0</a> |
| useStrictSecurity<a href="#v1-vtclusterspec-usestrictsecurity" id="v1-vtclusterspec-usestrictsecurity">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseStrictSecurity enables strict security mode for component<br />it restricts disk writes access<br />uses non-root user out of the box<br />drops not needed security permissions |

#### VTInsert {#v1-vtinsert}

VTInsert defines vtinsert component configuration at victoria-traces cluster

Appears in: [VTClusterSpec (v1)](#v1-vtclusterspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| affinity<a href="#v1-vtinsert-affinity" id="v1-vtinsert-affinity">#</a><br/>_[Affinity (v1)](#v1-affinity)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Affinity If specified, the pod's scheduling constraints. |
| componentVersion<a href="#v1-vtinsert-componentversion" id="v1-vtinsert-componentversion">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ComponentVersion defines default images tag for this component.<br />it can be overwritten with component specific image.tag value. |
| configMaps<a href="#v1-vtinsert-configmaps" id="v1-vtinsert-configmaps">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigMaps is a list of ConfigMaps in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/configs/CONFIGMAP_NAME folder |
| containers<a href="#v1-vtinsert-containers" id="v1-vtinsert-containers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Containers property allows to inject additions sidecars or to patch existing containers.<br />It can be useful for proxies, backup, etc. |
| disableAutomountServiceAccountToken<a href="#v1-vtinsert-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken" id="v1-vtinsert-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableAutomountServiceAccountToken whether to disable serviceAccount auto mount by Kubernetes<br />Operator will conditionally create volumes and volumeMounts for containers if it requires k8s API access.<br />For example, vmagent and vm-config-reloader requires k8s API access.<br />Operator creates volumes with name: "kube-api-access", which can be used as volumeMount for extraContainers if needed.<br />And also adds VolumeMounts at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0540">v0.54.0</a> |
| disableSelfServiceScrape<a href="#v1-vtinsert-disableselfservicescrape" id="v1-vtinsert-disableselfservicescrape">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableSelfServiceScrape controls creation of VMServiceScrape by operator<br />for the application.<br />Has priority over `VM_DISABLESELFSERVICESCRAPECREATION` operator env variable |
| dnsConfig<a href="#v1-vtinsert-dnsconfig" id="v1-vtinsert-dnsconfig">#</a><br/>_[PodDNSConfig (v1)](#v1-poddnsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Specifies the DNS parameters of a pod.<br />Parameters specified here will be merged to the generated DNS<br />configuration based on DNSPolicy. |
| dnsPolicy<a href="#v1-vtinsert-dnspolicy" id="v1-vtinsert-dnspolicy">#</a><br/>_[DNSPolicy (v1)](#v1-dnspolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DNSPolicy sets DNS policy for the pod |
| enableServiceLinks<a href="#v1-vtinsert-enableservicelinks" id="v1-vtinsert-enableservicelinks">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableServiceLinks indicates whether information about services should be injected into pod's<br />environment variables, matching the syntax of Docker links.<br />Optional: Defaults to true. |
| extraArgs<a href="#v1-vtinsert-extraargs" id="v1-vtinsert-extraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraArgs that will be passed to the application container<br />for example remoteWrite.tmpDataPath: /tmp |
| extraEnvs<a href="#v1-vtinsert-extraenvs" id="v1-vtinsert-extraenvs">#</a><br/>_[EnvVar (v1)](#v1-envvar) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvs that will be passed to the application container |
| extraEnvsFrom<a href="#v1-vtinsert-extraenvsfrom" id="v1-vtinsert-extraenvsfrom">#</a><br/>_[EnvFromSource (v1)](#v1-envfromsource) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvsFrom defines source of env variables for the application container<br />could either be secret or configmap |
| hostAliases<a href="#v1-vtinsert-hostaliases" id="v1-vtinsert-hostaliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliases provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork. |
| hostNetwork<a href="#v1-vtinsert-hostnetwork" id="v1-vtinsert-hostnetwork">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostNetwork controls whether the pod may use the node network namespace |
| host_aliases<a href="#v1-vtinsert-host_aliases" id="v1-vtinsert-host_aliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliasesUnderScore provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork.<br />Has Priority over hostAliases field |
| hpa<a href="#v1-vtinsert-hpa" id="v1-vtinsert-hpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedHPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedhpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configures horizontal pod autoscaling. |
| image<a href="#v1-vtinsert-image" id="v1-vtinsert-image">#</a><br/>_[Image (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-image)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Image - docker image settings<br />if no specified operator uses default version from operator config |
| imagePullSecrets<a href="#v1-vtinsert-imagepullsecrets" id="v1-vtinsert-imagepullsecrets">#</a><br/>_[LocalObjectReference (v1)](#v1-localobjectreference) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ImagePullSecrets An optional list of references to secrets in the same namespace<br />to use for pulling images from registries<br />see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images/#specifying-imagepullsecrets-on-a-pod |
| initContainers<a href="#v1-vtinsert-initcontainers" id="v1-vtinsert-initcontainers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InitContainers allows adding initContainers to the pod definition.<br />Any errors during the execution of an initContainer will lead to a restart of the Pod.<br />More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/ |
| livenessProbe<a href="#v1-vtinsert-livenessprobe" id="v1-vtinsert-livenessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LivenessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| logFormat<a href="#v1-vtinsert-logformat" id="v1-vtinsert-logformat">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogFormat for VTInsert to be configured with.<br />default or json |
| logLevel<a href="#v1-vtinsert-loglevel" id="v1-vtinsert-loglevel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogLevel for VTInsert to be configured with. |
| minReadySeconds<a href="#v1-vtinsert-minreadyseconds" id="v1-vtinsert-minreadyseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MinReadySeconds defines a minimum number of seconds to wait before starting update next pod<br />if previous in healthy state<br />Has no effect for VLogs and VMSingle |
| networkPolicy<a href="#v1-vtinsert-networkpolicy" id="v1-vtinsert-networkpolicy">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedNetworkPolicy (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddednetworkpolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NetworkPolicy defines network access rules for pods created by this CR. |
| nodeSelector<a href="#v1-vtinsert-nodeselector" id="v1-vtinsert-nodeselector">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeSelector Define which Nodes the Pods are scheduled on. |
| paused<a href="#v1-vtinsert-paused" id="v1-vtinsert-paused">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Paused If set to true all actions on the underlying managed objects are not<br />going to be performed, except for delete actions. |
| podDisruptionBudget<a href="#v1-vtinsert-poddisruptionbudget" id="v1-vtinsert-poddisruptionbudget">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedPodDisruptionBudgetSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedpoddisruptionbudgetspec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodDisruptionBudget created by operator |
| podMetadata<a href="#v1-vtinsert-podmetadata" id="v1-vtinsert-podmetadata">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedObjectMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedobjectmetadata)_ | _(Required)_<br/>PodMetadata configures Labels and Annotations which are propagated to the VTInsert pods. |
| port<a href="#v1-vtinsert-port" id="v1-vtinsert-port">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Port listen address |
| preStopSleepSeconds<a href="#v1-vtinsert-prestopsleepseconds" id="v1-vtinsert-prestopsleepseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PreStopSleepSeconds defines the number of seconds to sleep in the preStop lifecycle hook.<br />It gives time for load balancers to remove the pod from rotation before the pod is terminated.<br />Defaults to 15 for applicable components. Set to 0 to disable. |
| priorityClassName<a href="#v1-vtinsert-priorityclassname" id="v1-vtinsert-priorityclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PriorityClassName class assigned to the Pods |
| readinessGates<a href="#v1-vtinsert-readinessgates" id="v1-vtinsert-readinessgates">#</a><br/>_[PodReadinessGate (v1)](#v1-podreadinessgate) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>ReadinessGates defines pod readiness gates |
| readinessProbe<a href="#v1-vtinsert-readinessprobe" id="v1-vtinsert-readinessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReadinessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| replicaCount<a href="#v1-vtinsert-replicacount" id="v1-vtinsert-replicacount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReplicaCount is the expected size of the Application. |
| resources<a href="#v1-vtinsert-resources" id="v1-vtinsert-resources">#</a><br/>_[ResourceRequirements (v1)](#v1-resourcerequirements)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Resources container resource request and limits, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/<br />if not defined default resources from operator config will be used |
| revisionHistoryLimitCount<a href="#v1-vtinsert-revisionhistorylimitcount" id="v1-vtinsert-revisionhistorylimitcount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The number of old ReplicaSets to retain to allow rollback in deployment or<br />maximum number of revisions that will be maintained in the Deployment revision history.<br />Has no effect at StatefulSets<br />Defaults to 10. |
| rollingUpdate<a href="#v1-vtinsert-rollingupdate" id="v1-vtinsert-rollingupdate">#</a><br/>_[RollingUpdateDeployment (v1)](#v1-rollingupdatedeployment)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RollingUpdate - overrides deployment update params. |
| runtimeClassName<a href="#v1-vtinsert-runtimeclassname" id="v1-vtinsert-runtimeclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RuntimeClassName - defines runtime class for kubernetes pod.<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/ |
| schedulerName<a href="#v1-vtinsert-schedulername" id="v1-vtinsert-schedulername">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SchedulerName - defines kubernetes scheduler name |
| secrets<a href="#v1-vtinsert-secrets" id="v1-vtinsert-secrets">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Secrets is a list of Secrets in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/secrets/SECRET_NAME folder |
| securityContext<a href="#v1-vtinsert-securitycontext" id="v1-vtinsert-securitycontext">#</a><br/>_[SecurityContext (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-securitycontext)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SecurityContext holds pod-level security attributes and common container settings.<br />This defaults to the default PodSecurityContext. |
| serviceScrapeSpec<a href="#v1-vtinsert-servicescrapespec" id="v1-vtinsert-servicescrapespec">#</a><br/>_[VMServiceScrapeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeSpec that will be added to vtinsert VMServiceScrape spec |
| serviceSpec<a href="#v1-vtinsert-servicespec" id="v1-vtinsert-servicespec">#</a><br/>_[AdditionalServiceSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-additionalservicespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceSpec that will be added to vtinsert service spec |
| startupProbe<a href="#v1-vtinsert-startupprobe" id="v1-vtinsert-startupprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StartupProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| terminationGracePeriodSeconds<a href="#v1-vtinsert-terminationgraceperiodseconds" id="v1-vtinsert-terminationgraceperiodseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TerminationGracePeriodSeconds period for container graceful termination |
| tolerations<a href="#v1-vtinsert-tolerations" id="v1-vtinsert-tolerations">#</a><br/>_[Toleration (v1)](#v1-toleration) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Tolerations If specified, the pod's tolerations. |
| topologySpreadConstraints<a href="#v1-vtinsert-topologyspreadconstraints" id="v1-vtinsert-topologyspreadconstraints">#</a><br/>_[TopologySpreadConstraint (v1)](#v1-topologyspreadconstraint) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TopologySpreadConstraints embedded kubernetes pod configuration option,<br />controls how pods are spread across your cluster among failure-domains<br />such as regions, zones, nodes, and other user-defined topology domains<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/ |
| updateStrategy<a href="#v1-vtinsert-updatestrategy" id="v1-vtinsert-updatestrategy">#</a><br/>_[DeploymentStrategyType (v1)](#v1-deploymentstrategytype)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UpdateStrategy - overrides default update strategy. |
| useDefaultResources<a href="#v1-vtinsert-usedefaultresources" id="v1-vtinsert-usedefaultresources">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseDefaultResources controls resource settings<br />By default, operator sets built-in resource requirements |
| useStrictSecurity<a href="#v1-vtinsert-usestrictsecurity" id="v1-vtinsert-usestrictsecurity">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseStrictSecurity enables strict security mode for component<br />it restricts disk writes access<br />uses non-root user out of the box<br />drops not needed security permissions |
| volumeMounts<a href="#v1-vtinsert-volumemounts" id="v1-vtinsert-volumemounts">#</a><br/>_[VolumeMount (v1)](#v1-volumemount) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VolumeMounts allows configuration of additional VolumeMounts on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />VolumeMounts specified will be appended to other VolumeMounts in the Application container |
| volumes<a href="#v1-vtinsert-volumes" id="v1-vtinsert-volumes">#</a><br/>_[Volume (v1)](#v1-volume) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Volumes allows configuration of additional volumes on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />Volumes specified will be appended to other volumes that are generated. |
| vpa<a href="#v1-vtinsert-vpa" id="v1-vtinsert-vpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedVPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedvpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configures vertical pod autoscaling. |

| readinessProbe<a href="#v1-vtselect-readinessprobe" id="v1-vtselect-readinessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReadinessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| replicaCount<a href="#v1-vtselect-replicacount" id="v1-vtselect-replicacount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReplicaCount is the expected size of the Application. |
| resources<a href="#v1-vtselect-resources" id="v1-vtselect-resources">#</a><br/>_[ResourceRequirements (v1)](#v1-resourcerequirements)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Resources container resource request and limits, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/<br />if not defined default resources from operator config will be used |
| revisionHistoryLimitCount<a href="#v1-vtselect-revisionhistorylimitcount" id="v1-vtselect-revisionhistorylimitcount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The number of old ReplicaSets to retain to allow rollback in deployment or<br />maximum number of revisions that will be maintained in the Deployment revision history.<br />Has no effect at StatefulSets<br />Defaults to 10. |
| rollingUpdate<a href="#v1-vtselect-rollingupdate" id="v1-vtselect-rollingupdate">#</a><br/>_[RollingUpdateDeployment (v1)](#v1-rollingupdatedeployment)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RollingUpdate - overrides deployment update params. |
| runtimeClassName<a href="#v1-vtselect-runtimeclassname" id="v1-vtselect-runtimeclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RuntimeClassName - defines runtime class for kubernetes pod.<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/ |
| schedulerName<a href="#v1-vtselect-schedulername" id="v1-vtselect-schedulername">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SchedulerName - defines kubernetes scheduler name |
| secrets<a href="#v1-vtselect-secrets" id="v1-vtselect-secrets">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Secrets is a list of Secrets in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/secrets/SECRET_NAME folder |
| securityContext<a href="#v1-vtselect-securitycontext" id="v1-vtselect-securitycontext">#</a><br/>_[SecurityContext (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-securitycontext)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SecurityContext holds pod-level security attributes and common container settings.<br />This defaults to the default PodSecurityContext. |
| serviceScrapeSpec<a href="#v1-vtselect-servicescrapespec" id="v1-vtselect-servicescrapespec">#</a><br/>_[VMServiceScrapeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeSpec that will be added to vtselect VMServiceScrape spec |
| serviceSpec<a href="#v1-vtselect-servicespec" id="v1-vtselect-servicespec">#</a><br/>_[AdditionalServiceSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-additionalservicespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceSpec that will be added to vtselect service spec |
| startupProbe<a href="#v1-vtselect-startupprobe" id="v1-vtselect-startupprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StartupProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| terminationGracePeriodSeconds<a href="#v1-vtselect-terminationgraceperiodseconds" id="v1-vtselect-terminationgraceperiodseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TerminationGracePeriodSeconds period for container graceful termination |
| tolerations<a href="#v1-vtselect-tolerations" id="v1-vtselect-tolerations">#</a><br/>_[Toleration (v1)](#v1-toleration) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Tolerations If specified, the pod's tolerations. |
| topologySpreadConstraints<a href="#v1-vtselect-topologyspreadconstraints" id="v1-vtselect-topologyspreadconstraints">#</a><br/>_[TopologySpreadConstraint (v1)](#v1-topologyspreadconstraint) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TopologySpreadConstraints embedded kubernetes pod configuration option,<br />controls how pods are spread across your cluster among failure-domains<br />such as regions, zones, nodes, and other user-defined topology domains<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/ |
| updateStrategy<a href="#v1-vtselect-updatestrategy" id="v1-vtselect-updatestrategy">#</a><br/>_[DeploymentStrategyType (v1)](#v1-deploymentstrategytype)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UpdateStrategy - overrides default update strategy. |
| useDefaultResources<a href="#v1-vtselect-usedefaultresources" id="v1-vtselect-usedefaultresources">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseDefaultResources controls resource settings<br />By default, operator sets built-in resource requirements |
| useStrictSecurity<a href="#v1-vtselect-usestrictsecurity" id="v1-vtselect-usestrictsecurity">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseStrictSecurity enables strict security mode for component<br />it restricts disk writes access<br />uses non-root user out of the box<br />drops not needed security permissions |
| volumeMounts<a href="#v1-vtselect-volumemounts" id="v1-vtselect-volumemounts">#</a><br/>_[VolumeMount (v1)](#v1-volumemount) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VolumeMounts allows configuration of additional VolumeMounts on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />VolumeMounts specified will be appended to other VolumeMounts in the Application container |
| volumes<a href="#v1-vtselect-volumes" id="v1-vtselect-volumes">#</a><br/>_[Volume (v1)](#v1-volume) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Volumes allows configuration of additional volumes on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />Volumes specified will be appended to other volumes that are generated. |
| vpa<a href="#v1-vtselect-vpa" id="v1-vtselect-vpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedVPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedvpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configures vertical pod autoscaling. |

#### VTSingle {#v1-vtsingle}

VTSingle is fast, cost-effective and scalable traces database.
VTSingle is the Schema for the API

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| apiVersion<br/>_string_ | (Required)<br/>`operator.victoriametrics.com/v1` |
| kind<br/>_string_ | (Required)<br/>`VTSingle` |
| metadata<a href="#v1-vtsingle-metadata" id="v1-vtsingle-metadata">#</a><br/>_[ObjectMeta (v1)](#v1-objectmeta)_ | _(Required)_<br/>Refer to Kubernetes API documentation for fields of `metadata`. |
| spec<a href="#v1-vtsingle-spec" id="v1-vtsingle-spec">#</a><br/>_[VTSingleSpec (v1)](#v1-vtsinglespec)_ | _(Required)_<br/> |

#### VTSingleSpec {#v1-vtsinglespec}

VTSingleSpec defines the desired state of VTSingle

Appears in: [VTSingle (v1)](#v1-vtsingle)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| affinity<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-affinity" id="v1-vtsinglespec-affinity">#</a><br/>_[Affinity (v1)](#v1-affinity)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Affinity If specified, the pod's scheduling constraints. |
| componentVersion<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-componentversion" id="v1-vtsinglespec-componentversion">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ComponentVersion defines default images tag for all components.<br />it can be overwritten with component specific image.tag value. |
| configMaps<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-configmaps" id="v1-vtsinglespec-configmaps">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigMaps is a list of ConfigMaps in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/configs/CONFIGMAP_NAME folder |
| containers<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-containers" id="v1-vtsinglespec-containers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Containers property allows to inject additions sidecars or to patch existing containers.<br />It can be useful for proxies, backup, etc. |
| disableAutomountServiceAccountToken<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken" id="v1-vtsinglespec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableAutomountServiceAccountToken whether to disable serviceAccount auto mount by Kubernetes<br />Operator will conditionally create volumes and volumeMounts for containers if it requires k8s API access.<br />For example, vmagent and vm-config-reloader requires k8s API access.<br />Operator creates volumes with name: "kube-api-access", which can be used as volumeMount for extraContainers if needed.<br />And also adds VolumeMounts at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0540">v0.54.0</a> |
| disableSelfServiceScrape<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-disableselfservicescrape" id="v1-vtsinglespec-disableselfservicescrape">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableSelfServiceScrape controls creation of VMServiceScrape by operator<br />for the application.<br />Has priority over `VM_DISABLESELFSERVICESCRAPECREATION` operator env variable |
| dnsConfig<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-dnsconfig" id="v1-vtsinglespec-dnsconfig">#</a><br/>_[PodDNSConfig (v1)](#v1-poddnsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Specifies the DNS parameters of a pod.<br />Parameters specified here will be merged to the generated DNS<br />configuration based on DNSPolicy. |
| dnsPolicy<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-dnspolicy" id="v1-vtsinglespec-dnspolicy">#</a><br/>_[DNSPolicy (v1)](#v1-dnspolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DNSPolicy sets DNS policy for the pod |
| enableServiceLinks<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-enableservicelinks" id="v1-vtsinglespec-enableservicelinks">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableServiceLinks indicates whether information about services should be injected into pod's<br />environment variables, matching the syntax of Docker links.<br />Optional: Defaults to true. |
| extraArgs<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-extraargs" id="v1-vtsinglespec-extraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraArgs that will be passed to the application container<br />for example remoteWrite.tmpDataPath: /tmp |
| extraEnvs<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-extraenvs" id="v1-vtsinglespec-extraenvs">#</a><br/>_[EnvVar (v1)](#v1-envvar) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvs that will be passed to the application container |
| extraEnvsFrom<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-extraenvsfrom" id="v1-vtsinglespec-extraenvsfrom">#</a><br/>_[EnvFromSource (v1)](#v1-envfromsource) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvsFrom defines source of env variables for the application container<br />could either be secret or configmap |
| futureRetention<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-futureretention" id="v1-vtsinglespec-futureretention">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>FutureRetention for the stored traces<br />Log entries with timestamps bigger than now+futureRetention are rejected during data ingestion;<br />see https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriatraces/#configure-victoriatraces |
| hostAliases<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-hostaliases" id="v1-vtsinglespec-hostaliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliases provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork. |
| hostNetwork<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-hostnetwork" id="v1-vtsinglespec-hostnetwork">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostNetwork controls whether the pod may use the node network namespace |
| host_aliases<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-host_aliases" id="v1-vtsinglespec-host_aliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliasesUnderScore provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork.<br />Has Priority over hostAliases field |
| image<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-image" id="v1-vtsinglespec-image">#</a><br/>_[Image (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-image)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Image - docker image settings<br />if no specified operator uses default version from operator config |
| imagePullSecrets<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-imagepullsecrets" id="v1-vtsinglespec-imagepullsecrets">#</a><br/>_[LocalObjectReference (v1)](#v1-localobjectreference) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ImagePullSecrets An optional list of references to secrets in the same namespace<br />to use for pulling images from registries<br />see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images/#specifying-imagepullsecrets-on-a-pod |
| initContainers<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-initcontainers" id="v1-vtsinglespec-initcontainers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InitContainers allows adding initContainers to the pod definition.<br />Any errors during the execution of an initContainer will lead to a restart of the Pod.<br />More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/ |
| livenessProbe<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-livenessprobe" id="v1-vtsinglespec-livenessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LivenessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| logFormat<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-logformat" id="v1-vtsinglespec-logformat">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogFormat for VTSingle to be configured with. |
| logIngestedRows<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-logingestedrows" id="v1-vtsinglespec-logingestedrows">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>Whether to log all the ingested log entries; this can be useful for debugging of data ingestion;<br />see https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriatraces/#configure-victoriatraces |
| logLevel<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-loglevel" id="v1-vtsinglespec-loglevel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogLevel for VictoriaTraces to be configured with. |
| logNewStreams<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-lognewstreams" id="v1-vtsinglespec-lognewstreams">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>LogNewStreams Whether to log creation of new streams; this can be useful for debugging of high cardinality issues with log streams;<br />see https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriatraces/#configure-victoriatraces |
| managedMetadata<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-managedmetadata" id="v1-vtsinglespec-managedmetadata">#</a><br/>_[ManagedObjectsMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-managedobjectsmetadata)_ | _(Required)_<br/>ManagedMetadata defines metadata that will be added to the all objects<br />created by operator for the given CustomResource |
| minReadySeconds<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-minreadyseconds" id="v1-vtsinglespec-minreadyseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MinReadySeconds defines a minimum number of seconds to wait before starting update next pod<br />if previous in healthy state<br />Has no effect for VLogs and VMSingle |
| networkPolicy<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-networkpolicy" id="v1-vtsinglespec-networkpolicy">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedNetworkPolicy (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddednetworkpolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NetworkPolicy defines network access rules for pods created by this CR. |
| nodeSelector<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-nodeselector" id="v1-vtsinglespec-nodeselector">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeSelector Define which Nodes the Pods are scheduled on. |
| paused<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-paused" id="v1-vtsinglespec-paused">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Paused If set to true all actions on the underlying managed objects are not<br />going to be performed, except for delete actions. |
| podMetadata<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-podmetadata" id="v1-vtsinglespec-podmetadata">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedObjectMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedobjectmetadata)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodMetadata configures Labels and Annotations which are propagated to the VTSingle pods. |
| port<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-port" id="v1-vtsinglespec-port">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Port listen address |
| preStopSleepSeconds<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-prestopsleepseconds" id="v1-vtsinglespec-prestopsleepseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PreStopSleepSeconds defines the number of seconds to sleep in the preStop lifecycle hook.<br />It gives time for load balancers to remove the pod from rotation before the pod is terminated.<br />Defaults to 15 for applicable components. Set to 0 to disable. |
| priorityClassName<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-priorityclassname" id="v1-vtsinglespec-priorityclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PriorityClassName class assigned to the Pods |
| readinessGates<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-readinessgates" id="v1-vtsinglespec-readinessgates">#</a><br/>_[PodReadinessGate (v1)](#v1-podreadinessgate) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>ReadinessGates defines pod readiness gates |
| readinessProbe<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-readinessprobe" id="v1-vtsinglespec-readinessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReadinessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| replicaCount<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-replicacount" id="v1-vtsinglespec-replicacount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReplicaCount is the expected size of the Application. |
| resources<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-resources" id="v1-vtsinglespec-resources">#</a><br/>_[ResourceRequirements (v1)](#v1-resourcerequirements)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Resources container resource request and limits, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/<br />if not defined default resources from operator config will be used |
| retentionMaxDiskSpaceUsageBytes<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-retentionmaxdiskspaceusagebytes" id="v1-vtsinglespec-retentionmaxdiskspaceusagebytes">#</a><br/>_[BytesString (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-bytesstring)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RetentionMaxDiskSpaceUsageBytes for the stored traces<br />VictoriaTraces keeps at least two last days of data in order to guarantee that the traces for the last day can be returned in queries.<br />This means that the total disk space usage may exceed the -retention.maxDiskSpaceUsageBytes,<br />if the size of the last two days of data exceeds the -retention.maxDiskSpaceUsageBytes.<br />https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriatraces/#configure-victoriatraces |
| retentionPeriod<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-retentionperiod" id="v1-vtsinglespec-retentionperiod">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RetentionPeriod for the stored traces<br />https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriatraces/#configure-victoriatraces |
| revisionHistoryLimitCount<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-revisionhistorylimitcount" id="v1-vtsinglespec-revisionhistorylimitcount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The number of old ReplicaSets to retain to allow rollback in deployment or<br />maximum number of revisions that will be maintained in the Deployment revision history.<br />Has no effect at StatefulSets<br />Defaults to 10. |
| runtimeClassName<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-runtimeclassname" id="v1-vtsinglespec-runtimeclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RuntimeClassName - defines runtime class for kubernetes pod.<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/ |
| schedulerName<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-schedulername" id="v1-vtsinglespec-schedulername">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SchedulerName - defines kubernetes scheduler name |
| secrets<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-secrets" id="v1-vtsinglespec-secrets">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Secrets is a list of Secrets in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/secrets/SECRET_NAME folder |
| securityContext<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-securitycontext" id="v1-vtsinglespec-securitycontext">#</a><br/>_[SecurityContext (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-securitycontext)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SecurityContext holds pod-level security attributes and common container settings.<br />This defaults to the default PodSecurityContext. |
| serviceAccountName<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-serviceaccountname" id="v1-vtsinglespec-serviceaccountname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceAccountName is the name of the ServiceAccount to use to run the pods |
| serviceScrapeSpec<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-servicescrapespec" id="v1-vtsinglespec-servicescrapespec">#</a><br/>_[VMServiceScrapeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeSpec that will be added to vtsingle VMServiceScrape spec |
| serviceSpec<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-servicespec" id="v1-vtsinglespec-servicespec">#</a><br/>_[AdditionalServiceSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-additionalservicespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceSpec that will be added to vtsingle service spec |
| startupProbe<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-startupprobe" id="v1-vtsinglespec-startupprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StartupProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| storage<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-storage" id="v1-vtsinglespec-storage">#</a><br/>_[PersistentVolumeClaimSpec (v1)](#v1-persistentvolumeclaimspec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Storage is the definition of how storage will be used by the VTSingle<br />by default it`s empty dir |
| storageDataPath<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-storagedatapath" id="v1-vtsinglespec-storagedatapath">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StorageDataPath disables spec.storage option and overrides arg for victoria-traces binary --storageDataPath,<br />its users responsibility to mount proper device into given path. |
| storageMetadata<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-storagemetadata" id="v1-vtsinglespec-storagemetadata">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedObjectMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedobjectmetadata)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StorageMeta defines annotations and labels attached to PVC for given vtsingle CR |
| terminationGracePeriodSeconds<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-terminationgraceperiodseconds" id="v1-vtsinglespec-terminationgraceperiodseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TerminationGracePeriodSeconds period for container graceful termination |
| tolerations<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-tolerations" id="v1-vtsinglespec-tolerations">#</a><br/>_[Toleration (v1)](#v1-toleration) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Tolerations If specified, the pod's tolerations. |
| topologySpreadConstraints<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-topologyspreadconstraints" id="v1-vtsinglespec-topologyspreadconstraints">#</a><br/>_[TopologySpreadConstraint (v1)](#v1-topologyspreadconstraint) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TopologySpreadConstraints embedded kubernetes pod configuration option,<br />controls how pods are spread across your cluster among failure-domains<br />such as regions, zones, nodes, and other user-defined topology domains<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/ |

| useStrictSecurity<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-usestrictsecurity" id="v1-vtsinglespec-usestrictsecurity">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseStrictSecurity enables strict security mode for component<br />it restricts disk writes access<br />uses non-root user out of the box<br />drops not needed security permissions |
| volumeMounts<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-volumemounts" id="v1-vtsinglespec-volumemounts">#</a><br/>_[VolumeMount (v1)](#v1-volumemount) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VolumeMounts allows configuration of additional VolumeMounts on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />VolumeMounts specified will be appended to other VolumeMounts in the Application container |
| volumes<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-volumes" id="v1-vtsinglespec-volumes">#</a><br/>_[Volume (v1)](#v1-volume) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Volumes allows configuration of additional volumes on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />Volumes specified will be appended to other volumes that are generated. |
| vpa<a href="#v1-vtsinglespec-vpa" id="v1-vtsinglespec-vpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedVPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedvpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configures vertical pod autoscaling. |

#### VTStorage {#v1-vtstorage}

VTStorage defines vtstorage component configuration at victoria-traces cluster
