| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| affinity<a href="#v1-vtstorage-affinity" id="v1-vtstorage-affinity">#</a><br/>_[Affinity (v1)](#v1-affinity)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Affinity If specified, the pod's scheduling constraints. |
| claimTemplates<a href="#v1-vtstorage-claimtemplates" id="v1-vtstorage-claimtemplates">#</a><br/>_[PersistentVolumeClaim (v1)](#v1-persistentvolumeclaim) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>ClaimTemplates allows adding additional VolumeClaimTemplates for StatefulSet |
| componentVersion<a href="#v1-vtstorage-componentversion" id="v1-vtstorage-componentversion">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ComponentVersion defines default images tag for this component.<br />it can be overwritten with component specific image.tag value. |
| configMaps<a href="#v1-vtstorage-configmaps" id="v1-vtstorage-configmaps">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigMaps is a list of ConfigMaps in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/configs/CONFIGMAP_NAME folder |
| containers<a href="#v1-vtstorage-containers" id="v1-vtstorage-containers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Containers property allows to inject additions sidecars or to patch existing containers.<br />It can be useful for proxies, backup, etc. |
| disableAutomountServiceAccountToken<a href="#v1-vtstorage-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken" id="v1-vtstorage-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableAutomountServiceAccountToken whether to disable serviceAccount auto mount by Kubernetes<br />Operator will conditionally create volumes and volumeMounts for containers if it requires k8s API access.<br />For example, vmagent and vm-config-reloader requires k8s API access.<br />Operator creates volumes with name: "kube-api-access", which can be used as volumeMount for extraContainers if needed.<br />And also adds VolumeMounts at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0540">v0.54.0</a> |
| disableSelfServiceScrape<a href="#v1-vtstorage-disableselfservicescrape" id="v1-vtstorage-disableselfservicescrape">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableSelfServiceScrape controls creation of VMServiceScrape by operator<br />for the application.<br />Has priority over `VM_DISABLESELFSERVICESCRAPECREATION` operator env variable |
| dnsConfig<a href="#v1-vtstorage-dnsconfig" id="v1-vtstorage-dnsconfig">#</a><br/>_[PodDNSConfig (v1)](#v1-poddnsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Specifies the DNS parameters of a pod.<br />Parameters specified here will be merged to the generated DNS<br />configuration based on DNSPolicy. |
| dnsPolicy<a href="#v1-vtstorage-dnspolicy" id="v1-vtstorage-dnspolicy">#</a><br/>_[DNSPolicy (v1)](#v1-dnspolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DNSPolicy sets DNS policy for the pod |
| enableServiceLinks<a href="#v1-vtstorage-enableservicelinks" id="v1-vtstorage-enableservicelinks">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableServiceLinks indicates whether information about services should be injected into pod's<br />environment variables, matching the syntax of Docker links.<br />Optional: Defaults to true. |
| extraArgs<a href="#v1-vtstorage-extraargs" id="v1-vtstorage-extraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraArgs that will be passed to the application container<br />for example remoteWrite.tmpDataPath: /tmp |
| extraEnvs<a href="#v1-vtstorage-extraenvs" id="v1-vtstorage-extraenvs">#</a><br/>_[EnvVar (v1)](#v1-envvar) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvs that will be passed to the application container |
| extraEnvsFrom<a href="#v1-vtstorage-extraenvsfrom" id="v1-vtstorage-extraenvsfrom">#</a><br/>_[EnvFromSource (v1)](#v1-envfromsource) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvsFrom defines source of env variables for the application container<br />could either be secret or configmap |
| futureRetention<a href="#v1-vtstorage-futureretention" id="v1-vtstorage-futureretention">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>FutureRetention for the stored traces<br />Log entries with timestamps bigger than now+futureRetention are rejected during data ingestion<br />see https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriatraces/#configure-victoriatraces |
| hostAliases<a href="#v1-vtstorage-hostaliases" id="v1-vtstorage-hostaliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliases provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork. |
| hostNetwork<a href="#v1-vtstorage-hostnetwork" id="v1-vtstorage-hostnetwork">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostNetwork controls whether the pod may use the node network namespace |
| host_aliases<a href="#v1-vtstorage-host_aliases" id="v1-vtstorage-host_aliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliasesUnderScore provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork.<br />Has Priority over hostAliases field |
| hpa<a href="#v1-vtstorage-hpa" id="v1-vtstorage-hpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedHPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedhpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configures horizontal pod autoscaling.<br />Note, downscaling is not supported. |
| image<a href="#v1-vtstorage-image" id="v1-vtstorage-image">#</a><br/>_[Image (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-image)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Image - docker image settings<br />if no specified operator uses default version from operator config |
| imagePullSecrets<a href="#v1-vtstorage-imagepullsecrets" id="v1-vtstorage-imagepullsecrets">#</a><br/>_[LocalObjectReference (v1)](#v1-localobjectreference) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ImagePullSecrets An optional list of references to secrets in the same namespace<br />to use for pulling images from registries<br />see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images/#specifying-imagepullsecrets-on-a-pod |
| initContainers<a href="#v1-vtstorage-initcontainers" id="v1-vtstorage-initcontainers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InitContainers allows adding initContainers to the pod definition.<br />Any errors during the execution of an initContainer will lead to a restart of the Pod.<br />More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/ |
| livenessProbe<a href="#v1-vtstorage-livenessprobe" id="v1-vtstorage-livenessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LivenessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| logFormat<a href="#v1-vtstorage-logformat" id="v1-vtstorage-logformat">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogFormat for VTStorage to be configured with.<br />default or json |
| logIngestedRows<a href="#v1-vtstorage-logingestedrows" id="v1-vtstorage-logingestedrows">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>Whether to log all the ingested log entries; this can be useful for debugging of data ingestion<br />see https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriatraces/#configure-victoriatraces |
| logLevel<a href="#v1-vtstorage-loglevel" id="v1-vtstorage-loglevel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogLevel for VTStorage to be configured with. |
| logNewStreams<a href="#v1-vtstorage-lognewstreams" id="v1-vtstorage-lognewstreams">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>LogNewStreams Whether to log creation of new streams; this can be useful for debugging of high cardinality issues with log streams<br />see https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriatraces/#configure-victoriatraces |
| maintenanceInsertNodeIDs<a href="#v1-vtstorage-maintenanceinsertnodeids" id="v1-vtstorage-maintenanceinsertnodeids">#</a><br/>_integer array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MaintenanceInsertNodeIDs - excludes given node ids from insert requests routing, must contain pod suffixes - for pod-0, id will be 0 and etc.<br />lets say, you have pod-0, pod-1, pod-2, pod-3. to exclude pod-0 and pod-3 from insert routing, define nodeIDs: [0,3].<br />Useful at storage expanding, when you want to rebalance some data at cluster. |
| maintenanceSelectNodeIDs<a href="#v1-vtstorage-maintenanceselectnodeids" id="v1-vtstorage-maintenanceselectnodeids">#</a><br/>_integer array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MaintenanceSelectNodeIDs - excludes given node ids from select requests routing, must contain pod suffixes - for pod-0, id will be 0 and etc. |
| minReadySeconds<a href="#v1-vtstorage-minreadyseconds" id="v1-vtstorage-minreadyseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MinReadySeconds defines a minimum number of seconds to wait before starting update next pod<br />if previous in healthy state<br />Has no effect for VLogs and VMSingle |
| networkPolicy<a href="#v1-vtstorage-networkpolicy" id="v1-vtstorage-networkpolicy">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedNetworkPolicy (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddednetworkpolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NetworkPolicy defines network access rules for pods created by this CR. |
| nodeSelector<a href="#v1-vtstorage-nodeselector" id="v1-vtstorage-nodeselector">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeSelector Define which Nodes the Pods are scheduled on. |
| paused<a href="#v1-vtstorage-paused" id="v1-vtstorage-paused">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Paused If set to true all actions on the underlying managed objects are not<br />going to be performed, except for delete actions. |
| persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy<a href="#v1-vtstorage-persistentvolumeclaimretentionpolicy" id="v1-vtstorage-persistentvolumeclaimretentionpolicy">#</a><br/>_[StatefulSetPersistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy (v1)](#v1-statefulsetpersistentvolumeclaimretentionpolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PersistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy allows configuration of PVC retention policy |
| podDisruptionBudget<a href="#v1-vtstorage-poddisruptionbudget" id="v1-vtstorage-poddisruptionbudget">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedPodDisruptionBudgetSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedpoddisruptionbudgetspec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodDisruptionBudget created by operator |
| podMetadata<a href="#v1-vtstorage-podmetadata" id="v1-vtstorage-podmetadata">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedObjectMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedobjectmetadata)_ | _(Required)_<br/>PodMetadata configures Labels and Annotations which are propagated to the VTStorage pods. |
| port<a href="#v1-vtstorage-port" id="v1-vtstorage-port">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Port listen address |
| preStopSleepSeconds<a href="#v1-vtstorage-prestopsleepseconds" id="v1-vtstorage-prestopsleepseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PreStopSleepSeconds defines the number of seconds to sleep in the preStop lifecycle hook.<br />It gives time for load balancers to remove the pod from rotation before the pod is terminated.<br />Defaults to 15 for applicable components. Set to 0 to disable. |
| priorityClassName<a href="#v1-vtstorage-priorityclassname" id="v1-vtstorage-priorityclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PriorityClassName class assigned to the Pods |
| readinessGates<a href="#v1-vtstorage-readinessgates" id="v1-vtstorage-readinessgates">#</a><br/>_[PodReadinessGate (v1)](#v1-podreadinessgate) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>ReadinessGates defines pod readiness gates |
| readinessProbe<a href="#v1-vtstorage-readinessprobe" id="v1-vtstorage-readinessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReadinessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| replicaCount<a href="#v1-vtstorage-replicacount" id="v1-vtstorage-replicacount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReplicaCount is the expected size of the Application. |
| resources<a href="#v1-vtstorage-resources" id="v1-vtstorage-resources">#</a><br/>_[ResourceRequirements (v1)](#v1-resourcerequirements)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Resources container resource request and limits, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/<br />if not defined default resources from operator config will be used |
| retentionMaxDiskSpaceUsageBytes<a href="#v1-vtstorage-retentionmaxdiskspaceusagebytes" id="v1-vtstorage-retentionmaxdiskspaceusagebytes">#</a><br/>_[BytesString (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-bytesstring)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RetentionMaxDiskSpaceUsageBytes for the stored traces<br />VictoriaTraces keeps at least two last days of data in order to guarantee that the traces for the last day can be returned in queries.<br />This means that the total disk space usage may exceed the -retention.maxDiskSpaceUsageBytes,<br />if the size of the last two days of data exceeds the -retention.maxDiskSpaceUsageBytes.<br />https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriatraces/#configure-victoriatraces |
| retentionPeriod<a href="#v1-vtstorage-retentionperiod" id="v1-vtstorage-retentionperiod">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RetentionPeriod for the stored traces<br />https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriatraces/#configure-victoriatraces |
| revisionHistoryLimitCount<a href="#v1-vtstorage-revisionhistorylimitcount" id="v1-vtstorage-revisionhistorylimitcount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The number of old ReplicaSets to retain to allow rollback in deployment or<br />maximum number of revisions that will be maintained in the Deployment revision history.<br />Has no effect at StatefulSets<br />Defaults to 10. |
| rollingUpdateStrategy<a href="#v1-vtstorage-rollingupdatestrategy" id="v1-vtstorage-rollingupdatestrategy">#</a><br/>_[StatefulSetUpdateStrategyType (v1)](#v1-statefulsetupdatestrategytype)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RollingUpdateStrategy defines strategy for application updates<br />Default is OnDelete, in this case operator handles update process<br />Can be changed for RollingUpdate |
| rollingUpdateStrategyBehavior<a href="#v1-vtstorage-rollingupdatestrategybehavior" id="v1-vtstorage-rollingupdatestrategybehavior">#</a><br/>_[StatefulSetUpdateStrategyBehavior (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-statefulsetupdatestrategybehavior)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RollingUpdateStrategyBehavior defines customized behavior for rolling updates.<br />It applies if the RollingUpdateStrategy is set to OnDelete, which is the default. |
| runtimeClassName<a href="#v1-vtstorage-runtimeclassname" id="v1-vtstorage-runtimeclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RuntimeClassName - defines runtime class for kubernetes pod.<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/ |
| schedulerName<a href="#v1-vtstorage-schedulername" id="v1-vtstorage-schedulername">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SchedulerName - defines kubernetes scheduler name |
| secrets<a href="#v1-vtstorage-secrets" id="v1-vtstorage-secrets">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Secrets is a list of Secrets in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/secrets/SECRET_NAME folder |
| securityContext<a href="#v1-vtstorage-securitycontext" id="v1-vtstorage-securitycontext">#</a><br/>_[SecurityContext (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-securitycontext)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SecurityContext holds pod-level security attributes and common container settings.<br />This defaults to the default PodSecurityContext. |
| serviceScrapeSpec<a href="#v1-vtstorage-servicescrapespec" id="v1-vtstorage-servicescrapespec">#</a><br/>_[VMServiceScrapeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeSpec that will be added to vtstorage VMServiceScrape spec |
| serviceSpec<a href="#v1-vtstorage-servicespec" id="v1-vtstorage-servicespec">#</a><br/>_[AdditionalServiceSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-additionalservicespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceSpec that will be added to vtstorage service spec |
| startupProbe<a href="#v1-vtstorage-startupprobe" id="v1-vtstorage-startupprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StartupProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| storage<a href="#v1-vtstorage-storage" id="v1-vtstorage-storage">#</a><br/>_[StorageSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-storagespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Storage configures persistent volume for VTStorage |
| storageDataPath<a href="#v1-vtstorage-storagedatapath" id="v1-vtstorage-storagedatapath">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StorageDataPath - path to storage data |
| terminationGracePeriodSeconds<a href="#v1-vtstorage-terminationgraceperiodseconds" id="v1-vtstorage-terminationgraceperiodseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TerminationGracePeriodSeconds period for container graceful termination |
| tolerations<a href="#v1-vtstorage-tolerations" id="v1-vtstorage-tolerations">#</a><br/>_[Toleration (v1)](#v1-toleration) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Tolerations If specified, the pod's tolerations. |
| topologySpreadConstraints<a href="#v1-vtstorage-topologyspreadconstraints" id="v1-vtstorage-topologyspreadconstraints">#</a><br/>_[TopologySpreadConstraint (v1)](#v1-topologyspreadconstraint) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TopologySpreadConstraints embedded kubernetes pod configuration option,<br />controls how pods are spread across your cluster among failure-domains<br />such as regions, zones, nodes, and other user-defined topology domains<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/ |
| useDefaultResources<a href="#v1-vtstorage-usedefaultresources" id="v1-vtstorage-usedefaultresources">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseDefaultResources controls resource settings<br />By default, operator sets built-in resource requirements |
| useStrictSecurity<a href="#v1-vtstorage-usestrictsecurity" id="v1-vtstorage-usestrictsecurity">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseStrictSecurity enables strict security mode for component<br />it restricts disk writes access<br />uses non-root user out of the box<br />drops not needed security permissions |
| volumeMounts<a href="#v1-vtstorage-volumemounts" id="v1-vtstorage-volumemounts">#</a><br/>_[VolumeMount (v1)](#v1-volumemount) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VolumeMounts allows configuration of additional VolumeMounts on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />VolumeMounts specified will be appended to other VolumeMounts in the Application container |
| volumes<a href="#v1-vtstorage-volumes" id="v1-vtstorage-volumes">#</a><br/>_[Volume (v1)](#v1-volume) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Volumes allows configuration of additional volumes on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />Volumes specified will be appended to other volumes that are generated. |
| vpa<a href="#v1-vtstorage-vpa" id="v1-vtstorage-vpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedVPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedvpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configures vertical pod autoscaling. |

#### VLDistributedSpec {#v1alpha1-vldistributedspec}

VLDistributedSpec defines configurable parameters for VLDistributed CR

Appears in: [VLDistributed (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vldistributed)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| backendType<a href="#v1alpha1-vldistributedspec-backendtype" id="v1alpha1-vldistributedspec-backendtype">#</a><br/>_[VLDistributedBackendType (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vldistributedbackendtype)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>BackendType defines the storage backend type used across all zones.<br />VLCluster uses a distributed VLCluster per zone; VLSingle uses a single-node VLSingle per zone.<br />All zones must use the same backend type; mixed configurations are not supported. |
| license<a href="#v1alpha1-vldistributedspec-license" id="v1alpha1-vldistributedspec-license">#</a><br/>_[License (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-license)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>License configures license key for enterprise features. If not nil, it will be passed to VLAgent and VLClusters. |
| paused<a href="#v1alpha1-vldistributedspec-paused" id="v1alpha1-vldistributedspec-paused">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Paused If set to true all actions on the underlying managed objects are not<br />going to be performed, except for delete actions. |
| retain<a href="#v1alpha1-vldistributedspec-retain" id="v1alpha1-vldistributedspec-retain">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Retain keeps resources in case of VLDistributed removal |
| vmauth<a href="#v1alpha1-vldistributedspec-vmauth" id="v1alpha1-vldistributedspec-vmauth">#</a><br/>_[VLDistributedAuth (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vldistributedauth)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VMAuth is a VMAuth definition (name + optional spec) that acts as a proxy for the VMUsers created by the operator.<br />Use an inline spec to define a VMAuth object in-place or provide a name to reference an existing VMAuth. |
| zoneCommon<a href="#v1alpha1-vldistributedspec-zonecommon" id="v1alpha1-vldistributedspec-zonecommon">#</a><br/>_[VLDistributedZoneCommon (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vldistributedzonecommon)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ZoneCommon defines common properties for all zones |
| zones<a href="#v1alpha1-vldistributedspec-zones" id="v1alpha1-vldistributedspec-zones">#</a><br/>_[VLDistributedZone (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vldistributedzone) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>Zones is a list of zones to update. Each item in the list represents a "zone" within the distributed setup. |

#### VLDistributedZoneAgentSpec {#v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec}

VLDistributedZoneAgentSpec is a customized specification of a new VLAgent.
It includes selected options from the original VLAgentSpec.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| affinity<a href="#v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec-affinity" id="v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec-affinity">#</a><br/>_[Affinity (v1)](#v1-affinity)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Affinity If specified, the pod's scheduling constraints. |
| claimTemplates<a href="#v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec-claimtemplates" id="v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec-claimtemplates">#</a><br/>_[PersistentVolumeClaim (v1)](#v1-persistentvolumeclaim) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>ClaimTemplates allows adding additional VolumeClaimTemplates for VLAgent in StatefulSet mode |
| configMaps<a href="#v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec-configmaps" id="v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec-configmaps">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigMaps is a list of ConfigMaps in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/configs/CONFIGMAP_NAME folder |
| containers<a href="#v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec-containers" id="v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec-containers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Containers property allows to inject additions sidecars or to patch existing containers.<br />It can be useful for proxies, backup, etc. |
| disableAutomountServiceAccountToken<a href="#v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken" id="v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableAutomountServiceAccountToken whether to disable serviceAccount auto mount by Kubernetes<br />Operator will conditionally create volumes and volumeMounts for containers if it requires k8s API access.<br />For example, vmagent and vm-config-reloader requires k8s API access.<br />Operator creates volumes with name: "kube-api-access", which can be used as volumeMount for extraContainers if needed.<br />And also adds VolumeMounts at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0540">v0.54.0</a> |
| disableSelfServiceScrape<a href="#v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec-disableselfservicescrape" id="v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec-disableselfservicescrape">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableSelfServiceScrape controls creation of VMServiceScrape by operator<br />for the application.<br />Has priority over `VM_DISABLESELFSERVICESCRAPECREATION` operator env variable |
| dnsConfig<a href="#v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec-dnsconfig" id="v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec-dnsconfig">#</a><br/>_[PodDNSConfig (v1)](#v1-poddnsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Specifies the DNS parameters of a pod.<br />Parameters specified here will be merged to the generated DNS<br />configuration based on DNSPolicy. |
| dnsPolicy<a href="#v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec-dnspolicy" id="v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec-dnspolicy">#</a><br/>_[DNSPolicy (v1)](#v1-dnspolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DNSPolicy sets DNS policy for the pod |
| enableServiceLinks<a href="#v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec-enableservicelinks" id="v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec-enableservicelinks">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableServiceLinks indicates whether information about services should be injected into pod's<br />environment variables, matching the syntax of Docker links.<br />Optional: Defaults to true. |
| extraArgs<a href="#v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec-extraargs" id="v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec-extraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraArgs that will be passed to the application container<br />for example remoteWrite.tmpDataPath: /tmp |

#### VMDistributedBackendType {#v1alpha1-vmdistributedbackendtype}

_Underlying type:_ _string_

VMDistributedBackendType defines the storage backend type for all zones.

#### VMDistributedSpec {#v1alpha1-vmdistributedspec}

VMDistributedSpec defines configurable parameters for VMDistributed CR

Appears in: [VMDistributed (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vmdistributed)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| backendType<a href="#v1alpha1-vmdistributedspec-backendtype" id="v1alpha1-vmdistributedspec-backendtype">#</a><br/>_[VMDistributedBackendType (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vmdistributedbackendtype)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>BackendType defines the storage backend type used across all zones.<br />VMCluster uses a distributed VMCluster per zone; VMSingle uses a single-node VMSingle per zone.<br />All zones must use the same backend type; mixed configurations are not supported. |
| license<a href="#v1alpha1-vmdistributedspec-license" id="v1alpha1-vmdistributedspec-license">#</a><br/>_[License (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-license)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>License configures license key for enterprise features. If not nil, it will be passed to VMAgent, VMAuth and VMClusters. |
| paused<a href="#v1alpha1-vmdistributedspec-paused" id="v1alpha1-vmdistributedspec-paused">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Paused If set to true all actions on the underlying managed objects are not<br />going to be performed, except for delete actions. |
| retain<a href="#v1alpha1-vmdistributedspec-retain" id="v1alpha1-vmdistributedspec-retain">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Retain keeps resources in case of VMDistributed removal |
| vmauth<a href="#v1alpha1-vmdistributedspec-vmauth" id="v1alpha1-vmdistributedspec-vmauth">#</a><br/>_[VMDistributedAuth (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vmdistributedauth)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VMAuth is a VMAuth definition (name + optional spec) that acts as a proxy for the VMUsers created by the operator.<br />Use an inline spec to define a VMAuth object in-place or provide a name to reference an existing VMAuth. |
| zoneCommon<a href="#v1alpha1-vmdistributedspec-zonecommon" id="v1alpha1-vmdistributedspec-zonecommon">#</a><br/>_[VMDistributedZoneCommon (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vmdistributedzonecommon)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ZoneCommon defines common properties for all zones |
| zones<a href="#v1alpha1-vmdistributedspec-zones" id="v1alpha1-vmdistributedspec-zones">#</a><br/>_[VMDistributedZone (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vmdistributedzone) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>Zones is a list of zones to update. Each item in the list represents a "zone" within the distributed setup. |

| disableSelfServiceScrape<a href="#v1alpha1-vmdistributedzoneagentspec-disableselfservicescrape" id="v1alpha1-vmdistributedzoneagentspec-disableselfservicescrape">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableSelfServiceScrape controls creation of VMServiceScrape by operator<br />for the application.<br />Has priority over `VM_DISABLESELFSERVICESCRAPECREATION` operator env variable |
| dnsConfig<a href="#v1alpha1-vmdistributedzoneagentspec-dnsconfig" id="v1alpha1-vmdistributedzoneagentspec-dnsconfig">#</a><br/>_[PodDNSConfig (v1)](#v1-poddnsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Specifies the DNS parameters of a pod.<br />Parameters specified here will be merged to the generated DNS<br />configuration based on DNSPolicy. |

| extraArgs<a href="#v1alpha1-vmdistributedzoneagentspec-extraargs" id="v1alpha1-vmdistributedzoneagentspec-extraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraArgs that will be passed to the application container<br />for example remoteWrite.tmpDataPath: /tmp |

Set to 0 to disable. |

#### AdditionalServiceSpec {#v1beta1-additionalservicespec}

ServiceSpec defines additional service for CRD with user-defined params.
by default, some of fields can be inherited from default service definition for the CRD:
labels,selector, ports.
if metadata.name is not defined, service will have format {{CRD_TYPE}}-{{CRD_NAME}}-additional-service.
if UseAsDefault is set to true, changes applied to the main service without additional service creation

#### ArbitraryFSAccessThroughSMsConfig {#v1beta1-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsmsconfig}

ArbitraryFSAccessThroughSMsConfig enables users to configure, whether
a service scrape selected by the vmagent instance is allowed to use
arbitrary files on the file system of the vmagent container. This is the case
when e.g. a service scrape specifies a BearerTokenFile in an endpoint. A
malicious user could create a service scrape selecting arbitrary secret files
in the vmagent container. Those secrets would then be sent with a scrape
request by vmagent to a malicious target. Denying the above would prevent the
attack, users can instead use the BearerTokenSecret field.

Appears in: [CommonScrapeParams (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams), [CommonScrapeSecurityEnforcements (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-commonscrapesecurityenforcements), [VMAgentSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmagentspec), [VMAlertmanagerSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec), [VMAuthSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmauthspec), [VMSingleSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmsinglespec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| deny<a href="#v1beta1-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsmsconfig-deny" id="v1beta1-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsmsconfig-deny">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/> |

Note that using this feature may expose the possibility to<br />break upgrades of VMAgent or VMSingle. It is advised to review VMAgent or VMSingle release<br />notes to ensure that no incompatible scrape configs are going to break<br />VMAgent or VMSingle after the upgrade. |
| arbitraryFSAccessThroughSMs<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsms" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsms">#</a><br/>_[ArbitraryFSAccessThroughSMsConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsmsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ArbitraryFSAccessThroughSMs configures whether configuration<br />based on EndpointAuth can access arbitrary files on the file system<br />of the VMAgent or VMSingle container e.g. bearer token files, basic auth, tls certs |
| enableKubernetesAPISelectors<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-enablekubernetesapiselectors" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-enablekubernetesapiselectors">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableKubernetesAPISelectors instructs vmagent or vmsingle to use CRD scrape objects spec.selectors for<br />Kubernetes API list and watch requests.<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/#list-and-watch-filtering<br />It could be useful to reduce Kubernetes API server resource usage for serving less than 100 CRD scrape objects in total. |
| enforcedNamespaceLabel<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-enforcednamespacelabel" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-enforcednamespacelabel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnforcedNamespaceLabel enforces adding a namespace label of origin for each alert<br />and metric that is user created. The label value will always be the namespace of the object that is<br />being created. |
| externalLabelName<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-externallabelname" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-externallabelname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExternalLabelName Name of external label used to denote scraping agent instance<br />name. Defaults to the value of `prometheus`. External label will<br />_not_ be added when value is set to empty string (`""`). |
| externalLabels<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-externallabels" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-externallabels">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExternalLabels The labels to add to any time series scraped by vmagent or vmsingle.<br />it doesn't affect metrics ingested directly by push API's |
| globalScrapeMetricRelabelConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-globalscrapemetricrelabelconfigs" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-globalscrapemetricrelabelconfigs">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>GlobalScrapeMetricRelabelConfigs is a global metric relabel configuration, which is applied to each scrape job. |
| globalScrapeRelabelConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-globalscraperelabelconfigs" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-globalscraperelabelconfigs">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>GlobalScrapeRelabelConfigs is a global relabel configuration, which is applied to each samples of each scrape job during service discovery. |
| ignoreNamespaceSelectors<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-ignorenamespaceselectors" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-ignorenamespaceselectors">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>IgnoreNamespaceSelectors if set to true will ignore NamespaceSelector settings from<br />scrape objects, and they will only discover endpoints<br />within their current namespace. Defaults to false. |
| ingestOnlyMode<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-ingestonlymode" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-ingestonlymode">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>IngestOnlyMode switches vmagent or vmsingle into unmanaged mode<br />it disables any config generation for scraping<br />Currently it prevents vmagent or vmsingle from managing tls and auth options for remote write |
| inlineScrapeConfig<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-inlinescrapeconfig" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-inlinescrapeconfig">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InlineScrapeConfig As scrape configs are appended, the user is responsible to make sure it<br />is valid. Note that using this feature may expose the possibility to<br />break upgrades of VMAgent or VMSingle. It is advised to review VMAgent or VMSingle release<br />notes to ensure that no incompatible scrape configs are going to break<br />VMAgent or VMSingle after the upgrade.<br />it should be defined as single yaml file.<br />inlineScrapeConfig: \|<br />    - job_name: "prometheus"<br />      static_configs:<br />      - targets: ["localhost:9090"] |
| maxScrapeInterval<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-maxscrapeinterval" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-maxscrapeinterval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>MaxScrapeInterval allows limiting maximum scrape interval for VMServiceScrape, VMPodScrape and other scrapes<br />If interval is higher than defined limit, `maxScrapeInterval` will be used. |
| minScrapeInterval<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-minscrapeinterval" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-minscrapeinterval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>MinScrapeInterval allows limiting minimal scrape interval for VMServiceScrape, VMPodScrape and other scrapes<br />If interval is lower than defined limit, `minScrapeInterval` will be used. |
| nodeScrapeNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-nodescrapenamespaceselector" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-nodescrapenamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeScrapeNamespaceSelector defines Namespaces to be selected for VMNodeScrape discovery.<br />Works in combination with Selector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| nodeScrapeRelabelTemplate<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-nodescraperelabeltemplate" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-nodescraperelabeltemplate">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeScrapeRelabelTemplate defines relabel config, that will be added to each VMNodeScrape.<br />it's useful for adding specific labels to all targets |
| nodeScrapeSelector<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-nodescrapeselector" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-nodescrapeselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeScrapeSelector defines VMNodeScrape to be selected for scraping.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| overrideHonorLabels<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-overridehonorlabels" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-overridehonorlabels">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OverrideHonorLabels if set to true overrides all user configured honor_labels.<br />If HonorLabels is set in scrape objects to true, this overrides honor_labels to false. |
| overrideHonorTimestamps<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-overridehonortimestamps" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-overridehonortimestamps">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OverrideHonorTimestamps allows to globally enforce honoring timestamps in all scrape configs. |
| podScrapeNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-podscrapenamespaceselector" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-podscrapenamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodScrapeNamespaceSelector defines Namespaces to be selected for VMPodScrape discovery.<br />Works in combination with Selector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| podScrapeRelabelTemplate<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-podscraperelabeltemplate" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-podscraperelabeltemplate">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodScrapeRelabelTemplate defines relabel config, that will be added to each VMPodScrape.<br />it's useful for adding specific labels to all targets |
| podScrapeSelector<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-podscrapeselector" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-podscrapeselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodScrapeSelector defines PodScrapes to be selected for target discovery.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| probeNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-probenamespaceselector" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-probenamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProbeNamespaceSelector defines Namespaces to be selected for VMProbe discovery.<br />Works in combination with Selector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| probeScrapeRelabelTemplate<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-probescraperelabeltemplate" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-probescraperelabeltemplate">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProbeScrapeRelabelTemplate defines relabel config, that will be added to each VMProbeScrape.<br />it's useful for adding specific labels to all targets |
| probeSelector<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-probeselector" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-probeselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProbeSelector defines VMProbe to be selected for target probing.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| sampleLimit<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-samplelimit" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-samplelimit">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SampleLimit defines global per target limit of scraped samples |
| scrapeClasses<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-scrapeclasses" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-scrapeclasses">#</a><br/>_[ScrapeClass (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-scrapeclass) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeClasses defines the list of scrape classes to expose to scraping objects such as<br />PodScrapes, ServiceScrapes, Probes and ScrapeConfigs. |
| scrapeConfigNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-scrapeconfignamespaceselector" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-scrapeconfignamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeConfigNamespaceSelector defines Namespaces to be selected for VMScrapeConfig discovery.<br />Works in combination with Selector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| scrapeConfigRelabelTemplate<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-scrapeconfigrelabeltemplate" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-scrapeconfigrelabeltemplate">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeConfigRelabelTemplate defines relabel config, that will be added to each VMScrapeConfig.<br />it's useful for adding specific labels to all targets |
| scrapeConfigSelector<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-scrapeconfigselector" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-scrapeconfigselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeConfigSelector defines VMScrapeConfig to be selected for target discovery.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector. |
| scrapeInterval<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-scrapeinterval" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-scrapeinterval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeInterval defines how often scrape targets by default |
| scrapeTimeout<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-scrapetimeout" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-scrapetimeout">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeTimeout defines global timeout for targets scrape |
| selectAllByDefault<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-selectallbydefault" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-selectallbydefault">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SelectAllByDefault changes default behavior for empty CRD selectors, such ServiceScrapeSelector.<br />with selectAllByDefault: true and empty serviceScrapeSelector and ServiceScrapeNamespaceSelector<br />Operator selects all exist serviceScrapes<br />with selectAllByDefault: false - selects nothing |
| serviceScrapeNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-servicescrapenamespaceselector" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-servicescrapenamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeNamespaceSelector Namespaces to be selected for VMServiceScrape discovery.<br />Works in combination with Selector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| serviceScrapeRelabelTemplate<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-servicescraperelabeltemplate" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-servicescraperelabeltemplate">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeRelabelTemplate defines relabel config, that will be added to each VMServiceScrape.<br />it's useful for adding specific labels to all targets |
| serviceScrapeSelector<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-servicescrapeselector" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-servicescrapeselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeSelector defines ServiceScrapes to be selected for target discovery.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| staticScrapeNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-staticscrapenamespaceselector" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-staticscrapenamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StaticScrapeNamespaceSelector defines Namespaces to be selected for VMStaticScrape discovery.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| staticScrapeRelabelTemplate<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-staticscraperelabeltemplate" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-staticscraperelabeltemplate">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StaticScrapeRelabelTemplate defines relabel config, that will be added to each VMStaticScrape.<br />it's useful for adding specific labels to all targets |
| staticScrapeSelector<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-staticscrapeselector" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-staticscrapeselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StaticScrapeSelector defines VMStaticScrape to be selected for target discovery.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />If both nil - match everything.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces. |
| vmAgentExternalLabelName<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-vmagentexternallabelname" id="v1beta1-commonscrapeparams-vmagentexternallabelname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VMAgentExternalLabelName Name of vmAgent external label used to denote vmAgent instance<br />name. Defaults to the value of `prometheus`. External label will<br />_not_ be added when value is set to empty string (`""`).<br/><b>Deprecated: </b>since version <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0670">v0.67.0</a> will be removed in <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0690">v0.69.0</a> use <a href="#commonscrapeparams-externallabelname">externalLabelName</a> instead<br/> |

| arbitraryFSAccessThroughSMs<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapesecurityenforcements-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsms" id="v1beta1-commonscrapesecurityenforcements-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsms">#</a><br/>_[ArbitraryFSAccessThroughSMsConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsmsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ArbitraryFSAccessThroughSMs configures whether configuration<br />based on EndpointAuth can access arbitrary files on the file system<br />of the VMAgent or VMSingle container e.g. bearer token files, basic auth, tls certs |

The label value will always be the namespace of the object that is<br />being created. |
| ignoreNamespaceSelectors<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapesecurityenforcements-ignorenamespaceselectors" id="v1beta1-commonscrapesecurityenforcements-ignorenamespaceselectors">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>IgnoreNamespaceSelectors if set to true will ignore NamespaceSelector settings from<br />scrape objects, and they will only discover endpoints<br />within their current namespace. Defaults to false. |

| overrideHonorTimestamps<a href="#v1beta1-commonscrapesecurityenforcements-overridehonortimestamps" id="v1beta1-commonscrapesecurityenforcements-overridehonortimestamps">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OverrideHonorTimestamps allows to globally enforce honoring timestamps in all scrape configs. |

| name<a href="#v1beta1-configmapkeyreference-name" id="v1beta1-configmapkeyreference-name">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Name of the referent.<br />This field is effectively required, but due to backwards compatibility is<br />allowed to be empty. Instances of this type with an empty value here are<br />almost certainly wrong.<br />More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names |

#### ConsulAgentSDConfig {#v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig}

ConsulAgentSDConfig configurations allows retrieving scrape targets from a local Consul Agent.
See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/sd_configs/#consulagent_sd_configs)

Appears in: [VMScrapeConfigSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| authorization<a href="#v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-authorization" id="v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-authorization">#</a><br/>_[Authorization (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-authorization)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Authorization header to use on every scrape request. |
| basicAuth<a href="#v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-basicauth" id="v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-basicauth">#</a><br/>_[BasicAuth (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-basicauth)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>BasicAuth information to use on every scrape request. |
| datacenter<a href="#v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-datacenter" id="v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-datacenter">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Consul Datacenter name, if not provided it will use the local Consul Agent Datacenter. |
| filter<a href="#v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-filter" id="v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-filter">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Filter defines filter for service discovery requests.<br />See https://developer.hashicorp.com/consul/api-docs/features/filtering |
| followRedirects<a href="#v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-followredirects" id="v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-followredirects">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configure whether HTTP requests follow HTTP 3xx redirects. |
| namespace<a href="#v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-namespace" id="v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-namespace">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Namespaces are only supported in Consul Enterprise. |
| oauth2<a href="#v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-oauth2" id="v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-oauth2">#</a><br/>_[OAuth2 (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-oauth2)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OAuth2 defines auth configuration |
| proxyURL<a href="#v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-proxyurl" id="v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-proxyurl">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProxyURL eg http://proxyserver:2195 Directs scrapes to proxy through this endpoint. |
| proxy_client_config<a href="#v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-proxy_client_config" id="v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-proxy_client_config">#</a><br/>_[ProxyClientConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-proxyclientconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProxyClientConfig configures proxy auth settings for scraping<br />See [feature description](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/#scraping-targets-via-a-proxy) |
| scheme<a href="#v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-scheme" id="v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-scheme">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HTTP Scheme default "http" |
| server<a href="#v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-server" id="v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-server">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Server address of the Consul Agent. Defaults to localhost:8500. |
| services<a href="#v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-services" id="v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-services">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>A list of services for which targets are retrieved. If omitted, all services are scraped. |
| tagSeparator<a href="#v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-tagseparator" id="v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-tagseparator">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The string by which Consul tags are joined into the tag label. |
| tlsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-tlsconfig" id="v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-tlsconfig">#</a><br/>_[TLSConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-tlsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TLS configuration to use on every scrape request |
| tokenRef<a href="#v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-tokenref" id="v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig-tokenref">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Consul ACL TokenRef, if not provided it will use the ACL from the local Consul Agent. |

#### ConsulSDConfig {#v1beta1-consulsdconfig}

ConsulSDConfig defines a Consul service discovery configuration.

Will reduce load on Consul.<br />If unset, use its default value. |
| authorization<a href="#v1beta1-consulsdconfig-authorization" id="v1beta1-consulsdconfig-authorization">#</a><br/>_[Authorization (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-authorization)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Authorization header to use on every scrape request. |
| basicAuth<a href="#v1beta1-consulsdconfig-basicauth" id="v1beta1-consulsdconfig-basicauth">#</a><br/>_[BasicAuth (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-basicauth)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>BasicAuth information to use on every scrape request. |
| datacenter<a href="#v1beta1-consulsdconfig-datacenter" id="v1beta1-consulsdconfig-datacenter">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Consul Datacenter name, if not provided it will use the local Consul Agent Datacenter. |
| filter<a href="#v1beta1-consulsdconfig-filter" id="v1beta1-consulsdconfig-filter">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Filter defines filter for /v1/catalog/services requests<br />See https://developer.hashicorp.com/consul/api-docs/features/filtering |
| followRedirects<a href="#v1beta1-consulsdconfig-followredirects" id="v1beta1-consulsdconfig-followredirects">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configure whether HTTP requests follow HTTP 3xx redirects. |
| namespace<a href="#v1beta1-consulsdconfig-namespace" id="v1beta1-consulsdconfig-namespace">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Namespaces are only supported in Consul Enterprise. |
| nodeMeta<a href="#v1beta1-consulsdconfig-nodemeta" id="v1beta1-consulsdconfig-nodemeta">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Node metadata key/value pairs to filter nodes for a given service. |
| oauth2<a href="#v1beta1-consulsdconfig-oauth2" id="v1beta1-consulsdconfig-oauth2">#</a><br/>_[OAuth2 (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-oauth2)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OAuth2 defines auth configuration |
| partition<a href="#v1beta1-consulsdconfig-partition" id="v1beta1-consulsdconfig-partition">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Admin Partitions are only supported in Consul Enterprise. |
| proxyURL<a href="#v1beta1-consulsdconfig-proxyurl" id="v1beta1-consulsdconfig-proxyurl">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProxyURL eg http://proxyserver:2195 Directs scrapes to proxy through this endpoint. |
| proxy_client_config<a href="#v1beta1-consulsdconfig-proxy_client_config" id="v1beta1-consulsdconfig-proxy_client_config">#</a><br/>_[ProxyClientConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-proxyclientconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProxyClientConfig configures proxy auth settings for scraping<br />See [feature description](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/#scraping-targets-via-a-proxy) |
| scheme<a href="#v1beta1-consulsdconfig-scheme" id="v1beta1-consulsdconfig-scheme">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HTTP Scheme default "http" |
| server<a href="#v1beta1-consulsdconfig-server" id="v1beta1-consulsdconfig-server">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>A valid string consisting of a hostname or IP followed by an optional port number. |
| services<a href="#v1beta1-consulsdconfig-services" id="v1beta1-consulsdconfig-services">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>A list of services for which targets are retrieved. If omitted, all services are scraped. |
| tagSeparator<a href="#v1beta1-consulsdconfig-tagseparator" id="v1beta1-consulsdconfig-tagseparator">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The string by which Consul tags are joined into the tag label.<br />If unset, use its default value. |
| tags<a href="#v1beta1-consulsdconfig-tags" id="v1beta1-consulsdconfig-tags">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>An optional list of tags used to filter nodes for a given service. Services must contain all tags in the list. |
| tlsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-consulsdconfig-tlsconfig" id="v1beta1-consulsdconfig-tlsconfig">#</a><br/>_[TLSConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-tlsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TLS configuration to use on every scrape request |
| tokenRef<a href="#v1beta1-consulsdconfig-tokenref" id="v1beta1-consulsdconfig-tokenref">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Consul ACL TokenRef, if not provided it will use the ACL from the local Consul Agent. |

#### ContainerSecurityContext {#v1beta1-containersecuritycontext}

ContainerSecurityContext defines security context for each application container

Appears in: [SecurityContext (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-securitycontext)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| allowPrivilegeEscalation<a href="#v1beta1-containersecuritycontext-allowprivilegeescalation" id="v1beta1-containersecuritycontext-allowprivilegeescalation">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>AllowPrivilegeEscalation controls whether a process can gain more<br />privileges than its parent process. This bool directly controls if<br />the no_new_privs flag will be set on the container process.<br />AllowPrivilegeEscalation is true always when the container is:<br />1) run as Privileged<br />2) has CAP_SYS_ADMIN<br />Note that this field cannot be set when spec.os.name is windows. |
| capabilities<a href="#v1beta1-containersecuritycontext-capabilities" id="v1beta1-containersecuritycontext-capabilities">#</a><br/>_[Capabilities (v1)](#v1-capabilities)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The capabilities to add/drop when running containers.<br />Defaults to the default set of capabilities granted by the container runtime.<br />Note that this field cannot be set when spec.os.name is windows. |
| privileged<a href="#v1beta1-containersecuritycontext-privileged" id="v1beta1-containersecuritycontext-privileged">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Run containers in privileged mode.<br />Processes in privileged containers are essentially equivalent to root on the host.<br />Note that this field cannot be set when spec.os.name is windows. |
| procMount<a href="#v1beta1-containersecuritycontext-procmount" id="v1beta1-containersecuritycontext-procmount">#</a><br/>_[ProcMountType (v1)](#v1-procmounttype)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>procMount denotes the type of proc mount to use for the containers.<br />The default is DefaultProcMount which uses the container runtime defaults for<br />readonly paths and masked paths.<br />This requires the ProcMountType feature flag to be enabled.<br />Note that this field cannot be set when spec.os.name is windows. |
| readOnlyRootFilesystem<a href="#v1beta1-containersecuritycontext-readonlyrootfilesystem" id="v1beta1-containersecuritycontext-readonlyrootfilesystem">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Whether this containers has a read-only root filesystem.<br />Default is false.<br />Note that this field cannot be set when spec.os.name is windows. |

#### DNSSDConfig {#v1beta1-dnssdconfig}

DNSSDConfig allows specifying a set of DNS domain names which are periodically queried to discover a list of targets.
The DNS servers to be contacted are read from /etc/resolv.conf.
See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/sd_configs/#dns_sd_configs)

Appears in: [VMScrapeConfigSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| names<a href="#v1beta1-dnssdconfig-names" id="v1beta1-dnssdconfig-names">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Required)_<br/>A list of DNS domain names to be queried. |
| port<a href="#v1beta1-dnssdconfig-port" id="v1beta1-dnssdconfig-port">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The port number used if the query type is not SRV<br />Ignored for SRV records |
| type<a href="#v1beta1-dnssdconfig-type" id="v1beta1-dnssdconfig-type">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |

#### DigitalOceanSDConfig {#v1beta1-digitaloceansdconfig}

DigitalOceanSDConfig allow retrieving scrape targets from DigitalOcean's Droplets API.
This service discovery uses the public IPv4 address by default, by that can be changed with relabeling.

| basicAuth<a href="#v1beta1-digitaloceansdconfig-basicauth" id="v1beta1-digitaloceansdconfig-basicauth">#</a><br/>_[BasicAuth (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-basicauth)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>BasicAuth information to use on every scrape request. |
| followRedirects<a href="#v1beta1-digitaloceansdconfig-followredirects" id="v1beta1-digitaloceansdconfig-followredirects">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configure whether HTTP requests follow HTTP 3xx redirects. |
| oauth2<a href="#v1beta1-digitaloceansdconfig-oauth2" id="v1beta1-digitaloceansdconfig-oauth2">#</a><br/>_[OAuth2 (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-oauth2)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OAuth2 defines auth configuration |
| port<a href="#v1beta1-digitaloceansdconfig-port" id="v1beta1-digitaloceansdconfig-port">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The port to scrape metrics from. |
| proxyURL<a href="#v1beta1-digitaloceansdconfig-proxyurl" id="v1beta1-digitaloceansdconfig-proxyurl">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProxyURL eg http://proxyserver:2195 Directs scrapes to proxy through this endpoint. |
| proxy_client_config<a href="#v1beta1-digitaloceansdconfig-proxy_client_config" id="v1beta1-digitaloceansdconfig-proxy_client_config">#</a><br/>_[ProxyClientConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-proxyclientconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProxyClientConfig configures proxy auth settings for scraping<br />See [feature description](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/#scraping-targets-via-a-proxy) |
| server<a href="#v1beta1-digitaloceansdconfig-server" id="v1beta1-digitaloceansdconfig-server">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Server is an optional DigitalOcean API server to query.<br />By default, https://api.digitalocean.com is used. |

#### DownsamplingConfig {#v1beta1-downsamplingconfig}

DownsamplingConfig defines downsampling configuration for VMSingle and VMCluster
Requires enterprise license.
See https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#downsampling

Appears in: [VMClusterSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmclusterspec), [VMSingleSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmsinglespec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| dedupInterval<a href="#v1beta1-downsamplingconfig-dedupinterval" id="v1beta1-downsamplingconfig-dedupinterval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DedupInterval sets the deduplication interval used with downsampling.<br />It corresponds to -dedup.minScrapeInterval flag.<br />Must be a multiple of all configured downsampling intervals. |
| rules<a href="#v1beta1-downsamplingconfig-rules" id="v1beta1-downsamplingconfig-rules">#</a><br/>_[DownsamplingRule (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-downsamplingrule) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Rules defines downsampling rules.<br />Each rule matches time series by an optional filter and applies downsampling after a given offset. |

#### DownsamplingPeriod {#v1beta1-downsamplingperiod}

DownsamplingPeriod defines a single downsampling time horizon.

Appears in: [DownsamplingRule (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-downsamplingrule)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| interval<a href="#v1beta1-downsamplingperiod-interval" id="v1beta1-downsamplingperiod-interval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Interval is the target downsampling resolution; only the last sample per interval is kept.<br />Example: "10m" |
| offset<a href="#v1beta1-downsamplingperiod-offset" id="v1beta1-downsamplingperiod-offset">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Offset is the minimum age of data before downsampling is applied.<br />Example: "30d" |

#### DownsamplingRule {#v1beta1-downsamplingrule}

DownsamplingRule defines downsampling periods for an optional label filter.
All period intervals must be pairwise multiples of each other.

Appears in: [DownsamplingConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-downsamplingconfig)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| filter<a href="#v1beta1-downsamplingrule-filter" id="v1beta1-downsamplingrule-filter">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Filter is an optional MetricsQL label filter for matching time series.<br />If not set, the rule is applied to all time series.<br />Example: '\{env="prod"\}' |
| periods<a href="#v1beta1-downsamplingrule-periods" id="v1beta1-downsamplingrule-periods">#</a><br/>_[DownsamplingPeriod (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-downsamplingperiod) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>Periods defines the downsampling time horizons applied to matching series. |

#### EC2SDConfig {#v1beta1-ec2sdconfig}

EC2SDConfig allow retrieving scrape targets from AWS EC2 instances.
The private IP address is used by default, but may be changed to the public IP address with relabeling.
The IAM credentials used must have the ec2:DescribeInstances permission to discover scrape targets.
See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/sd_configs/#ec2_sd_configs)

Appears in: [VMScrapeConfigSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| accessKey<a href="#v1beta1-ec2sdconfig-accesskey" id="v1beta1-ec2sdconfig-accesskey">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>AccessKey is the AWS API key. |
| filters<a href="#v1beta1-ec2sdconfig-filters" id="v1beta1-ec2sdconfig-filters">#</a><br/>_[EC2Filter (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-ec2filter) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Filters can be used optionally to filter the instance list by other criteria.<br />Available filter criteria can be found here:<br />https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_DescribeInstances.html<br />Filter API documentation: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_Filter.html |
| port<a href="#v1beta1-ec2sdconfig-port" id="v1beta1-ec2sdconfig-port">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The port to scrape metrics from. If using the public IP address, this must<br />instead be specified in the relabeling rule. |
| region<a href="#v1beta1-ec2sdconfig-region" id="v1beta1-ec2sdconfig-region">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The AWS region |
| roleARN<a href="#v1beta1-ec2sdconfig-rolearn" id="v1beta1-ec2sdconfig-rolearn">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>AWS Role ARN, an alternative to using AWS API keys. |
| secretKey<a href="#v1beta1-ec2sdconfig-secretkey" id="v1beta1-ec2sdconfig-secretkey">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SecretKey is the AWS API secret. |

#### EmailConfig {#v1beta1-emailconfig}

#### GCESDConfig {#v1beta1-gcesdconfig}

GCESDConfig configures scrape targets from GCP GCE instances.
The private IP address is used by default, but may be changed to
the public IP address with relabeling.
See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/sd_configs/#gce_sd_configs)

The GCE service discovery will load the Google Cloud credentials
from the file specified by the GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS environment variable.
See https://cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/tutorials/authenticating-to-cloud-platform

Appears in: [VMScrapeConfigSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| filter<a href="#v1beta1-gcesdconfig-filter" id="v1beta1-gcesdconfig-filter">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Filter can be used optionally to filter the instance list by other criteria<br />Syntax of this filter is described in the filter query parameter section:<br />https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/reference/latest/instances/list |
| port<a href="#v1beta1-gcesdconfig-port" id="v1beta1-gcesdconfig-port">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The port to scrape metrics from. If using the public IP address, this must<br />instead be specified in the relabeling rule. |
| project<a href="#v1beta1-gcesdconfig-project" id="v1beta1-gcesdconfig-project">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>The Google Cloud Project ID |
| tagSeparator<a href="#v1beta1-gcesdconfig-tagseparator" id="v1beta1-gcesdconfig-tagseparator">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The tag separator is used to separate the tags on concatenation |
| zone<a href="#v1beta1-gcesdconfig-zone" id="v1beta1-gcesdconfig-zone">#</a><br/>_[StringOrArray (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-stringorarray)_ | _(Required)_<br/>The zone of the scrape targets. If you need multiple zones use multiple GCESDConfigs. |

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| authorization<a href="#v1beta1-httpconfig-authorization" id="v1beta1-httpconfig-authorization">#</a><br/>_[Authorization (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-authorization)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Authorization header configuration for the client.<br />This is mutually exclusive with BasicAuth and is only available starting from Alertmanager v0.22+. |
| basic_auth<a href="#v1beta1-httpconfig-basic_auth" id="v1beta1-httpconfig-basic_auth">#</a><br/>_[BasicAuth (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-basicauth)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>BasicAuth for the client. |
| bearer_token_file<a href="#v1beta1-httpconfig-bearer_token_file" id="v1beta1-httpconfig-bearer_token_file">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>BearerTokenFile defines filename for bearer token, it must be mounted to pod. |
| bearer_token_secret<a href="#v1beta1-httpconfig-bearer_token_secret" id="v1beta1-httpconfig-bearer_token_secret">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The secret's key that contains the bearer token<br />It must be at them same namespace as CRD |
| follow_redirects<a href="#v1beta1-httpconfig-follow_redirects" id="v1beta1-httpconfig-follow_redirects">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>FollowRedirects controls redirects for scraping. |
| http_headers<a href="#v1beta1-httpconfig-http_headers" id="v1beta1-httpconfig-http_headers">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:[HTTPHeaderConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-httpheaderconfig))_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HTTPHeaders defines custom HTTP headers to be sent along with each request.<br />Only supported starting from Alertmanager v0.28.0; ignored by older versions.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0750">v0.75.0</a> |
| noProxy<a href="#v1beta1-httpconfig-noproxy" id="v1beta1-httpconfig-noproxy">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NoProxy defines a comma-separated string that can contain IPs, CIDR notation, domain names that should be excluded from proxying.<br />IP and domain names can contain port numbers. |
| oauth2<a href="#v1beta1-httpconfig-oauth2" id="v1beta1-httpconfig-oauth2">#</a><br/>_[OAuth2 (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-oauth2)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OAuth2 client credentials used to fetch a token for the targets. |
| proxyConnectHeader<a href="#v1beta1-httpconfig-proxyconnectheader" id="v1beta1-httpconfig-proxyconnectheader">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:[SecretKeySelector](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.35/#secretkeyselector-v1-core))_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProxyConnectHeader optionally specifies headers to send to proxies during CONNECT requests. |
| proxyFromEnvironment<a href="#v1beta1-httpconfig-proxyfromenvironment" id="v1beta1-httpconfig-proxyfromenvironment">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProxyFromEnvironment defines whether to use the proxy configuration defined by environment variables (HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, and NO_PROXY). |
| proxyURL<a href="#v1beta1-httpconfig-proxyurl" id="v1beta1-httpconfig-proxyurl">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProxyUrl defines the HTTP proxy server to use. |

Available from v0.29.0 alertmanager version

Appears in: [Receiver (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-receiver)

| --- | --- |
| alert_source_token<a href="#v1beta1-incidentioconfig-alert_source_token" id="v1beta1-incidentioconfig-alert_source_token">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>AlertSourceToken is used to authenticate with incident.io.<br />Mutually exclusive with AlertSourceTokenFile. |
| alert_source_token_file<a href="#v1beta1-incidentioconfig-alert_source_token_file" id="v1beta1-incidentioconfig-alert_source_token_file">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>AlertSourceTokenFile defines the path to a file that contains the alert source token.<br />Mutually exclusive with AlertSourceToken. |

| max_alerts<a href="#v1beta1-incidentioconfig-max_alerts" id="v1beta1-incidentioconfig-max_alerts">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MaxAlerts defines maximum number of alerts to be sent per incident.io message. |
| send_resolved<a href="#v1beta1-incidentioconfig-send_resolved" id="v1beta1-incidentioconfig-send_resolved">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SendResolved controls notify about resolved alerts. |
| timeout<a href="#v1beta1-incidentioconfig-timeout" id="v1beta1-incidentioconfig-timeout">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Timeout is the maximum time allowed to invoke incident.io |
| url<a href="#v1beta1-incidentioconfig-url" id="v1beta1-incidentioconfig-url">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The URL to send the incident.io alert. This would typically be provided by the<br />incident.io team when setting up an alert source.<br />Mutually exclusive with URLFile. |
| url_file<a href="#v1beta1-incidentioconfig-url_file" id="v1beta1-incidentioconfig-url_file">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>URLFile defines the path to a file that holds the incident.io alert URL.<br />Mutually exclusive with URL. |

#### InhibitRule {#v1beta1-inhibitrule}

InhibitRule defines an inhibition rule that allows to mute alerts when other
alerts are already firing.
Note, it doesn't support deprecated alertmanager config options.
See https://prometheus.io/docs/alerting/latest/configuration/#inhibit_rule

Appears in: [VMAlertmanagerConfigSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerconfigspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| equal<a href="#v1beta1-inhibitrule-equal" id="v1beta1-inhibitrule-equal">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Labels that must have an equal value in the source and target alert for<br />the inhibition to take effect. |
| source_matchers<a href="#v1beta1-inhibitrule-source_matchers" id="v1beta1-inhibitrule-source_matchers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SourceMatchers defines a list of matchers for which one or more alerts have<br />to exist for the inhibition to take effect. |
| target_matchers<a href="#v1beta1-inhibitrule-target_matchers" id="v1beta1-inhibitrule-target_matchers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TargetMatchers defines a list of matchers that have to be fulfilled by the target<br />alerts to be muted. |

#### JiraConfig {#v1beta1-jiraconfig}

JiraConfig represent alertmanager's jira_config entry
https://prometheus.io/docs/alerting/latest/configuration/#jira_config
Available from v0.28.0 alertmanager version

Appears in: [Receiver (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-receiver)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| api_url<a href="#v1beta1-jiraconfig-api_url" id="v1beta1-jiraconfig-api_url">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The URL to send API requests to. The full API path must be included.<br />Example: https://company.atlassian.net/rest/api/2/ |
| custom_fields<a href="#v1beta1-jiraconfig-custom_fields" id="v1beta1-jiraconfig-custom_fields">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:[JSON (v1)](#v1-json))_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Other issue and custom fields.<br />Jira issue field can have multiple types.<br />Depends on the field type, the values must be provided differently.<br />See https://developer.atlassian.com/server/jira/platform/jira-rest-api-examples/#setting-custom-field-data-for-other-field-types for further examples. |
| description<a href="#v1beta1-jiraconfig-description" id="v1beta1-jiraconfig-description">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Issue description template. |
| http_config<a href="#v1beta1-jiraconfig-http_config" id="v1beta1-jiraconfig-http_config">#</a><br/>_[HTTPConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-httpconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The HTTP client's configuration. You must use this configuration to supply the personal access token (PAT) as part of the HTTP `Authorization` header.<br />For Jira Cloud, use basic_auth with the email address as the username and the PAT as the password.<br />For Jira Data Center, use the 'authorization' field with 'credentials: <PAT value>'. |
| issue_type<a href="#v1beta1-jiraconfig-issue_type" id="v1beta1-jiraconfig-issue_type">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Type of the issue (e.g. Bug) |
| labels<a href="#v1beta1-jiraconfig-labels" id="v1beta1-jiraconfig-labels">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Required)_<br/>Labels to be added to the issue |
| priority<a href="#v1beta1-jiraconfig-priority" id="v1beta1-jiraconfig-priority">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Priority of the issue |
| project<a href="#v1beta1-jiraconfig-project" id="v1beta1-jiraconfig-project">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>The project key where issues are created |
| reopen_duration<a href="#v1beta1-jiraconfig-reopen_duration" id="v1beta1-jiraconfig-reopen_duration">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>If reopen_transition is defined, reopen the issue when it is not older than this value (rounded down to the nearest minute).<br />The resolutiondate field is used to determine the age of the issue. |
| reopen_transition<a href="#v1beta1-jiraconfig-reopen_transition" id="v1beta1-jiraconfig-reopen_transition">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Name of the workflow transition to resolve an issue.<br />The target status must have the category "done". |
| resolve_transition<a href="#v1beta1-jiraconfig-resolve_transition" id="v1beta1-jiraconfig-resolve_transition">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Name of the workflow transition to reopen an issue.<br />The target status should not have the category "done". |
| send_resolved<a href="#v1beta1-jiraconfig-send_resolved" id="v1beta1-jiraconfig-send_resolved">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SendResolved controls notify about resolved alerts. |
| summary<a href="#v1beta1-jiraconfig-summary" id="v1beta1-jiraconfig-summary">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Issue summary template |
| wont_fix_resolution<a href="#v1beta1-jiraconfig-wont_fix_resolution" id="v1beta1-jiraconfig-wont_fix_resolution">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>If reopen_transition is defined, ignore issues with that resolution. |
