#### License {#v1beta1-license}

License holds license key for enterprise features.
Using license key is supported starting from VictoriaMetrics corev1.94.0.
See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/enterprise/)

Appears in: [VLAgentSpec (v1)](#v1-vlagentspec), [VLClusterSpec (v1)](#v1-vlclusterspec), [VLDistributedSpec (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vldistributedspec), [VLDistributedZoneAgentSpec (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec), [VLSingleSpec (v1)](#v1-vlsinglespec), [VMAgentSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmagentspec), [VMAlertSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmalertspec), [VMAnomalySpec (v1)](#v1-vmanomalyspec), [VMAuthLoadBalancerSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec), [VMAuthSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmauthspec), [VMClusterSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmclusterspec), [VMDistributedSpec (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vmdistributedspec), [VMDistributedZoneAgentSpec (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vmdistributedzoneagentspec), [VMSingleSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmsinglespec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| forceOffline<a href="#v1beta1-license-forceoffline" id="v1beta1-license-forceoffline">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>Enforce offline verification of the license key. |
| key<a href="#v1beta1-license-key" id="v1beta1-license-key">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Enterprise license key. This flag is available only in [VictoriaMetrics enterprise](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/enterprise/).<br />To request a trial license, [go to](https://victoriametrics.com/products/enterprise/trial) |
| keyRef<a href="#v1beta1-license-keyref" id="v1beta1-license-keyref">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Required)_<br/>KeyRef is reference to secret with license key for enterprise features. |

(v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmalertremotewritespec), [VMDistributedZoneRemoteWriteSpec (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vmdistributedzoneremotewritespec), [VMNodeScrapeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmnodescrapespec), [VMProbeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmprobespec), [VMScrapeConfigSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec), [VultrSDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vultrsdconfig)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| client_id<a href="#v1beta1-oauth2-client_id" id="v1beta1-oauth2-client_id">#</a><br/>_[SecretOrConfigMap (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-secretorconfigmap)_ | _(Required)_<br/>The secret or configmap containing the OAuth2 client id |
| client_secret<a href="#v1beta1-oauth2-client_secret" id="v1beta1-oauth2-client_secret">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The secret containing the OAuth2 client secret |
| client_secret_file<a href="#v1beta1-oauth2-client_secret_file" id="v1beta1-oauth2-client_secret_file">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ClientSecretFile defines path for client secret file. |
| endpoint_params<a href="#v1beta1-oauth2-endpoint_params" id="v1beta1-oauth2-endpoint_params">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Parameters to append to the token URL |
| proxy_url<a href="#v1beta1-oauth2-proxy_url" id="v1beta1-oauth2-proxy_url">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The proxy URL for token_url connection<br />Is only supported by Scrape objects family<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0550">v0.55.0</a> |
| scopes<a href="#v1beta1-oauth2-scopes" id="v1beta1-oauth2-scopes">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OAuth2 scopes used for the token request |
| tls_config<a href="#v1beta1-oauth2-tls_config" id="v1beta1-oauth2-tls_config">#</a><br/>_[TLSConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-tlsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TLSConfig for token_url connection<br />Is only supported by Scrape objects family<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0550">v0.55.0</a> |
| token_url<a href="#v1beta1-oauth2-token_url" id="v1beta1-oauth2-token_url">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>The URL to fetch the token from |

#### OVHCloudSDConfig {#v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig}

OVHCloudSDConfig configurations allows retrieving scrape targets from OVH Cloud VPS and OVH Cloud dedicated server.
See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/sd_configs/#ovhcloud_sd_configs)

Appears in: [VMScrapeConfigSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| applicationKey<a href="#v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-applicationkey" id="v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-applicationkey">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>ApplicationKey defines a self generated token. |
| applicationSecret<a href="#v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-applicationsecret" id="v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-applicationsecret">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Required)_<br/>ApplicationSecret defines a generated secret. |
| authorization<a href="#v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-authorization" id="v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-authorization">#</a><br/>_[Authorization (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-authorization)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Authorization header to use on every scrape request. |
| basicAuth<a href="#v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-basicauth" id="v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-basicauth">#</a><br/>_[BasicAuth (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-basicauth)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>BasicAuth information to use on every scrape request. |
| consumerKey<a href="#v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-consumerkey" id="v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-consumerkey">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Required)_<br/>ConsumerKey holds user/app specific token |
| endpoint<a href="#v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-endpoint" id="v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-endpoint">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Endpoint defines OVH Cloud endpoint |
| followRedirects<a href="#v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-followredirects" id="v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-followredirects">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configure whether HTTP requests follow HTTP 3xx redirects. |
| oauth2<a href="#v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-oauth2" id="v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-oauth2">#</a><br/>_[OAuth2 (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-oauth2)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OAuth2 defines auth configuration |
| proxyURL<a href="#v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-proxyurl" id="v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-proxyurl">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProxyURL eg http://proxyserver:2195 Directs scrapes to proxy through this endpoint. |
| proxy_client_config<a href="#v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-proxy_client_config" id="v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-proxy_client_config">#</a><br/>_[ProxyClientConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-proxyclientconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProxyClientConfig configures proxy auth settings for scraping<br />See [feature description](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/#scraping-targets-via-a-proxy) |
| service<a href="#v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-service" id="v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-service">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Service could be either `vps` or `dedicated_server` |
| tlsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-tlsconfig" id="v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig-tlsconfig">#</a><br/>_[TLSConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-tlsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TLS configuration to use on every scrape request |

| applicationCredentialName<a href="#v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-applicationcredentialname" id="v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-applicationcredentialname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The ApplicationCredentialID or ApplicationCredentialName fields are<br />required if using an application credential to authenticate. Some providers<br />allow you to create an application credential to authenticate rather than a<br />password. |
| applicationCredentialSecret<a href="#v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-applicationcredentialsecret" id="v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-applicationcredentialsecret">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The applicationCredentialSecret field is required if using an application<br />credential to authenticate. |

| domainID<a href="#v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-domainid" id="v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-domainid">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DomainID |
| domainName<a href="#v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-domainname" id="v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-domainname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>At most one of domainId and domainName must be provided if using username<br />with Identity V3. Otherwise, either are optional. |
| identityEndpoint<a href="#v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-identityendpoint" id="v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-identityendpoint">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>IdentityEndpoint specifies the HTTP endpoint that is required to work with<br />the Identity API of the appropriate version. |
| password<a href="#v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-password" id="v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-password">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Password for the Identity V2 and V3 APIs. Consult with your provider's<br />control panel to discover your account's preferred method of authentication. |
| port<a href="#v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-port" id="v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-port">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The port to scrape metrics from. If using the public IP address, this must<br />instead be specified in the relabeling rule. |
| projectID<a href="#v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-projectid" id="v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-projectid">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/> ProjectID |
| projectName<a href="#v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-projectname" id="v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-projectname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The ProjectId and ProjectName fields are optional for the Identity V2 API.<br />Some providers allow you to specify a ProjectName instead of the ProjectId.<br />Some require both. Your provider's authentication policies will determine<br />how these fields influence authentication. |
| region<a href="#v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-region" id="v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-region">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>The OpenStack Region. |
| role<a href="#v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-role" id="v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-role">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>The OpenStack role of entities that should be discovered. |
| tlsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-tlsconfig" id="v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-tlsconfig">#</a><br/>_[TLSConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-tlsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TLS configuration to use on every scrape request |
| userid<a href="#v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-userid" id="v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-userid">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UserID |
| username<a href="#v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-username" id="v1beta1-openstacksdconfig-username">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Username is required if using Identity V2 API. Consult with your provider's<br />control panel to discover your account's username.<br />In Identity V3, either userid or a combination of username<br />and domainId or domainName are needed |

#### OpsGenieConfig {#v1beta1-opsgenieconfig}

OpsGenieConfig configures notifications via OpsGenie.
See https://prometheus.io/docs/alerting/latest/configuration/#opsgenie_config

Appears in: [Receiver (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-receiver)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| actions<a href="#v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-actions" id="v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-actions">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Comma separated list of actions that will be available for the alert. |
| apiURL<a href="#v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-apiurl" id="v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-apiurl">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The URL to send OpsGenie API requests to. |
| api_key<a href="#v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-api_key" id="v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-api_key">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The secret's key that contains the OpsGenie API key.<br />It must be at them same namespace as CRD<br />fallback to global setting if empty |
| description<a href="#v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-description" id="v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-description">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Description of the incident. |
| details<a href="#v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-details" id="v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-details">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>A set of arbitrary key/value pairs that provide further detail about the incident. |
| entity<a href="#v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-entity" id="v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-entity">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Optional field that can be used to specify which domain alert is related to. |
| http_config<a href="#v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-http_config" id="v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-http_config">#</a><br/>_[HTTPConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-httpconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HTTP client configuration. |
| message<a href="#v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-message" id="v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-message">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Alert text limited to 130 characters. |
| note<a href="#v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-note" id="v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-note">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Additional alert note. |
| priority<a href="#v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-priority" id="v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-priority">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Priority level of alert. Possible values are P1, P2, P3, P4, and P5. |
| responders<a href="#v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-responders" id="v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-responders">#</a><br/>_[OpsGenieConfigResponder (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-opsgenieconfigresponder) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>List of responders responsible for notifications. |
| send_resolved<a href="#v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-send_resolved" id="v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-send_resolved">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SendResolved controls notify about resolved alerts. |
| source<a href="#v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-source" id="v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-source">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Backlink to the sender of the notification. |
| tags<a href="#v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-tags" id="v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-tags">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Comma separated list of tags attached to the notifications. |
| update_alerts<a href="#v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-update_alerts" id="v1beta1-opsgenieconfig-update_alerts">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>Whether to update message and description of the alert in OpsGenie if it already exists<br />By default, the alert is never updated in OpsGenie, the new message only appears in activity log. |

#### OpsGenieConfigResponder {#v1beta1-opsgenieconfigresponder}

OpsGenieConfigResponder defines a responder to an incident.
One of `id`, `name` or `username` has to be defined.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| id<a href="#v1beta1-opsgenieconfigresponder-id" id="v1beta1-opsgenieconfigresponder-id">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ID of the responder. |
| name<a href="#v1beta1-opsgenieconfigresponder-name" id="v1beta1-opsgenieconfigresponder-name">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Name of the responder. |
| type<a href="#v1beta1-opsgenieconfigresponder-type" id="v1beta1-opsgenieconfigresponder-type">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Type of responder. |
| username<a href="#v1beta1-opsgenieconfigresponder-username" id="v1beta1-opsgenieconfigresponder-username">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Username of the responder. |

Either this field or `routingKey` needs to<br />be defined.<br />It must be at them same namespace as CRD |
| severity<a href="#v1beta1-pagerdutyconfig-severity" id="v1beta1-pagerdutyconfig-severity">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Severity of the incident. |
| url<a href="#v1beta1-pagerdutyconfig-url" id="v1beta1-pagerdutyconfig-url">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The URL to send requests to. |

#### PodMetricsEndpoint {#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint}

PodMetricsEndpoint defines a scrapeable endpoint of a Kubernetes Pod serving metrics.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| attach_metadata<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-attach_metadata" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-attach_metadata">#</a><br/>_[AttachMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-attachmetadata)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>AttachMetadata configures metadata attaching from service discovery |
| authorization<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-authorization" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-authorization">#</a><br/>_[Authorization (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-authorization)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Authorization with http header Authorization |
| basicAuth<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-basicauth" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-basicauth">#</a><br/>_[BasicAuth (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-basicauth)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>BasicAuth allow an endpoint to authenticate over basic authentication |
| bearerTokenFile<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-bearertokenfile" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-bearertokenfile">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>File to read bearer token for scraping targets. |
| bearerTokenSecret<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-bearertokensecret" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-bearertokensecret">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Secret to mount to read bearer token for scraping targets. The secret<br />needs to be in the same namespace as the scrape object and accessible by<br />the victoria-metrics operator. |
| filterRunning<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-filterrunning" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-filterrunning">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>FilterRunning applies filter with pod status == running<br />it prevents from scrapping metrics at failed or succeed state pods.<br />enabled by default |
| follow_redirects<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-follow_redirects" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-follow_redirects">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>FollowRedirects controls redirects for scraping. |
| honorLabels<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-honorlabels" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-honorlabels">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HonorLabels chooses the metric's labels on collisions with target labels. |
| honorTimestamps<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-honortimestamps" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-honortimestamps">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HonorTimestamps controls whether vmagent or vmsingle respects the timestamps present in scraped data. |
| interval<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-interval" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-interval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Interval at which metrics should be scraped |
| max_scrape_size<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-max_scrape_size" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-max_scrape_size">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MaxScrapeSize defines a maximum size of scraped data for a job |
| metricRelabelConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-metricrelabelconfigs" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-metricrelabelconfigs">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MetricRelabelConfigs to apply to samples after scrapping. |
| oauth2<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-oauth2" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-oauth2">#</a><br/>_[OAuth2 (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-oauth2)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OAuth2 defines auth configuration |
| params<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-params" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-params">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string array)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Optional HTTP URL parameters |
| path<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-path" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-path">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HTTP path to scrape for metrics. |
| port<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-port" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-port">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Name of the port exposed at Pod. |
| portNumber<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-portnumber" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-portnumber">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PortNumber defines the `Pod` port number which exposes the endpoint. |
| proxyURL<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-proxyurl" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-proxyurl">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProxyURL eg http://proxyserver:2195 Directs scrapes to proxy through this endpoint. |
| relabelConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-relabelconfigs" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-relabelconfigs">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RelabelConfigs to apply to samples during service discovery. |
| sampleLimit<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-samplelimit" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-samplelimit">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SampleLimit defines per-scrape limit on number of scraped samples that will be accepted. |
| scheme<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-scheme" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-scheme">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HTTP scheme to use for scraping. |
| scrapeTimeout<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-scrapetimeout" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-scrapetimeout">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Timeout after which the scrape is ended |
| scrape_interval<a href="#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-scrape_interval" id="v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint-scrape_interval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeInterval is the same as Interval and has priority over it.<br />one of scrape_interval or interval can be used |

#### PushoverConfig {#v1beta1-pushoverconfig}

PushoverConfig configures notifications via Pushover.
See https://prometheus.io/docs/alerting/latest/configuration/#pushover_config

Appears in: [Receiver (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-receiver)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| expire<a href="#v1beta1-pushoverconfig-expire" id="v1beta1-pushoverconfig-expire">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>How long your notification will continue to be retried for, unless the user<br />acknowledges the notification. |
| html<a href="#v1beta1-pushoverconfig-html" id="v1beta1-pushoverconfig-html">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Whether notification message is HTML or plain text. |
| http_config<a href="#v1beta1-pushoverconfig-http_config" id="v1beta1-pushoverconfig-http_config">#</a><br/>_[HTTPConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-httpconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HTTP client configuration. |
| message<a href="#v1beta1-pushoverconfig-message" id="v1beta1-pushoverconfig-message">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Notification message. |
| priority<a href="#v1beta1-pushoverconfig-priority" id="v1beta1-pushoverconfig-priority">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Priority, see https://pushover.net/api#priority |
| retry<a href="#v1beta1-pushoverconfig-retry" id="v1beta1-pushoverconfig-retry">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>How often the Pushover servers will send the same notification to the user.<br />Must be at least 30 seconds. |
| send_resolved<a href="#v1beta1-pushoverconfig-send_resolved" id="v1beta1-pushoverconfig-send_resolved">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SendResolved controls notify about resolved alerts. |
| sound<a href="#v1beta1-pushoverconfig-sound" id="v1beta1-pushoverconfig-sound">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The name of one of the sounds supported by device clients to override the user's default sound choice |
| title<a href="#v1beta1-pushoverconfig-title" id="v1beta1-pushoverconfig-title">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Notification title. |
| token<a href="#v1beta1-pushoverconfig-token" id="v1beta1-pushoverconfig-token">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Required)_<br/>The secret's key that contains the registered application’s API token, see https://pushover.net/apps.<br />It must be at them same namespace as CRD |
| url<a href="#v1beta1-pushoverconfig-url" id="v1beta1-pushoverconfig-url">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>A supplementary URL shown alongside the message. |
| url_title<a href="#v1beta1-pushoverconfig-url_title" id="v1beta1-pushoverconfig-url_title">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>A title for supplementary URL, otherwise just the URL is shown |
| user_key<a href="#v1beta1-pushoverconfig-user_key" id="v1beta1-pushoverconfig-user_key">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Required)_<br/>The secret's key that contains the recipient user’s user key.<br />It must be at them same namespace as CRD |

#### RelabelConfig {#v1beta1-relabelconfig}

RelabelConfig allows dynamic rewriting of the label set
More info: https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/#relabeling

Appears in: [CommonRelabelParams (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-commonrelabelparams), [CommonScrapeParams (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-commonscrapeparams), [Endpoint (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-endpoint), [EndpointRelabelings (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-endpointrelabelings), [PodMetricsEndpoint (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint), [ScrapeClass (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-scrapeclass), [StreamAggrRule (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-streamaggrrule), [TargetEndpoint (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-targetendpoint), [VMAgentRemoteWriteSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec), [VMAgentSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmagentspec), [VMNodeScrapeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmnodescrapespec), [VMProbeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmprobespec), [VMProbeTargetKubernetes (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmprobetargetkubernetes), [VMProbeTargetStatic (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmprobetargetstatic), [VMScrapeConfigSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec), [VMSingleSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmsinglespec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| action<a href="#v1beta1-relabelconfig-action" id="v1beta1-relabelconfig-action">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Action to perform based on regex matching. Default is 'replace' |
| if<a href="#v1beta1-relabelconfig-if" id="v1beta1-relabelconfig-if">#</a><br/>_[StringOrArray (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-stringorarray)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>If represents metricsQL match expression (or list of expressions): '\{__name__=~"foo_.*"\}' |
| labels<a href="#v1beta1-relabelconfig-labels" id="v1beta1-relabelconfig-labels">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Labels is used together with Match for `action: graphite` |
| match<a href="#v1beta1-relabelconfig-match" id="v1beta1-relabelconfig-match">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Match is used together with Labels for `action: graphite` |
| modulus<a href="#v1beta1-relabelconfig-modulus" id="v1beta1-relabelconfig-modulus">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Modulus to take of the hash of the source label values. |
| regex<a href="#v1beta1-relabelconfig-regex" id="v1beta1-relabelconfig-regex">#</a><br/>_[StringOrArray (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-stringorarray)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Regular expression against which the extracted value is matched. Default is '(.*)'<br />victoriaMetrics supports multiline regex joined with \|<br />https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/#relabeling-enhancements |
| replacement<a href="#v1beta1-relabelconfig-replacement" id="v1beta1-relabelconfig-replacement">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Replacement value against which a regex replace is performed if the<br />regular expression matches. Regex capture groups are available. Default is '$1' |
| separator<a href="#v1beta1-relabelconfig-separator" id="v1beta1-relabelconfig-separator">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Separator placed between concatenated source label values. default is ';'. |
| sourceLabels<a href="#v1beta1-relabelconfig-sourcelabels" id="v1beta1-relabelconfig-sourcelabels">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The source labels select values from existing labels. Their content is concatenated<br />using the configured separator and matched against the configured regular expression<br />for the replace, keep, and drop actions. |
| source_labels<a href="#v1beta1-relabelconfig-source_labels" id="v1beta1-relabelconfig-source_labels">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UnderScoreSourceLabels - additional form of source labels source_labels<br />for compatibility with original relabel config.<br />if set both sourceLabels and source_labels, sourceLabels has priority.<br />for details https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/operator/issues/131 |
| targetLabel<a href="#v1beta1-relabelconfig-targetlabel" id="v1beta1-relabelconfig-targetlabel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Label to which the resulting value is written in a replace action.<br />It is mandatory for replace actions. Regex capture groups are available. |
| target_label<a href="#v1beta1-relabelconfig-target_label" id="v1beta1-relabelconfig-target_label">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UnderScoreTargetLabel - additional form of target label - target_label<br />for compatibility with original relabel config.<br />if set both targetLabel and target_label, targetLabel has priority.<br />for details https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/operator/issues/131 |

#### RetentionFilter {#v1beta1-retentionfilter}

RetentionFilter defines per-series retention based on a label filter.
Requires enterprise license.
See https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#retention-filters

Appears in: [RetentionFiltersConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-retentionfiltersconfig)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| filter<a href="#v1beta1-retentionfilter-filter" id="v1beta1-retentionfilter-filter">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Filter is a MetricsQL label filter for matching time series.<br />Example: '\{env="dev"\}' |
| retention<a href="#v1beta1-retentionfilter-retention" id="v1beta1-retentionfilter-retention">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Retention is the retention period for matching time series.<br />Must not exceed the global retentionPeriod.<br />Example: "3d", "1w" |

#### Route {#v1beta1-route}

Route defines a node in the routing tree.

Appears in: [VMAlertmanagerConfigSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerconfigspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| active_time_intervals<a href="#v1beta1-route-active_time_intervals" id="v1beta1-route-active_time_intervals">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ActiveTimeIntervals Times when the route should be active<br />These must match the name at time_intervals |
| continue<a href="#v1beta1-route-continue" id="v1beta1-route-continue">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Continue indicating whether an alert should continue matching subsequent<br />sibling nodes. It will always be true for the first-level route if disableRouteContinueEnforce for vmalertmanager not set. |
| group_by<a href="#v1beta1-route-group_by" id="v1beta1-route-group_by">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>List of labels to group by. |
| group_interval<a href="#v1beta1-route-group_interval" id="v1beta1-route-group_interval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>How long to wait before sending an updated notification. |
| group_wait<a href="#v1beta1-route-group_wait" id="v1beta1-route-group_wait">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>How long to wait before sending the initial notification. |
| matchers<a href="#v1beta1-route-matchers" id="v1beta1-route-matchers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>List of matchers that the alert’s labels should match. For the first<br />level route, the operator adds a namespace: "CRD_NS" matcher.<br />https://prometheus.io/docs/alerting/latest/configuration/#matcher |
| mute_time_intervals<a href="#v1beta1-route-mute_time_intervals" id="v1beta1-route-mute_time_intervals">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MuteTimeIntervals is a list of interval names that will mute matched alert |
| receiver<a href="#v1beta1-route-receiver" id="v1beta1-route-receiver">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Name of the receiver for this route. |
| repeat_interval<a href="#v1beta1-route-repeat_interval" id="v1beta1-route-repeat_interval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>How long to wait before repeating the last notification. |
| routes<a href="#v1beta1-route-routes" id="v1beta1-route-routes">#</a><br/>_[JSON (v1)](#v1-json) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Child routes.<br />https://prometheus.io/docs/alerting/latest/configuration/#route |

#### Rule {#v1beta1-rule}

Rule describes an alerting or recording rule.

Appears in: [RuleGroup (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-rulegroup)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| alert<a href="#v1beta1-rule-alert" id="v1beta1-rule-alert">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Alert is a name for alert |
| annotations<a href="#v1beta1-rule-annotations" id="v1beta1-rule-annotations">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Annotations will be added to rule configuration |
| debug<a href="#v1beta1-rule-debug" id="v1beta1-rule-debug">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Debug enables logging for rule<br />it useful for tracking |
| expr<a href="#v1beta1-rule-expr" id="v1beta1-rule-expr">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Expr is query, that will be evaluated at dataSource |
| for<a href="#v1beta1-rule-for" id="v1beta1-rule-for">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>For evaluation interval in time.Duration format<br />30s, 1m, 1h  or nanoseconds |
| keep_firing_for<a href="#v1beta1-rule-keep_firing_for" id="v1beta1-rule-keep_firing_for">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>KeepFiringFor will make alert continue firing for this long<br />even when the alerting expression no longer has results.<br />Use time.Duration format, 30s, 1m, 1h  or nanoseconds |
| labels<a href="#v1beta1-rule-labels" id="v1beta1-rule-labels">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Labels will be added to rule configuration |
| record<a href="#v1beta1-rule-record" id="v1beta1-rule-record">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Record represents a query, that will be recorded to dataSource |
| update_entries_limit<a href="#v1beta1-rule-update_entries_limit" id="v1beta1-rule-update_entries_limit">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UpdateEntriesLimit defines max number of rule's state updates stored in memory.<br />Overrides `-rule.updateEntriesLimit` in vmalert. |

#### RuleGroup {#v1beta1-rulegroup}

RuleGroup is a list of sequentially evaluated recording and alerting rules.

Appears in: [VMRuleSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmrulespec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| concurrency<a href="#v1beta1-rulegroup-concurrency" id="v1beta1-rulegroup-concurrency">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Concurrency defines how many rules execute at once. |
| eval_alignment<a href="#v1beta1-rulegroup-eval_alignment" id="v1beta1-rulegroup-eval_alignment">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>Optional<br />The evaluation timestamp will be aligned with group's interval,<br />instead of using the actual timestamp that evaluation happens at.<br />It is enabled by default to get more predictable results<br />and to visually align with graphs plotted via Grafana or vmui. |
| eval_delay<a href="#v1beta1-rulegroup-eval_delay" id="v1beta1-rulegroup-eval_delay">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Optional<br />Adjust the `time` parameter of group evaluation requests to compensate intentional query delay from the datasource. |
| eval_offset<a href="#v1beta1-rulegroup-eval_offset" id="v1beta1-rulegroup-eval_offset">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Optional<br />Group will be evaluated at the exact offset in the range of [0...interval]. |
| headers<a href="#v1beta1-rulegroup-headers" id="v1beta1-rulegroup-headers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Headers contains optional HTTP headers added to each rule request<br />Must be in form `header-name: value`<br />For example:<br /> headers:<br />   - "CustomHeader: foo"<br />   - "CustomHeader2: bar" |
| interval<a href="#v1beta1-rulegroup-interval" id="v1beta1-rulegroup-interval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>evaluation interval for group |
| labels<a href="#v1beta1-rulegroup-labels" id="v1beta1-rulegroup-labels">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Labels optional list of labels added to every rule within a group.<br />It has priority over the external labels.<br />Labels are commonly used for adding environment<br />or tenant-specific tag. |
| limit<a href="#v1beta1-rulegroup-limit" id="v1beta1-rulegroup-limit">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Limit the number of alerts an alerting rule and series a recording<br />rule can produce |
| name<a href="#v1beta1-rulegroup-name" id="v1beta1-rulegroup-name">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Name of group |
| notifier_headers<a href="#v1beta1-rulegroup-notifier_headers" id="v1beta1-rulegroup-notifier_headers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NotifierHeaders contains optional HTTP headers added to each alert request which will send to notifier<br />Must be in form `header-name: value`<br />For example:<br /> headers:<br />   - "CustomHeader: foo"<br />   - "CustomHeader2: bar" |
| params<a href="#v1beta1-rulegroup-params" id="v1beta1-rulegroup-params">#</a><br/>_[Values (url)](#url-values)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Params optional HTTP URL parameters added to each rule request |
| rules<a href="#v1beta1-rulegroup-rules" id="v1beta1-rulegroup-rules">#</a><br/>_[Rule (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-rule) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>Rules list of alert rules.<br />Rules are merged by record and alert fields. |
| tenant<a href="#v1beta1-rulegroup-tenant" id="v1beta1-rulegroup-tenant">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Tenant id for group, can be used only with enterprise version of vmalert.<br />See more details [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert/#multitenancy). |
| type<a href="#v1beta1-rulegroup-type" id="v1beta1-rulegroup-type">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Type defines datasource type for enterprise version of vmalert<br />possible values - prometheus,graphite,vlogs |

StatefulSetUpdateStrategyBehavior customizes behavior for StatefulSet updates.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |

#### StorageSpec {#v1beta1-storagespec}

StorageSpec defines the configured storage for a group VM servers.
If neither `emptyDir` nor `volumeClaimTemplate` is specified, then by default an [EmptyDir](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#emptydir) will be used.

Appears in: [VLAgentSpec (v1)](#v1-vlagentspec), [VLDistributedZoneAgentSpec (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vldistributedzoneagentspec), [VLStorage (v1)](#v1-vlstorage), [VMAgentSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmagentspec), [VMAlertmanagerSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec), [VMAnomalySpec (v1)](#v1-vmanomalyspec), [VMDistributedZoneAgentSpec (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vmdistributedzoneagentspec), [VMSelect (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmselect), [VMStorage (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmstorage), [VTStorage (v1)](#v1-vtstorage)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| emptyDir<a href="#v1beta1-storagespec-emptydir" id="v1beta1-storagespec-emptydir">#</a><br/>_[EmptyDirVolumeSource (v1)](#v1-emptydirvolumesource)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EmptyDirVolumeSource to be used by the Prometheus StatefulSets. If specified, used in place of any volumeClaimTemplate. More<br />info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#emptydir |
| volumeClaimTemplate<a href="#v1beta1-storagespec-volumeclaimtemplate" id="v1beta1-storagespec-volumeclaimtemplate">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedPersistentVolumeClaim (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedpersistentvolumeclaim)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>A PVC spec to be used by the StatefulSets/Deployments. |

#### StreamAggrConfig {#v1beta1-streamaggrconfig}

StreamAggrConfig defines the stream aggregation config

Appears in: [VMAgentRemoteWriteSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec), [VMAgentSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmagentspec), [VMSingleSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmsinglespec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| configmap<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrconfig-configmap" id="v1beta1-streamaggrconfig-configmap">#</a><br/>_[ConfigMapKeySelector (v1)](#v1-configmapkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigMap with stream aggregation rules |
| dedupInterval<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrconfig-dedupinterval" id="v1beta1-streamaggrconfig-dedupinterval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Allows setting different de-duplication intervals per each configured remote storage |
| dropInput<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrconfig-dropinput" id="v1beta1-streamaggrconfig-dropinput">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Allow drop all the input samples after the aggregation |
| dropInputLabels<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrconfig-dropinputlabels" id="v1beta1-streamaggrconfig-dropinputlabels">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>labels to drop from samples for aggregator before stream de-duplication and aggregation |
| enableWindows<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrconfig-enablewindows" id="v1beta1-streamaggrconfig-enablewindows">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableWindows enables aggregating data in separate windows.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0540">v0.54.0</a> |
| ignoreFirstIntervals<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrconfig-ignorefirstintervals" id="v1beta1-streamaggrconfig-ignorefirstintervals">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>IgnoreFirstIntervals instructs to ignore first interval |
| ignoreFirstSampleInterval<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrconfig-ignorefirstsampleinterval" id="v1beta1-streamaggrconfig-ignorefirstsampleinterval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>IgnoreFirstSampleInterval sets interval for total and prometheus_total during which first samples will be ignored |
| ignoreOldSamples<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrconfig-ignoreoldsamples" id="v1beta1-streamaggrconfig-ignoreoldsamples">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>IgnoreOldSamples instructs to ignore samples with old timestamps outside the current aggregation interval. |
| keepInput<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrconfig-keepinput" id="v1beta1-streamaggrconfig-keepinput">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Allows writing both raw and aggregate data |
| rules<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrconfig-rules" id="v1beta1-streamaggrconfig-rules">#</a><br/>_[StreamAggrRule (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-streamaggrrule) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Stream aggregation rules |

#### StreamAggrRule {#v1beta1-streamaggrrule}

StreamAggrRule defines the rule in stream aggregation config

Appears in: [StreamAggrConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-streamaggrconfig)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| by<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrrule-by" id="v1beta1-streamaggrrule-by">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>By is an optional list of labels for grouping input series.<br />See also Without.<br />If neither By nor Without are set, then the Outputs are calculated<br />individually per each input time series. |
| dedup_interval<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrrule-dedup_interval" id="v1beta1-streamaggrrule-dedup_interval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DedupInterval is an optional interval for deduplication. |
| drop_input_labels<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrrule-drop_input_labels" id="v1beta1-streamaggrrule-drop_input_labels">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DropInputLabels is an optional list with labels, which must be dropped before further processing of input samples.<br />Labels are dropped before de-duplication and aggregation. |
| enable_windows<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrrule-enable_windows" id="v1beta1-streamaggrrule-enable_windows">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableWindows enables aggregating data in separate windows |
| flush_on_shutdown<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrrule-flush_on_shutdown" id="v1beta1-streamaggrrule-flush_on_shutdown">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>FlushOnShutdown defines whether to flush the aggregation state on process termination<br />or config reload. Is `false` by default.<br />It is not recommended changing this setting, unless unfinished aggregations states<br />are preferred to missing data points. |
| ignoreFirstSampleInterval<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrrule-ignorefirstsampleinterval" id="v1beta1-streamaggrrule-ignorefirstsampleinterval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>IgnoreFirstSampleInterval sets interval for total and prometheus_total during which first samples will be ignored |
| ignore_first_intervals<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrrule-ignore_first_intervals" id="v1beta1-streamaggrrule-ignore_first_intervals">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Required)_<br/> |
| ignore_old_samples<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrrule-ignore_old_samples" id="v1beta1-streamaggrrule-ignore_old_samples">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>IgnoreOldSamples instructs to ignore samples with old timestamps outside the current aggregation interval. |
| input_relabel_configs<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrrule-input_relabel_configs" id="v1beta1-streamaggrrule-input_relabel_configs">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InputRelabelConfigs is an optional relabeling rules, which are applied on the input<br />before aggregation. |
| interval<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrrule-interval" id="v1beta1-streamaggrrule-interval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Interval is the interval between aggregations. |
| keep_metric_names<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrrule-keep_metric_names" id="v1beta1-streamaggrrule-keep_metric_names">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>KeepMetricNames instructs to leave metric names as is for the output time series without adding any suffix. |
| match<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrrule-match" id="v1beta1-streamaggrrule-match">#</a><br/>_[StringOrArray (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-stringorarray)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Match is a label selector (or list of label selectors) for filtering time series for the given selector.<br />If the match isn't set, then all the input time series are processed. |
| no_align_flush_to_interval<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrrule-no_align_flush_to_interval" id="v1beta1-streamaggrrule-no_align_flush_to_interval">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NoAlignFlushToInterval disables aligning of flushes to multiples of Interval.<br />By default flushes are aligned to Interval. |
| output_relabel_configs<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrrule-output_relabel_configs" id="v1beta1-streamaggrrule-output_relabel_configs">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OutputRelabelConfigs is an optional relabeling rules, which are applied<br />on the aggregated output before being sent to remote storage. |
| outputs<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrrule-outputs" id="v1beta1-streamaggrrule-outputs">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Required)_<br/>Outputs is a list of output aggregate functions to produce.<br />The following names are allowed:<br />- total - aggregates input counters<br />- increase - counts the increase over input counters<br />- count_series - counts the input series<br />- count_samples - counts the input samples<br />- sum_samples - sums the input samples<br />- last - the last biggest sample value<br />- min - the minimum sample value<br />- max - the maximum sample value<br />- avg - the average value across all the samples<br />- stddev - standard deviation across all the samples<br />- stdvar - standard variance across all the samples<br />- histogram_bucket - creates VictoriaMetrics histogram for input samples<br />- quantiles(phi1, ..., phiN) - quantiles' estimation for phi in the range [0..1]<br />The output time series will have the following names:<br />  input_name:aggr_<interval>_<output> |
| staleness_interval<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrrule-staleness_interval" id="v1beta1-streamaggrrule-staleness_interval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Staleness interval is interval after which the series state will be reset if no samples have been sent during it.<br />The parameter is only relevant for outputs: total, total_prometheus, increase, increase_prometheus and histogram_bucket. |
| without<a href="#v1beta1-streamaggrrule-without" id="v1beta1-streamaggrrule-without">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Without is an optional list of labels, which must be excluded when grouping input series.<br />See also By.<br />If neither By nor Without are set, then the Outputs are calculated<br />individually per each input time series. |

| keySecret<a href="#v1beta1-tlsconfig-keysecret" id="v1beta1-tlsconfig-keysecret">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Secret containing the client key file for the targets. |
| serverName<a href="#v1beta1-tlsconfig-servername" id="v1beta1-tlsconfig-servername">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Used to verify the hostname for the targets. |

#### TLSServerConfig {#v1beta1-tlsserverconfig}

TLSServerConfig defines TLS configuration for the application's server

Appears in: [VMAlertmanagerGossipConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmalertmanagergossipconfig), [VMAlertmanagerWebConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerwebconfig)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| cert_file<a href="#v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-cert_file" id="v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-cert_file">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>CertFile defines path to the pre-mounted file with certificate<br />mutually exclusive with CertSecretRef |
| cert_secret_ref<a href="#v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-cert_secret_ref" id="v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-cert_secret_ref">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>CertSecretRef defines reference for secret with certificate content under given key<br />mutually exclusive with CertFile |
| cipher_suites<a href="#v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-cipher_suites" id="v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-cipher_suites">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>CipherSuites defines list of supported cipher suites for TLS versions up to TLS 1.2<br />https://golang.org/pkg/crypto/tls/#pkg-constants |
| client_auth_type<a href="#v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-client_auth_type" id="v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-client_auth_type">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Cert defines reference for secret with CA content under given key<br />mutually exclusive with CertFile<br />ClientAuthType defines server policy for client authentication<br />If you want to enable client authentication (aka mTLS), you need to use RequireAndVerifyClientCert<br />Note, mTLS is supported only at enterprise version of VictoriaMetrics components |
| client_ca_file<a href="#v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-client_ca_file" id="v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-client_ca_file">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ClientCAFile defines path to the pre-mounted file with CA<br />mutually exclusive with ClientCASecretRef |
| client_ca_secret_ref<a href="#v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-client_ca_secret_ref" id="v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-client_ca_secret_ref">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ClientCASecretRef defines reference for secret with CA content under given key<br />mutually exclusive with ClientCAFile |
| curve_preferences<a href="#v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-curve_preferences" id="v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-curve_preferences">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>CurvePreferences defines elliptic curves that will be used in an ECDHE handshake, in preference order.<br />https://golang.org/pkg/crypto/tls/#CurveID |
| key_file<a href="#v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-key_file" id="v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-key_file">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>KeyFile defines path to the pre-mounted file with certificate key<br />mutually exclusive with KeySecretRef |
| key_secret_ref<a href="#v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-key_secret_ref" id="v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-key_secret_ref">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Key defines reference for secret with certificate key content under given key<br />mutually exclusive with KeyFile |
| max_version<a href="#v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-max_version" id="v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-max_version">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MaxVersion maximum TLS version that is acceptable. |
| min_version<a href="#v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-min_version" id="v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-min_version">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MinVersion minimum TLS version that is acceptable. |
| prefer_server_cipher_suites<a href="#v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-prefer_server_cipher_suites" id="v1beta1-tlsserverconfig-prefer_server_cipher_suites">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PreferServerCipherSuites controls whether the server selects the<br />client's most preferred ciphersuite |

| Field | Description |

| basicAuth<a href="#v1beta1-targetendpoint-basicauth" id="v1beta1-targetendpoint-basicauth">#</a><br/>_[BasicAuth (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-basicauth)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>BasicAuth allow an endpoint to authenticate over basic authentication |
| bearerTokenFile<a href="#v1beta1-targetendpoint-bearertokenfile" id="v1beta1-targetendpoint-bearertokenfile">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>File to read bearer token for scraping targets. |
| bearerTokenSecret<a href="#v1beta1-targetendpoint-bearertokensecret" id="v1beta1-targetendpoint-bearertokensecret">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Secret to mount to read bearer token for scraping targets. The secret<br />needs to be in the same namespace as the scrape object and accessible by<br />the victoria-metrics operator. |

| honorTimestamps<a href="#v1beta1-targetendpoint-honortimestamps" id="v1beta1-targetendpoint-honortimestamps">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HonorTimestamps controls whether vmagent or vmsingle respects the timestamps present in scraped data. |

| metricRelabelConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-targetendpoint-metricrelabelconfigs" id="v1beta1-targetendpoint-metricrelabelconfigs">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MetricRelabelConfigs to apply to samples after scrapping. |
| oauth2<a href="#v1beta1-targetendpoint-oauth2" id="v1beta1-targetendpoint-oauth2">#</a><br/>_[OAuth2 (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-oauth2)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OAuth2 defines auth configuration |
| params<a href="#v1beta1-targetendpoint-params" id="v1beta1-targetendpoint-params">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string array)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Optional HTTP URL parameters |
| path<a href="#v1beta1-targetendpoint-path" id="v1beta1-targetendpoint-path">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HTTP path to scrape for metrics. |
| proxyURL<a href="#v1beta1-targetendpoint-proxyurl" id="v1beta1-targetendpoint-proxyurl">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProxyURL eg http://proxyserver:2195 Directs scrapes to proxy through this endpoint. |
| relabelConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-targetendpoint-relabelconfigs" id="v1beta1-targetendpoint-relabelconfigs">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RelabelConfigs to apply to samples during service discovery. |
| sampleLimit<a href="#v1beta1-targetendpoint-samplelimit" id="v1beta1-targetendpoint-samplelimit">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SampleLimit defines per-scrape limit on number of scraped samples that will be accepted. |
| scheme<a href="#v1beta1-targetendpoint-scheme" id="v1beta1-targetendpoint-scheme">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HTTP scheme to use for scraping. |
| scrapeTimeout<a href="#v1beta1-targetendpoint-scrapetimeout" id="v1beta1-targetendpoint-scrapetimeout">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Timeout after which the scrape is ended |
| scrape_interval<a href="#v1beta1-targetendpoint-scrape_interval" id="v1beta1-targetendpoint-scrape_interval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeInterval is the same as Interval and has priority over it.<br />one of scrape_interval or interval can be used |
| seriesLimit<a href="#v1beta1-targetendpoint-serieslimit" id="v1beta1-targetendpoint-serieslimit">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SeriesLimit defines per-scrape limit on number of unique time series<br />a single target can expose during all the scrapes on the time window of 24h. |
| targets<a href="#v1beta1-targetendpoint-targets" id="v1beta1-targetendpoint-targets">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Required)_<br/>Targets static targets addresses in form of ["192.122.55.55:9100","some-name:9100"]. |
| tlsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-targetendpoint-tlsconfig" id="v1beta1-targetendpoint-tlsconfig">#</a><br/>_[TLSConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-tlsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TLSConfig configuration to use when scraping the endpoint |
| vm_scrape_params<a href="#v1beta1-targetendpoint-vm_scrape_params" id="v1beta1-targetendpoint-vm_scrape_params">#</a><br/>_[VMScrapeParams (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmscrapeparams)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VMScrapeParams defines VictoriaMetrics specific scrape parameters |

#### TargetRef {#v1beta1-targetref}

one of target types can be chosen:

user can define multiple targetRefs with different ref Types.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| URLMapCommon<a href="#v1beta1-targetref-urlmapcommon" id="v1beta1-targetref-urlmapcommon">#</a><br/>_[URLMapCommon (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-urlmapcommon)_ | _(Required)_<br/> |
| crd<a href="#v1beta1-targetref-crd" id="v1beta1-targetref-crd">#</a><br/>_[CRDRef (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-crdref)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>CRD describes exist operator's CRD object,<br />operator generates access url based on CRD params. |
| hosts<a href="#v1beta1-targetref-hosts" id="v1beta1-targetref-hosts">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Required)_<br/> |
| name<a href="#v1beta1-targetref-name" id="v1beta1-targetref-name">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Name references item at VMAuths spec.defaultTargetRefs map, with name set other attributes are skipped |
| paths<a href="#v1beta1-targetref-paths" id="v1beta1-targetref-paths">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Paths - matched path to route. |
| query_args<a href="#v1beta1-targetref-query_args" id="v1beta1-targetref-query_args">#</a><br/>_[QueryArg (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-queryarg) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>QueryArgs appends list of query arguments to generated URL |
| static<a href="#v1beta1-targetref-static" id="v1beta1-targetref-static">#</a><br/>_[StaticRef (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-staticref)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Static - user defined url for traffic forward,<br />for instance http://vmsingle:8428 |
| targetRefBasicAuth<a href="#v1beta1-targetref-targetrefbasicauth" id="v1beta1-targetref-targetrefbasicauth">#</a><br/>_[TargetRefBasicAuth (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-targetrefbasicauth)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TargetRefBasicAuth allow an target endpoint to authenticate over basic authentication |
| target_path_suffix<a href="#v1beta1-targetref-target_path_suffix" id="v1beta1-targetref-target_path_suffix">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TargetPathSuffix allows to add some suffix to the target path<br />It allows to hide tenant configuration from user with crd as ref.<br />it also may contain any url encoded params. |

#### URLMapCommon {#v1beta1-urlmapcommon}

URLMapCommon contains common fields for unauthorized user and user in vmuser

| Field | Description |

| drop_src_path_prefix_parts<a href="#v1beta1-urlmapcommon-drop_src_path_prefix_parts" id="v1beta1-urlmapcommon-drop_src_path_prefix_parts">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DropSrcPathPrefixParts is the number of `/`-delimited request path prefix parts to drop before proxying the request to backend.<br />See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#dropping-request-path-prefix) for more details. |
| headers<a href="#v1beta1-urlmapcommon-headers" id="v1beta1-urlmapcommon-headers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RequestHeaders represent additional http headers, that vmauth uses<br />in form of ["header_key: header_value"]<br />multiple values for header key:<br />["header_key: value1,value2"]<br />it's available since 1.68.0 version of vmauth |

| response_headers<a href="#v1beta1-urlmapcommon-response_headers" id="v1beta1-urlmapcommon-response_headers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ResponseHeaders represent additional http headers, that vmauth adds for request response<br />in form of ["header_key: header_value"]<br />multiple values for header key:<br />["header_key: value1,value2"]<br />it's available since 1.93.0 version of vmauth |
| retry_status_codes<a href="#v1beta1-urlmapcommon-retry_status_codes" id="v1beta1-urlmapcommon-retry_status_codes">#</a><br/>_integer array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RetryStatusCodes defines http status codes in numeric format for request retries<br />Can be defined per target or at VMUser.spec level<br />e.g. [429,503] |
| src_headers<a href="#v1beta1-urlmapcommon-src_headers" id="v1beta1-urlmapcommon-src_headers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Required)_<br/>SrcHeaders is an optional list of headers, which must match request headers. |
| src_query_args<a href="#v1beta1-urlmapcommon-src_query_args" id="v1beta1-urlmapcommon-src_query_args">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Required)_<br/>SrcQueryArgs is an optional list of query args, which must match request URL query args. |
