| disableAutomountServiceAccountToken<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableAutomountServiceAccountToken whether to disable serviceAccount auto mount by Kubernetes<br />Operator will conditionally create volumes and volumeMounts for containers if it requires k8s API access.<br />For example, vmagent and vm-config-reloader requires k8s API access.<br />Operator creates volumes with name: "kube-api-access", which can be used as volumeMount for extraContainers if needed.<br />And also adds VolumeMounts at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0540">v0.54.0</a> |
| disableSelfServiceScrape<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-disableselfservicescrape" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-disableselfservicescrape">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableSelfServiceScrape controls creation of VMServiceScrape by operator<br />for the application.<br />Has priority over `VM_DISABLESELFSERVICESCRAPECREATION` operator env variable |
| dnsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-dnsconfig" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-dnsconfig">#</a><br/>_[PodDNSConfig (v1)](#v1-poddnsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Specifies the DNS parameters of a pod.<br />Parameters specified here will be merged to the generated DNS<br />configuration based on DNSPolicy. |
| dnsPolicy<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-dnspolicy" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-dnspolicy">#</a><br/>_[DNSPolicy (v1)](#v1-dnspolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DNSPolicy sets DNS policy for the pod |
| enableServiceLinks<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-enableservicelinks" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-enableservicelinks">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableServiceLinks indicates whether information about services should be injected into pod's<br />environment variables, matching the syntax of Docker links.<br />Optional: Defaults to true. |
| extraArgs<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-extraargs" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-extraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraArgs that will be passed to the application container<br />for example remoteWrite.tmpDataPath: /tmp |
| extraEnvs<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-extraenvs" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-extraenvs">#</a><br/>_[EnvVar (v1)](#v1-envvar) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvs that will be passed to the application container |
| extraEnvsFrom<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-extraenvsfrom" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-extraenvsfrom">#</a><br/>_[EnvFromSource (v1)](#v1-envfromsource) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvsFrom defines source of env variables for the application container<br />could either be secret or configmap |
| futureRetention<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-futureretention" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-futureretention">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>FutureRetention for the stored logs<br />Log entries with timestamps bigger than now+futureRetention are rejected during data ingestion; see https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/#retention |
| hostAliases<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-hostaliases" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-hostaliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliases provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork. |
| hostNetwork<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-hostnetwork" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-hostnetwork">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostNetwork controls whether the pod may use the node network namespace |
| host_aliases<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-host_aliases" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-host_aliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliasesUnderScore provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork.<br />Has Priority over hostAliases field |
| image<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-image" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-image">#</a><br/>_[Image (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-image)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Image - docker image settings<br />if no specified operator uses default version from operator config |
| imagePullSecrets<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-imagepullsecrets" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-imagepullsecrets">#</a><br/>_[LocalObjectReference (v1)](#v1-localobjectreference) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ImagePullSecrets An optional list of references to secrets in the same namespace<br />to use for pulling images from registries<br />see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images/#specifying-imagepullsecrets-on-a-pod |
| initContainers<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-initcontainers" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-initcontainers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InitContainers allows adding initContainers to the pod definition.<br />Any errors during the execution of an initContainer will lead to a restart of the Pod.<br />More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/ |
| livenessProbe<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-livenessprobe" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-livenessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LivenessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| logFormat<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-logformat" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-logformat">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogFormat for VLogs to be configured with. |
| logIngestedRows<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-logingestedrows" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-logingestedrows">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>Whether to log all the ingested log entries; this can be useful for debugging of data ingestion; see https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/data-ingestion/ |
| logLevel<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-loglevel" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-loglevel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogLevel for VictoriaLogs to be configured with. |
| logNewStreams<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-lognewstreams" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-lognewstreams">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>LogNewStreams Whether to log creation of new streams; this can be useful for debugging of high cardinality issues with log streams; see https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/keyconcepts/#stream-fields |
| managedMetadata<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-managedmetadata" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-managedmetadata">#</a><br/>_[ManagedObjectsMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-managedobjectsmetadata)_ | _(Required)_<br/>ManagedMetadata defines metadata that will be added to the all objects<br />created by operator for the given CustomResource |
| minReadySeconds<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-minreadyseconds" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-minreadyseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MinReadySeconds defines a minimum number of seconds to wait before starting update next pod<br />if previous in healthy state<br />Has no effect for VLogs and VMSingle |
| nodeSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-nodeselector" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-nodeselector">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeSelector Define which Nodes the Pods are scheduled on. |
| paused<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-paused" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-paused">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Paused If set to true all actions on the underlying managed objects are not<br />going to be performed, except for delete actions. |
| podMetadata<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-podmetadata" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-podmetadata">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedObjectMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedobjectmetadata)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodMetadata configures Labels and Annotations which are propagated to the VLogs pods. |
| port<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-port" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-port">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Port listen address |
| preStopSleepSeconds<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-prestopsleepseconds" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-prestopsleepseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PreStopSleepSeconds defines the number of seconds to sleep in the preStop lifecycle hook.<br />It gives time for load balancers to remove the pod from rotation before the pod is terminated.<br />Defaults to 15 for applicable components. Set to 0 to disable. |
| priorityClassName<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-priorityclassname" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-priorityclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PriorityClassName class assigned to the Pods |
| readinessGates<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-readinessgates" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-readinessgates">#</a><br/>_[PodReadinessGate (v1)](#v1-podreadinessgate) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>ReadinessGates defines pod readiness gates |
| readinessProbe<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-readinessprobe" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-readinessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReadinessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| removePvcAfterDelete<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-removepvcafterdelete" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-removepvcafterdelete">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RemovePvcAfterDelete - if true, controller adds ownership to pvc<br />and after VLogs object deletion - pvc will be garbage collected<br />by controller manager |
| replicaCount<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-replicacount" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-replicacount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReplicaCount is the expected size of the Application. |
| resources<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-resources" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-resources">#</a><br/>_[ResourceRequirements (v1)](#v1-resourcerequirements)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Resources container resource request and limits, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/<br />if not defined default resources from operator config will be used |
| retentionPeriod<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-retentionperiod" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-retentionperiod">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>RetentionPeriod for the stored logs |
| revisionHistoryLimitCount<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-revisionhistorylimitcount" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-revisionhistorylimitcount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The number of old ReplicaSets to retain to allow rollback in deployment or<br />maximum number of revisions that will be maintained in the Deployment revision history.<br />Has no effect at StatefulSets<br />Defaults to 10. |
| runtimeClassName<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-runtimeclassname" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-runtimeclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RuntimeClassName - defines runtime class for kubernetes pod.<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/ |
| schedulerName<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-schedulername" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-schedulername">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SchedulerName - defines kubernetes scheduler name |
| secrets<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-secrets" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-secrets">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Secrets is a list of Secrets in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/secrets/SECRET_NAME folder |
| securityContext<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-securitycontext" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-securitycontext">#</a><br/>_[SecurityContext (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-securitycontext)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SecurityContext holds pod-level security attributes and common container settings.<br />This defaults to the default PodSecurityContext. |
| serviceAccountName<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-serviceaccountname" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-serviceaccountname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceAccountName is the name of the ServiceAccount to use to run the pods |
| serviceScrapeSpec<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-servicescrapespec" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-servicescrapespec">#</a><br/>_[VMServiceScrapeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeSpec that will be added to vlogs VMServiceScrape spec |
| serviceSpec<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-servicespec" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-servicespec">#</a><br/>_[AdditionalServiceSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-additionalservicespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceSpec that will be added to vlogs service spec |
| startupProbe<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-startupprobe" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-startupprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StartupProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| storage<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-storage" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-storage">#</a><br/>_[PersistentVolumeClaimSpec (v1)](#v1-persistentvolumeclaimspec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Storage is the definition of how storage will be used by the VLogs<br />by default it`s empty dir |
| storageDataPath<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-storagedatapath" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-storagedatapath">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StorageDataPath disables spec.storage option and overrides arg for victoria-logs binary --storageDataPath,<br />its users responsibility to mount proper device into given path. |
| storageMetadata<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-storagemetadata" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-storagemetadata">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedObjectMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedobjectmetadata)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StorageMeta defines annotations and labels attached to PVC for given vlogs CR |
| terminationGracePeriodSeconds<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-terminationgraceperiodseconds" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-terminationgraceperiodseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TerminationGracePeriodSeconds period for container graceful termination |
| tolerations<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-tolerations" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-tolerations">#</a><br/>_[Toleration (v1)](#v1-toleration) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Tolerations If specified, the pod's tolerations. |
| topologySpreadConstraints<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-topologyspreadconstraints" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-topologyspreadconstraints">#</a><br/>_[TopologySpreadConstraint (v1)](#v1-topologyspreadconstraint) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TopologySpreadConstraints embedded kubernetes pod configuration option,<br />controls how pods are spread across your cluster among failure-domains<br />such as regions, zones, nodes, and other user-defined topology domains<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/ |
| useDefaultResources<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-usedefaultresources" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-usedefaultresources">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseDefaultResources controls resource settings<br />By default, operator sets built-in resource requirements |
| useLegacyNaming<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-uselegacynaming" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-uselegacynaming">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseLegacyNaming uses standalone Helm chart naming for managed resources:<br />the CR name is used directly instead of the default "<type>-<name>" convention.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0730">v0.73.0</a> |
| useStrictSecurity<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-usestrictsecurity" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-usestrictsecurity">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseStrictSecurity enables strict security mode for component<br />it restricts disk writes access<br />uses non-root user out of the box<br />drops not needed security permissions |
| volumeMounts<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-volumemounts" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-volumemounts">#</a><br/>_[VolumeMount (v1)](#v1-volumemount) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VolumeMounts allows configuration of additional VolumeMounts on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />VolumeMounts specified will be appended to other VolumeMounts in the Application container |
| volumes<a href="#v1beta1-vlogsspec-volumes" id="v1beta1-vlogsspec-volumes">#</a><br/>_[Volume (v1)](#v1-volume) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Volumes allows configuration of additional volumes on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />Volumes specified will be appended to other volumes that are generated. |

#### VMAccessClaim {#v1beta1-vmaccessclaim}

VMAccessClaim defines vm_access claim parameters used for request templating

Appears in: [VMUserJWT (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmuserjwt)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| logsAccountID<a href="#v1beta1-vmaccessclaim-logsaccountid" id="v1beta1-vmaccessclaim-logsaccountid">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogsAccountID defines accountID to use for logs requests templating |
| logsExtraFilters<a href="#v1beta1-vmaccessclaim-logsextrafilters" id="v1beta1-vmaccessclaim-logsextrafilters">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogsExtraFilters defines a list of logsql filters to apply for logs requests templating |
| logsExtraStreamFilters<a href="#v1beta1-vmaccessclaim-logsextrastreamfilters" id="v1beta1-vmaccessclaim-logsextrastreamfilters">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogsExtraStreamFilters defines a list of logsql stream filters to apply for logs requests templating |
| logsProjectID<a href="#v1beta1-vmaccessclaim-logsprojectid" id="v1beta1-vmaccessclaim-logsprojectid">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogsProjectID defines projectID to use for logs requests templating |
| metricsAccountID<a href="#v1beta1-vmaccessclaim-metricsaccountid" id="v1beta1-vmaccessclaim-metricsaccountid">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MetricsAccountID defines accountID to use for metrics requests templating |
| metricsExtraFilters<a href="#v1beta1-vmaccessclaim-metricsextrafilters" id="v1beta1-vmaccessclaim-metricsextrafilters">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MetricsExtraFilters defines a list of promql filters to apply for metrics requests templating |
| metricsExtraLabels<a href="#v1beta1-vmaccessclaim-metricsextralabels" id="v1beta1-vmaccessclaim-metricsextralabels">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MetricsExtraLabels defines a list of extra labels to apply for metrics requests templating |
| metricsProjectID<a href="#v1beta1-vmaccessclaim-metricsprojectid" id="v1beta1-vmaccessclaim-metricsprojectid">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MetricsProjectID defines projectID to use for metrics requests templating |

#### VMAgent {#v1beta1-vmagent}

VMAgent - is a tiny but brave agent, which helps you collect metrics from various sources and stores them in VictoriaMetrics
or any other Prometheus-compatible storage system that supports the remote_write protocol.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| apiVersion<br/>_string_ | (Required)<br/>`operator.victoriametrics.com/v1beta1` |
| kind<br/>_string_ | (Required)<br/>`VMAgent` |
| metadata<a href="#v1beta1-vmagent-metadata" id="v1beta1-vmagent-metadata">#</a><br/>_[ObjectMeta (v1)](#v1-objectmeta)_ | _(Required)_<br/>Refer to Kubernetes API documentation for fields of `metadata`. |
| spec<a href="#v1beta1-vmagent-spec" id="v1beta1-vmagent-spec">#</a><br/>_[VMAgentSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmagentspec)_ | _(Required)_<br/> |

#### VMAgentRemoteWriteSettings {#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritesettings}

VMAgentRemoteWriteSettings - defines global settings for all remoteWrite urls.

Appears in: [VMAgentSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmagentspec), [VMDistributedZoneAgentSpec (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vmdistributedzoneagentspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| flushInterval<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritesettings-flushinterval" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritesettings-flushinterval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Interval for flushing the data to remote storage. (default 1s) |
| label<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritesettings-label" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritesettings-label">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Labels in the form 'name=value' to add to all the metrics before sending them. This overrides the label if it already exists. |
| maxBlockSize<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritesettings-maxblocksize" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritesettings-maxblocksize">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The maximum size in bytes of unpacked request to send to remote storage |
| maxDiskUsagePerURL<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritesettings-maxdiskusageperurl" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritesettings-maxdiskusageperurl">#</a><br/>_[BytesString (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-bytesstring)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The maximum file-based buffer size in bytes at -remoteWrite.tmpDataPath |
| queues<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritesettings-queues" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritesettings-queues">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The number of concurrent queues |
| showURL<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritesettings-showurl" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritesettings-showurl">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Whether to show -remoteWrite.url in the exported metrics. It is hidden by default, since it can contain sensitive auth info |
| tmpDataPath<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritesettings-tmpdatapath" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritesettings-tmpdatapath">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Path to directory where temporary data for remote write component is stored (default vmagent-remotewrite-data) |
| useMultiTenantMode<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritesettings-usemultitenantmode" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritesettings-usemultitenantmode">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configures vmagent accepting data via the same multitenant endpoints as vminsert at VictoriaMetrics cluster does,<br />see [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/#multitenancy).<br />it's global setting and affects all remote storage configurations |

#### VMAgentRemoteWriteSpec {#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec}

VMAgentRemoteWriteSpec defines the remote storage configuration for VmAgent

Appears in: [VMAgentSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmagentspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| aws<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-aws" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-aws">#</a><br/>_[AWS (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-aws)_ | _(Required)_<br/>AWS describes params specific to AWS cloud |
| basicAuth<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-basicauth" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-basicauth">#</a><br/>_[BasicAuth (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-basicauth)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>BasicAuth allow an endpoint to authenticate over basic authentication |
| bearerTokenSecret<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-bearertokensecret" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-bearertokensecret">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Optional bearer auth token to use for -remoteWrite.url |
| forceVMProto<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-forcevmproto" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-forcevmproto">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ForceVMProto forces using VictoriaMetrics protocol for sending data to -remoteWrite.url |
| headers<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-headers" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-headers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Headers allow configuring custom http headers<br />Must be in form of semicolon separated header with value<br />e.g.<br />headerName: headerValue<br />vmagent supports since 1.79.0 version |
| inlineUrlRelabelConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-inlineurlrelabelconfig" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-inlineurlrelabelconfig">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InlineUrlRelabelConfig defines relabeling config for remoteWriteURL, it can be defined at crd spec. |
| maxDiskUsage<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-maxdiskusage" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-maxdiskusage">#</a><br/>_[BytesString (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-bytesstring)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MaxDiskUsage defines the maximum file-based buffer size in bytes for the given remoteWrite<br />It overrides global configuration defined at remoteWriteSettings.maxDiskUsagePerURL |
| oauth2<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-oauth2" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-oauth2">#</a><br/>_[OAuth2 (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-oauth2)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OAuth2 defines auth configuration |
| proxyURL<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-proxyurl" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-proxyurl">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProxyURL for -remoteWrite.url. Supported proxies: http, https, socks5. Example: socks5://proxy:1234 |
| queues<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-queues" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-queues">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The number of concurrent queues |
| sendTimeout<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-sendtimeout" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-sendtimeout">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Timeout for sending a single block of data to -remoteWrite.url (default 1m0s) |
| streamAggrConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-streamaggrconfig" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-streamaggrconfig">#</a><br/>_[StreamAggrConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-streamaggrconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StreamAggrConfig defines stream aggregation configuration for VMAgent for -remoteWrite.url |
| tlsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-tlsconfig" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-tlsconfig">#</a><br/>_[TLSConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-tlsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TLSConfig describes tls configuration for remote write target |
| url<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-url" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-url">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>URL of the endpoint to send samples to. |
| urlRelabelConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-urlrelabelconfig" id="v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec-urlrelabelconfig">#</a><br/>_[ConfigMapKeySelector (v1)](#v1-configmapkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigMap with relabeling config which is applied to metrics before sending them to the corresponding -remoteWrite.url. |

#### VMAgentSpec {#v1beta1-vmagentspec}

VMAgentSpec defines the desired state of VMAgent

Appears in: [VMAgent (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmagent)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| additionalScrapeConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-additionalscrapeconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-additionalscrapeconfigs">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>AdditionalScrapeConfigs As scrape configs are appended, the user is responsible to make sure it<br />is valid. Note that using this feature may expose the possibility to<br />break upgrades of VMAgent or VMSingle. It is advised to review VMAgent or VMSingle release<br />notes to ensure that no incompatible scrape configs are going to break<br />VMAgent or VMSingle after the upgrade. |
| affinity<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-affinity" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-affinity">#</a><br/>_[Affinity (v1)](#v1-affinity)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Affinity If specified, the pod's scheduling constraints. |
| apiServerConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-apiserverconfig" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-apiserverconfig">#</a><br/>_[APIServerConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-apiserverconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>APIServerConfig allows specifying a host and auth methods to access apiserver.<br />If left empty, VMAgent is assumed to run inside of the cluster<br />and will discover API servers automatically and use the pod's CA certificate<br />and bearer token file at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/. |
| arbitraryFSAccessThroughSMs<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsms" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsms">#</a><br/>_[ArbitraryFSAccessThroughSMsConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsmsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ArbitraryFSAccessThroughSMs configures whether configuration<br />based on EndpointAuth can access arbitrary files on the file system<br />of the VMAgent or VMSingle container e.g. bearer token files, basic auth, tls certs |
| claimTemplates<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-claimtemplates" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-claimtemplates">#</a><br/>_[PersistentVolumeClaim (v1)](#v1-persistentvolumeclaim) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>ClaimTemplates allows adding additional VolumeClaimTemplates for VMAgent in StatefulMode |
| componentVersion<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-componentversion" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-componentversion">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ComponentVersion defines default images tag for all components.<br />it can be overwritten with component specific image.tag value. |
| configMaps<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-configmaps" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-configmaps">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigMaps is a list of ConfigMaps in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/configs/CONFIGMAP_NAME folder |
| configReloadAuthKeySecret<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-configreloadauthkeysecret" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-configreloadauthkeysecret">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloadAuthKeySecret defines optional secret reference authKey for /-/reload API requests.<br />Given secret reference will be added to the application and vm-config-reloader as volume<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0570">v0.57.0</a> |
| configReloaderExtraArgs<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-configreloaderextraargs" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-configreloaderextraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloaderExtraArgs that will be passed to  VMAuths config-reloader container<br />for example resync-interval: "30s" |
| configReloaderImage<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-configreloaderimage" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-configreloaderimage">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloaderImage defines image:tag for config-reloader container |
| configReloaderImageTag<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-configreloaderimagetag" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-configreloaderimagetag">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloaderImageTag defines image:tag for config-reloader container<br/><b>Deprecated: </b>since version <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0670">v0.67.0</a> will be removed in <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0690">v0.69.0</a> use <a href="#vmagentspec-configreloaderimage">configReloaderImage</a> instead<br/> |
| configReloaderResources<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-configreloaderresources" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-configreloaderresources">#</a><br/>_[ResourceRequirements (v1)](#v1-resourcerequirements)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloaderResources config-reloader container resource request and limits, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/<br />if not defined default resources from operator config will be used |
| containers<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-containers" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-containers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Containers property allows to inject additions sidecars or to patch existing containers.<br />It can be useful for proxies, backup, etc. |
| daemonSetMode<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-daemonsetmode" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-daemonsetmode">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DaemonSetMode enables DaemonSet deployment mode instead of Deployment.<br />Supports only VMPodScrape<br />Cannot be used with statefulMode<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0550">v0.55.0</a> |
| daemonSetRollingUpdateStrategyBehavior<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-daemonsetrollingupdatestrategybehavior" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-daemonsetrollingupdatestrategybehavior">#</a><br/>_[RollingUpdateDaemonSet (v1)](#v1-rollingupdatedaemonset)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DaemonSetRollingUpdateStrategyBehavior defines customized behavior for rolling updates.<br />It applies if the DaemonSetUpdateStrategy is set to RollingUpdate, which is the default. |
| daemonSetUpdateStrategy<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-daemonsetupdatestrategy" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-daemonsetupdatestrategy">#</a><br/>_[DaemonSetUpdateStrategyType (v1)](#v1-daemonsetupdatestrategytype)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DaemonSetUpdateStrategy allows configuration for the DaemonSet update strategy type. |
| disableAutomountServiceAccountToken<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableAutomountServiceAccountToken whether to disable serviceAccount auto mount by Kubernetes<br />Operator will conditionally create volumes and volumeMounts for containers if it requires k8s API access.<br />For example, vmagent and vm-config-reloader requires k8s API access.<br />Operator creates volumes with name: "kube-api-access", which can be used as volumeMount for extraContainers if needed.<br />And also adds VolumeMounts at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0540">v0.54.0</a> |
| disableSelfServiceScrape<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-disableselfservicescrape" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-disableselfservicescrape">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableSelfServiceScrape controls creation of VMServiceScrape by operator<br />for the application.<br />Has priority over `VM_DISABLESELFSERVICESCRAPECREATION` operator env variable |
| dnsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-dnsconfig" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-dnsconfig">#</a><br/>_[PodDNSConfig (v1)](#v1-poddnsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Specifies the DNS parameters of a pod.<br />Parameters specified here will be merged to the generated DNS<br />configuration based on DNSPolicy. |
| dnsPolicy<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-dnspolicy" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-dnspolicy">#</a><br/>_[DNSPolicy (v1)](#v1-dnspolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DNSPolicy sets DNS policy for the pod |
| enableKubernetesAPISelectors<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-enablekubernetesapiselectors" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-enablekubernetesapiselectors">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableKubernetesAPISelectors instructs vmagent or vmsingle to use CRD scrape objects spec.selectors for<br />Kubernetes API list and watch requests.<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/#list-and-watch-filtering<br />It could be useful to reduce Kubernetes API server resource usage for serving less than 100 CRD scrape objects in total. |
| enableServiceLinks<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-enableservicelinks" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-enableservicelinks">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableServiceLinks indicates whether information about services should be injected into pod's<br />environment variables, matching the syntax of Docker links.<br />Optional: Defaults to true. |
| enforcedNamespaceLabel<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-enforcednamespacelabel" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-enforcednamespacelabel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnforcedNamespaceLabel enforces adding a namespace label of origin for each alert<br />and metric that is user created. The label value will always be the namespace of the object that is<br />being created. |
| externalLabelName<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-externallabelname" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-externallabelname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExternalLabelName Name of external label used to denote scraping agent instance<br />name. Defaults to the value of `prometheus`. External label will<br />_not_ be added when value is set to empty string (`""`). |
| externalLabels<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-externallabels" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-externallabels">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExternalLabels The labels to add to any time series scraped by vmagent or vmsingle.<br />it doesn't affect metrics ingested directly by push API's |
| extraArgs<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-extraargs" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-extraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraArgs that will be passed to the application container<br />for example remoteWrite.tmpDataPath: /tmp |
| extraEnvs<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-extraenvs" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-extraenvs">#</a><br/>_[EnvVar (v1)](#v1-envvar) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvs that will be passed to the application container |
| extraEnvsFrom<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-extraenvsfrom" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-extraenvsfrom">#</a><br/>_[EnvFromSource (v1)](#v1-envfromsource) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvsFrom defines source of env variables for the application container<br />could either be secret or configmap |
| globalScrapeMetricRelabelConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-globalscrapemetricrelabelconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-globalscrapemetricrelabelconfigs">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>GlobalScrapeMetricRelabelConfigs is a global metric relabel configuration, which is applied to each scrape job. |
| globalScrapeRelabelConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-globalscraperelabelconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-globalscraperelabelconfigs">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>GlobalScrapeRelabelConfigs is a global relabel configuration, which is applied to each samples of each scrape job during service discovery. |
| hostAliases<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-hostaliases" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-hostaliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliases provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork. |
| hostNetwork<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-hostnetwork" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-hostnetwork">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostNetwork controls whether the pod may use the node network namespace |
| host_aliases<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-host_aliases" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-host_aliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliasesUnderScore provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork.<br />Has Priority over hostAliases field |
| hpa<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-hpa" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-hpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedHPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedhpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configures horizontal pod autoscaling. |
| ignoreNamespaceSelectors<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-ignorenamespaceselectors" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-ignorenamespaceselectors">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>IgnoreNamespaceSelectors if set to true will ignore NamespaceSelector settings from<br />scrape objects, and they will only discover endpoints<br />within their current namespace. Defaults to false. |
| image<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-image" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-image">#</a><br/>_[Image (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-image)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Image - docker image settings<br />if no specified operator uses default version from operator config |
| imagePullSecrets<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-imagepullsecrets" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-imagepullsecrets">#</a><br/>_[LocalObjectReference (v1)](#v1-localobjectreference) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ImagePullSecrets An optional list of references to secrets in the same namespace<br />to use for pulling images from registries<br />see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images/#specifying-imagepullsecrets-on-a-pod |
| ingestOnlyMode<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-ingestonlymode" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-ingestonlymode">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>IngestOnlyMode switches vmagent or vmsingle into unmanaged mode<br />it disables any config generation for scraping<br />Currently it prevents vmagent or vmsingle from managing tls and auth options for remote write |
| initContainers<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-initcontainers" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-initcontainers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InitContainers allows adding initContainers to the pod definition.<br />Any errors during the execution of an initContainer will lead to a restart of the Pod.<br />More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/ |
| inlineRelabelConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-inlinerelabelconfig" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-inlinerelabelconfig">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InlineRelabelConfig - defines GlobalRelabelConfig for vmagent, can be defined directly at CRD. |
| inlineScrapeConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-inlinescrapeconfig" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-inlinescrapeconfig">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InlineScrapeConfig As scrape configs are appended, the user is responsible to make sure it<br />is valid. Note that using this feature may expose the possibility to<br />break upgrades of VMAgent or VMSingle. It is advised to review VMAgent or VMSingle release<br />notes to ensure that no incompatible scrape configs are going to break<br />VMAgent or VMSingle after the upgrade.<br />it should be defined as single yaml file.<br />inlineScrapeConfig: \|<br />    - job_name: "prometheus"<br />      static_configs:<br />      - targets: ["localhost:9090"] |
| insertPorts<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-insertports" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-insertports">#</a><br/>_[InsertPorts (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-insertports)_ | _(Required)_<br/>InsertPorts - additional listen ports for data ingestion. |
| license<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-license" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-license">#</a><br/>_[License (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-license)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>License allows to configure license key to be used for enterprise features.<br />Using license key is supported starting from VictoriaMetrics v1.94.0.<br />See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/enterprise/) |
| livenessProbe<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-livenessprobe" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-livenessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LivenessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| logFormat<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-logformat" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-logformat">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogFormat for VMAgent to be configured with. |
| logLevel<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-loglevel" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-loglevel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogLevel for VMAgent to be configured with.<br />INFO, WARN, ERROR, FATAL, PANIC |
| managedMetadata<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-managedmetadata" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-managedmetadata">#</a><br/>_[ManagedObjectsMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-managedobjectsmetadata)_ | _(Required)_<br/>ManagedMetadata defines metadata that will be added to the all objects<br />created by operator for the given CustomResource |
| maxScrapeInterval<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-maxscrapeinterval" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-maxscrapeinterval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>MaxScrapeInterval allows limiting maximum scrape interval for VMServiceScrape, VMPodScrape and other scrapes<br />If interval is higher than defined limit, `maxScrapeInterval` will be used. |
| minReadySeconds<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-minreadyseconds" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-minreadyseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MinReadySeconds defines a minimum number of seconds to wait before starting update next pod<br />if previous in healthy state<br />Has no effect for VLogs and VMSingle |
| minScrapeInterval<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-minscrapeinterval" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-minscrapeinterval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>MinScrapeInterval allows limiting minimal scrape interval for VMServiceScrape, VMPodScrape and other scrapes<br />If interval is lower than defined limit, `minScrapeInterval` will be used. |
| networkPolicy<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-networkpolicy" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-networkpolicy">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedNetworkPolicy (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddednetworkpolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NetworkPolicy defines network access rules for pods created by this CR. |
| nodeScrapeNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-nodescrapenamespaceselector" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-nodescrapenamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeScrapeNamespaceSelector defines Namespaces to be selected for VMNodeScrape discovery.<br />Works in combination with Selector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| nodeScrapeRelabelTemplate<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-nodescraperelabeltemplate" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-nodescraperelabeltemplate">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeScrapeRelabelTemplate defines relabel config, that will be added to each VMNodeScrape.<br />it's useful for adding specific labels to all targets |
| nodeScrapeSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-nodescrapeselector" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-nodescrapeselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeScrapeSelector defines VMNodeScrape to be selected for scraping.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| nodeSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-nodeselector" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-nodeselector">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeSelector Define which Nodes the Pods are scheduled on. |
| overrideHonorLabels<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-overridehonorlabels" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-overridehonorlabels">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OverrideHonorLabels if set to true overrides all user configured honor_labels.<br />If HonorLabels is set in scrape objects to true, this overrides honor_labels to false. |
| overrideHonorTimestamps<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-overridehonortimestamps" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-overridehonortimestamps">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OverrideHonorTimestamps allows to globally enforce honoring timestamps in all scrape configs. |
| paused<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-paused" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-paused">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Paused If set to true all actions on the underlying managed objects are not<br />going to be performed, except for delete actions. |
| persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-persistentvolumeclaimretentionpolicy" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-persistentvolumeclaimretentionpolicy">#</a><br/>_[StatefulSetPersistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy (v1)](#v1-statefulsetpersistentvolumeclaimretentionpolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PersistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy allows configuration of PVC retention policy |
| podDisruptionBudget<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-poddisruptionbudget" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-poddisruptionbudget">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedPodDisruptionBudgetSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedpoddisruptionbudgetspec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodDisruptionBudget created by operator |
| podMetadata<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-podmetadata" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-podmetadata">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedObjectMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedobjectmetadata)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodMetadata configures Labels and Annotations which are propagated to the vmagent pods. |
| podScrapeNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-podscrapenamespaceselector" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-podscrapenamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodScrapeNamespaceSelector defines Namespaces to be selected for VMPodScrape discovery.<br />Works in combination with Selector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| podScrapeRelabelTemplate<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-podscraperelabeltemplate" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-podscraperelabeltemplate">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodScrapeRelabelTemplate defines relabel config, that will be added to each VMPodScrape.<br />it's useful for adding specific labels to all targets |
| podScrapeSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-podscrapeselector" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-podscrapeselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodScrapeSelector defines PodScrapes to be selected for target discovery.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| port<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-port" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-port">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Port listen address |
| preStopSleepSeconds<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-prestopsleepseconds" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-prestopsleepseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PreStopSleepSeconds defines the number of seconds to sleep in the preStop lifecycle hook.<br />It gives time for load balancers to remove the pod from rotation before the pod is terminated.<br />Defaults to 15 for applicable components. Set to 0 to disable. |
| priorityClassName<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-priorityclassname" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-priorityclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PriorityClassName class assigned to the Pods |
| probeNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-probenamespaceselector" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-probenamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProbeNamespaceSelector defines Namespaces to be selected for VMProbe discovery.<br />Works in combination with Selector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| probeScrapeRelabelTemplate<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-probescraperelabeltemplate" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-probescraperelabeltemplate">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProbeScrapeRelabelTemplate defines relabel config, that will be added to each VMProbeScrape.<br />it's useful for adding specific labels to all targets |
| probeSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-probeselector" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-probeselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProbeSelector defines VMProbe to be selected for target probing.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| readinessGates<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-readinessgates" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-readinessgates">#</a><br/>_[PodReadinessGate (v1)](#v1-podreadinessgate) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>ReadinessGates defines pod readiness gates |
| readinessProbe<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-readinessprobe" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-readinessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReadinessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| relabelConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-relabelconfig" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-relabelconfig">#</a><br/>_[ConfigMapKeySelector (v1)](#v1-configmapkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RelabelConfig ConfigMap with global relabel config -remoteWrite.relabelConfig<br />This relabeling is applied to all the collected metrics before sending them to remote storage. |
| remoteWrite<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-remotewrite" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-remotewrite">#</a><br/>_[VMAgentRemoteWriteSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritespec) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>RemoteWrite list of victoria metrics /some other remote write system<br />for vm it must looks like: http://victoria-metrics-single:8428/api/v1/write<br />or for cluster different url<br />https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/#splitting-data-streams-among-multiple-systems |
| remoteWriteSettings<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-remotewritesettings" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-remotewritesettings">#</a><br/>_[VMAgentRemoteWriteSettings (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmagentremotewritesettings)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RemoteWriteSettings defines global settings for all remoteWrite urls. |
| replicaCount<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-replicacount" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-replicacount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReplicaCount is the expected size of the Application. |
| resources<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-resources" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-resources">#</a><br/>_[ResourceRequirements (v1)](#v1-resourcerequirements)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Resources container resource request and limits, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/<br />if not defined default resources from operator config will be used |
| revisionHistoryLimitCount<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-revisionhistorylimitcount" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-revisionhistorylimitcount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The number of old ReplicaSets to retain to allow rollback in deployment or<br />maximum number of revisions that will be maintained in the Deployment revision history.<br />Has no effect at StatefulSets<br />Defaults to 10. |
| rollingUpdate<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-rollingupdate" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-rollingupdate">#</a><br/>_[RollingUpdateDeployment (v1)](#v1-rollingupdatedeployment)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RollingUpdate - overrides deployment update params. |
| runtimeClassName<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-runtimeclassname" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-runtimeclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RuntimeClassName - defines runtime class for kubernetes pod.<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/ |
| sampleLimit<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-samplelimit" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-samplelimit">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SampleLimit defines global per target limit of scraped samples |
| schedulerName<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-schedulername" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-schedulername">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SchedulerName - defines kubernetes scheduler name |
| scrapeClasses<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-scrapeclasses" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-scrapeclasses">#</a><br/>_[ScrapeClass (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-scrapeclass) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeClasses defines the list of scrape classes to expose to scraping objects such as<br />PodScrapes, ServiceScrapes, Probes and ScrapeConfigs. |
| scrapeConfigNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-scrapeconfignamespaceselector" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-scrapeconfignamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeConfigNamespaceSelector defines Namespaces to be selected for VMScrapeConfig discovery.<br />Works in combination with Selector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| scrapeConfigRelabelTemplate<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-scrapeconfigrelabeltemplate" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-scrapeconfigrelabeltemplate">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeConfigRelabelTemplate defines relabel config, that will be added to each VMScrapeConfig.<br />it's useful for adding specific labels to all targets |
| scrapeConfigSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-scrapeconfigselector" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-scrapeconfigselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeConfigSelector defines VMScrapeConfig to be selected for target discovery.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector. |
| scrapeInterval<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-scrapeinterval" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-scrapeinterval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeInterval defines how often scrape targets by default |
| scrapeTimeout<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-scrapetimeout" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-scrapetimeout">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeTimeout defines global timeout for targets scrape |
| secrets<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-secrets" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-secrets">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Secrets is a list of Secrets in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/secrets/SECRET_NAME folder |
| securityContext<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-securitycontext" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-securitycontext">#</a><br/>_[SecurityContext (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-securitycontext)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SecurityContext holds pod-level security attributes and common container settings.<br />This defaults to the default PodSecurityContext. |
| selectAllByDefault<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-selectallbydefault" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-selectallbydefault">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SelectAllByDefault changes default behavior for empty CRD selectors, such ServiceScrapeSelector.<br />with selectAllByDefault: true and empty serviceScrapeSelector and ServiceScrapeNamespaceSelector<br />Operator selects all exist serviceScrapes<br />with selectAllByDefault: false - selects nothing |
| serviceAccountName<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-serviceaccountname" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-serviceaccountname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceAccountName is the name of the ServiceAccount to use to run the pods |
| serviceScrapeNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-servicescrapenamespaceselector" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-servicescrapenamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeNamespaceSelector Namespaces to be selected for VMServiceScrape discovery.<br />Works in combination with Selector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| serviceScrapeRelabelTemplate<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-servicescraperelabeltemplate" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-servicescraperelabeltemplate">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeRelabelTemplate defines relabel config, that will be added to each VMServiceScrape.<br />it's useful for adding specific labels to all targets |
| serviceScrapeSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-servicescrapeselector" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-servicescrapeselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeSelector defines ServiceScrapes to be selected for target discovery.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| serviceScrapeSpec<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-servicescrapespec" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-servicescrapespec">#</a><br/>_[VMServiceScrapeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeSpec that will be added to vmagent VMServiceScrape spec |
| serviceSpec<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-servicespec" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-servicespec">#</a><br/>_[AdditionalServiceSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-additionalservicespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceSpec that will be added to vmagent service spec |
| shardCount<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-shardcount" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-shardcount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ShardCount - numbers of shards of VMAgent<br />in this case operator will use 1 deployment/sts per shard with<br />replicas count according to spec.replicas,<br />see [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/#scraping-big-number-of-targets) |
| startupProbe<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-startupprobe" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-startupprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StartupProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| statefulMode<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-statefulmode" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-statefulmode">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StatefulMode enables StatefulSet for `VMAgent` instead of Deployment<br />it allows using persistent storage for vmagent's persistentQueue |
| statefulRollingUpdateStrategy<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-statefulrollingupdatestrategy" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-statefulrollingupdatestrategy">#</a><br/>_[StatefulSetUpdateStrategyType (v1)](#v1-statefulsetupdatestrategytype)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StatefulRollingUpdateStrategy allows configuration for strategyType<br />set it to RollingUpdate for disabling operator statefulSet rollingUpdate |
| statefulRollingUpdateStrategyBehavior<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-statefulrollingupdatestrategybehavior" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-statefulrollingupdatestrategybehavior">#</a><br/>_[StatefulSetUpdateStrategyBehavior (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-statefulsetupdatestrategybehavior)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StatefulRollingUpdateStrategyBehavior defines customized behavior for rolling updates.<br />It applies if the RollingUpdateStrategy is set to OnDelete, which is the default. |
| statefulStorage<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-statefulstorage" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-statefulstorage">#</a><br/>_[StorageSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-storagespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StatefulStorage configures storage for StatefulSet |
| staticScrapeNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-staticscrapenamespaceselector" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-staticscrapenamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StaticScrapeNamespaceSelector defines Namespaces to be selected for VMStaticScrape discovery.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| staticScrapeRelabelTemplate<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-staticscraperelabeltemplate" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-staticscraperelabeltemplate">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StaticScrapeRelabelTemplate defines relabel config, that will be added to each VMStaticScrape.<br />it's useful for adding specific labels to all targets |
| staticScrapeSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-staticscrapeselector" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-staticscrapeselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StaticScrapeSelector defines VMStaticScrape to be selected for target discovery.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />If both nil - match everything.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces. |
| streamAggrConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-streamaggrconfig" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-streamaggrconfig">#</a><br/>_[StreamAggrConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-streamaggrconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StreamAggrConfig defines global stream aggregation configuration for VMAgent |
| terminationGracePeriodSeconds<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-terminationgraceperiodseconds" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-terminationgraceperiodseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TerminationGracePeriodSeconds period for container graceful termination |
| tolerations<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-tolerations" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-tolerations">#</a><br/>_[Toleration (v1)](#v1-toleration) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Tolerations If specified, the pod's tolerations. |
| topologySpreadConstraints<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-topologyspreadconstraints" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-topologyspreadconstraints">#</a><br/>_[TopologySpreadConstraint (v1)](#v1-topologyspreadconstraint) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TopologySpreadConstraints embedded kubernetes pod configuration option,<br />controls how pods are spread across your cluster among failure-domains<br />such as regions, zones, nodes, and other user-defined topology domains<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/ |
| updateStrategy<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-updatestrategy" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-updatestrategy">#</a><br/>_[DeploymentStrategyType (v1)](#v1-deploymentstrategytype)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UpdateStrategy - overrides default update strategy.<br />works only for deployments, statefulset always use OnDelete. |
| useDefaultResources<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-usedefaultresources" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-usedefaultresources">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseDefaultResources controls resource settings<br />By default, operator sets built-in resource requirements |
| useLegacyNaming<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-uselegacynaming" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-uselegacynaming">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseLegacyNaming uses standalone Helm chart naming for managed resources:<br />the CR name is used directly instead of the default "<type>-<name>" convention.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0730">v0.73.0</a> |
| useStrictSecurity<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-usestrictsecurity" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-usestrictsecurity">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseStrictSecurity enables strict security mode for component<br />it restricts disk writes access<br />uses non-root user out of the box<br />drops not needed security permissions |
| useVMConfigReloader<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-usevmconfigreloader" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-usevmconfigreloader">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseVMConfigReloader replaces prometheus-like config-reloader<br />with vm one. It uses secrets watch instead of file watch<br />which greatly increases speed of config updates<br/><b>Deprecated: </b>will be removed in <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0670">v0.67.0</a><br/> |
| vmAgentExternalLabelName<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-vmagentexternallabelname" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-vmagentexternallabelname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VMAgentExternalLabelName Name of vmAgent external label used to denote vmAgent instance<br />name. Defaults to the value of `prometheus`. External label will<br />_not_ be added when value is set to empty string (`""`).<br/><b>Deprecated: </b>since version <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0670">v0.67.0</a> will be removed in <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0690">v0.69.0</a> use <a href="#vmagentspec-externallabelname">externalLabelName</a> instead<br/> |
| volumeMounts<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-volumemounts" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-volumemounts">#</a><br/>_[VolumeMount (v1)](#v1-volumemount) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VolumeMounts allows configuration of additional VolumeMounts on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />VolumeMounts specified will be appended to other VolumeMounts in the Application container |
| volumes<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-volumes" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-volumes">#</a><br/>_[Volume (v1)](#v1-volume) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Volumes allows configuration of additional volumes on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />Volumes specified will be appended to other volumes that are generated. |
| vpa<a href="#v1beta1-vmagentspec-vpa" id="v1beta1-vmagentspec-vpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedVPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedvpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configures vertical pod autoscaling. |

#### VMAlert {#v1beta1-vmalert}

VMAlert  executes a list of given alerting or recording rules against configured address.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| apiVersion<br/>_string_ | (Required)<br/>`operator.victoriametrics.com/v1beta1` |
| kind<br/>_string_ | (Required)<br/>`VMAlert` |
| metadata<a href="#v1beta1-vmalert-metadata" id="v1beta1-vmalert-metadata">#</a><br/>_[ObjectMeta (v1)](#v1-objectmeta)_ | _(Required)_<br/>Refer to Kubernetes API documentation for fields of `metadata`. |
| spec<a href="#v1beta1-vmalert-spec" id="v1beta1-vmalert-spec">#</a><br/>_[VMAlertSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmalertspec)_ | _(Required)_<br/> |

#### VMAlertDatasourceSpec {#v1beta1-vmalertdatasourcespec}

VMAlertDatasourceSpec defines the remote storage configuration for VmAlert to read alerts from

Appears in: [VMAlertSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmalertspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| basicAuth<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertdatasourcespec-basicauth" id="v1beta1-vmalertdatasourcespec-basicauth">#</a><br/>_[BasicAuth (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-basicauth)_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |
| headers<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertdatasourcespec-headers" id="v1beta1-vmalertdatasourcespec-headers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Headers allow configuring custom http headers<br />Must be in form of semicolon separated header with value<br />e.g.<br />headerName:headerValue<br />vmalert supports it since 1.79.0 version |
| oauth2<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertdatasourcespec-oauth2" id="v1beta1-vmalertdatasourcespec-oauth2">#</a><br/>_[OAuth2 (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-oauth2)_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |
| tlsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertdatasourcespec-tlsconfig" id="v1beta1-vmalertdatasourcespec-tlsconfig">#</a><br/>_[TLSConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-tlsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |
| url<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertdatasourcespec-url" id="v1beta1-vmalertdatasourcespec-url">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Victoria Metrics or VMSelect url. Required parameter. E.g. http://127.0.0.1:8428 |

| headers<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertnotifierspec-headers" id="v1beta1-vmalertnotifierspec-headers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Headers allow configuring custom http headers<br />Must be in form of semicolon separated header with value<br />e.g.<br />headerName:headerValue<br />vmalert supports it since 1.79.0 version |
| oauth2<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertnotifierspec-oauth2" id="v1beta1-vmalertnotifierspec-oauth2">#</a><br/>_[OAuth2 (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-oauth2)_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |

| Field | Description |

#### VMAlertRemoteWriteSpec {#v1beta1-vmalertremotewritespec}

VMAlertRemoteWriteSpec defines the remote storage configuration for VmAlert

Appears in: [VMAlertSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmalertspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| basicAuth<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertremotewritespec-basicauth" id="v1beta1-vmalertremotewritespec-basicauth">#</a><br/>_[BasicAuth (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-basicauth)_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |
| concurrency<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertremotewritespec-concurrency" id="v1beta1-vmalertremotewritespec-concurrency">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Defines number of readers that concurrently write into remote storage (default 1) |
| flushInterval<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertremotewritespec-flushinterval" id="v1beta1-vmalertremotewritespec-flushinterval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Defines interval of flushes to remote write endpoint (default 5s) |
| headers<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertremotewritespec-headers" id="v1beta1-vmalertremotewritespec-headers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Headers allow configuring custom http headers<br />Must be in form of semicolon separated header with value<br />e.g.<br />headerName:headerValue<br />vmalert supports it since 1.79.0 version |
| maxBatchSize<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertremotewritespec-maxbatchsize" id="v1beta1-vmalertremotewritespec-maxbatchsize">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Defines defines max number of timeseries to be flushed at once (default 1000) |
| maxQueueSize<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertremotewritespec-maxqueuesize" id="v1beta1-vmalertremotewritespec-maxqueuesize">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Defines the max number of pending datapoints to remote write endpoint (default 100000) |
| oauth2<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertremotewritespec-oauth2" id="v1beta1-vmalertremotewritespec-oauth2">#</a><br/>_[OAuth2 (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-oauth2)_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |
| tlsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertremotewritespec-tlsconfig" id="v1beta1-vmalertremotewritespec-tlsconfig">#</a><br/>_[TLSConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-tlsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |
| url<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertremotewritespec-url" id="v1beta1-vmalertremotewritespec-url">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>URL of the endpoint to send samples to. |

#### VMAlertSpec {#v1beta1-vmalertspec}

VMAlertSpec defines the desired state of VMAlert

Appears in: [VMAlert (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmalert)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| affinity<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-affinity" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-affinity">#</a><br/>_[Affinity (v1)](#v1-affinity)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Affinity If specified, the pod's scheduling constraints. |
| componentVersion<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-componentversion" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-componentversion">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ComponentVersion defines default images tag for all components.<br />it can be overwritten with component specific image.tag value. |
| configMaps<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-configmaps" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-configmaps">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigMaps is a list of ConfigMaps in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/configs/CONFIGMAP_NAME folder |
| configReloadAuthKeySecret<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-configreloadauthkeysecret" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-configreloadauthkeysecret">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloadAuthKeySecret defines optional secret reference authKey for /-/reload API requests.<br />Given secret reference will be added to the application and vm-config-reloader as volume<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0570">v0.57.0</a> |
| configReloaderExtraArgs<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-configreloaderextraargs" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-configreloaderextraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloaderExtraArgs that will be passed to  VMAuths config-reloader container<br />for example resync-interval: "30s" |
| configReloaderImage<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-configreloaderimage" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-configreloaderimage">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloaderImage defines image:tag for config-reloader container |
| configReloaderImageTag<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-configreloaderimagetag" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-configreloaderimagetag">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloaderImageTag defines image:tag for config-reloader container<br/><b>Deprecated: </b>since version <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0670">v0.67.0</a> will be removed in <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0690">v0.69.0</a> use <a href="#vmalertspec-configreloaderimage">configReloaderImage</a> instead<br/> |
| configReloaderResources<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-configreloaderresources" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-configreloaderresources">#</a><br/>_[ResourceRequirements (v1)](#v1-resourcerequirements)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloaderResources config-reloader container resource request and limits, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/<br />if not defined default resources from operator config will be used |
| containers<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-containers" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-containers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Containers property allows to inject additions sidecars or to patch existing containers.<br />It can be useful for proxies, backup, etc. |
| datasource<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-datasource" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-datasource">#</a><br/>_[VMAlertDatasourceSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmalertdatasourcespec)_ | _(Required)_<br/>Datasource Victoria Metrics or VMSelect url. Required parameter. e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8428 |
| disableAutomountServiceAccountToken<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableAutomountServiceAccountToken whether to disable serviceAccount auto mount by Kubernetes<br />Operator will conditionally create volumes and volumeMounts for containers if it requires k8s API access.<br />For example, vmagent and vm-config-reloader requires k8s API access.<br />Operator creates volumes with name: "kube-api-access", which can be used as volumeMount for extraContainers if needed.<br />And also adds VolumeMounts at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0540">v0.54.0</a> |
| disableSelfServiceScrape<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-disableselfservicescrape" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-disableselfservicescrape">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableSelfServiceScrape controls creation of VMServiceScrape by operator<br />for the application.<br />Has priority over `VM_DISABLESELFSERVICESCRAPECREATION` operator env variable |
| dnsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-dnsconfig" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-dnsconfig">#</a><br/>_[PodDNSConfig (v1)](#v1-poddnsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Specifies the DNS parameters of a pod.<br />Parameters specified here will be merged to the generated DNS<br />configuration based on DNSPolicy. |
| dnsPolicy<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-dnspolicy" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-dnspolicy">#</a><br/>_[DNSPolicy (v1)](#v1-dnspolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DNSPolicy sets DNS policy for the pod |
| enableServiceLinks<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-enableservicelinks" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-enableservicelinks">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableServiceLinks indicates whether information about services should be injected into pod's<br />environment variables, matching the syntax of Docker links.<br />Optional: Defaults to true. |
| enforcedNamespaceLabel<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-enforcednamespacelabel" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-enforcednamespacelabel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnforcedNamespaceLabel enforces adding a namespace label of origin for each alert<br />and metric that is user created. The label value will always be the namespace of the object that is<br />being created. |
| evaluationInterval<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-evaluationinterval" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-evaluationinterval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EvaluationInterval defines how often to evaluate rules by default |
| externalLabels<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-externallabels" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-externallabels">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExternalLabels in the form 'name: value' to add to all generated recording rules and alerts. |
| extraArgs<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-extraargs" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-extraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraArgs that will be passed to the application container<br />for example remoteWrite.tmpDataPath: /tmp |

| hostAliases<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-hostaliases" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-hostaliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliases provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork. |
| hostNetwork<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-hostnetwork" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-hostnetwork">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostNetwork controls whether the pod may use the node network namespace |
| host_aliases<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-host_aliases" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-host_aliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliasesUnderScore provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork.<br />Has Priority over hostAliases field |
