| initContainers<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-initcontainers" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-initcontainers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InitContainers allows adding initContainers to the pod definition.<br />Any errors during the execution of an initContainer will lead to a restart of the Pod.<br />More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/ |
| license<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-license" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-license">#</a><br/>_[License (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-license)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>License allows to configure license key to be used for enterprise features.<br />Using license key is supported starting from VictoriaMetrics v1.94.0.<br />See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/enterprise/) |

| logFormat<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-logformat" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-logformat">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogFormat for VMAlert to be configured with.<br />default or json |

| readinessProbe<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-readinessprobe" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-readinessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReadinessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| remoteRead<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-remoteread" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-remoteread">#</a><br/>_[VMAlertRemoteReadSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmalertremotereadspec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RemoteRead Optional URL to read vmalert state (persisted via RemoteWrite)<br />This configuration only makes sense if alerts state has been successfully<br />persisted (via RemoteWrite) before.<br />see -remoteRead.url docs in vmalerts for details.<br />E.g. http://127.0.0.1:8428 |

| resources<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-resources" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-resources">#</a><br/>_[ResourceRequirements (v1)](#v1-resourcerequirements)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Resources container resource request and limits, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/<br />if not defined default resources from operator config will be used |
| revisionHistoryLimitCount<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-revisionhistorylimitcount" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-revisionhistorylimitcount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The number of old ReplicaSets to retain to allow rollback in deployment or<br />maximum number of revisions that will be maintained in the Deployment revision history.<br />Has no effect at StatefulSets<br />Defaults to 10. |

Flag can be specified multiple times.<br />Examples:<br />-rule /path/to/file. Path to a single file with alerting rules<br />-rule dir/*.yaml -rule /*.yaml. Relative path to all .yaml files in folder,<br />absolute path to all .yaml files in root.<br />by default operator adds /etc/vmalert/configs/base/vmalert.yaml |
| ruleSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-ruleselector" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-ruleselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RuleSelector selector to select which VMRules to mount for loading alerting<br />rules from.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAlert namespace. |
| runtimeClassName<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-runtimeclassname" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-runtimeclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RuntimeClassName - defines runtime class for kubernetes pod.<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/ |
| schedulerName<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-schedulername" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-schedulername">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SchedulerName - defines kubernetes scheduler name |
| secrets<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-secrets" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-secrets">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Secrets is a list of Secrets in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/secrets/SECRET_NAME folder |
| securityContext<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-securitycontext" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-securitycontext">#</a><br/>_[SecurityContext (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-securitycontext)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SecurityContext holds pod-level security attributes and common container settings.<br />This defaults to the default PodSecurityContext. |
| selectAllByDefault<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-selectallbydefault" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-selectallbydefault">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SelectAllByDefault changes default behavior for empty CRD selectors, such RuleSelector.<br />with selectAllByDefault: true and empty serviceScrapeSelector and RuleNamespaceSelector<br />Operator selects all exist serviceScrapes<br />with selectAllByDefault: false - selects nothing |
| serviceAccountName<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-serviceaccountname" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-serviceaccountname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceAccountName is the name of the ServiceAccount to use to run the pods |

| serviceSpec<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-servicespec" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-servicespec">#</a><br/>_[AdditionalServiceSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-additionalservicespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceSpec that will be added to vmalert service spec |
| startupProbe<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-startupprobe" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-startupprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StartupProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| terminationGracePeriodSeconds<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-terminationgraceperiodseconds" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-terminationgraceperiodseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TerminationGracePeriodSeconds period for container graceful termination |
| tolerations<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-tolerations" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-tolerations">#</a><br/>_[Toleration (v1)](#v1-toleration) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Tolerations If specified, the pod's tolerations. |
| topologySpreadConstraints<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-topologyspreadconstraints" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-topologyspreadconstraints">#</a><br/>_[TopologySpreadConstraint (v1)](#v1-topologyspreadconstraint) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TopologySpreadConstraints embedded kubernetes pod configuration option,<br />controls how pods are spread across your cluster among failure-domains<br />such as regions, zones, nodes, and other user-defined topology domains<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/ |
| updateStrategy<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-updatestrategy" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-updatestrategy">#</a><br/>_[DeploymentStrategyType (v1)](#v1-deploymentstrategytype)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UpdateStrategy - overrides default update strategy. |
| useDefaultResources<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-usedefaultresources" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-usedefaultresources">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseDefaultResources controls resource settings<br />By default, operator sets built-in resource requirements |
| useLegacyNaming<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-uselegacynaming" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-uselegacynaming">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseLegacyNaming uses standalone Helm chart naming for managed resources:<br />the CR name is used directly instead of the default "<type>-<name>" convention.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0730">v0.73.0</a> |
| useStrictSecurity<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-usestrictsecurity" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-usestrictsecurity">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseStrictSecurity enables strict security mode for component<br />it restricts disk writes access<br />uses non-root user out of the box<br />drops not needed security permissions |

| volumes<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-volumes" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-volumes">#</a><br/>_[Volume (v1)](#v1-volume) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Volumes allows configuration of additional volumes on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />Volumes specified will be appended to other volumes that are generated. |
| vpa<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertspec-vpa" id="v1beta1-vmalertspec-vpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedVPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedvpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configures vertical pod autoscaling. |

#### VMAlertmanager {#v1beta1-vmalertmanager}

VMAlertmanager represents Victoria-Metrics deployment for Alertmanager.

#### VMAlertmanagerSpec {#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec}

VMAlertmanagerSpec is a specification of the desired behavior of the VMAlertmanager cluster. More info:
https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/master/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#spec-and-status

Appears in: [VMAlertmanager (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmalertmanager)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| additionalPeers<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-additionalpeers" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-additionalpeers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Required)_<br/>AdditionalPeers allows injecting a set of additional Alertmanagers to peer with to form a highly available cluster. |
| affinity<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-affinity" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-affinity">#</a><br/>_[Affinity (v1)](#v1-affinity)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Affinity If specified, the pod's scheduling constraints. |
| arbitraryFSAccessThroughSMs<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsms" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsms">#</a><br/>_[ArbitraryFSAccessThroughSMsConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsmsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ArbitraryFSAccessThroughSMs configures whether configuration<br />can contain paths to arbitrary files on the file system<br />e.g bearer token files, basic auth password files, tls certs file paths |
| claimTemplates<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-claimtemplates" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-claimtemplates">#</a><br/>_[PersistentVolumeClaim (v1)](#v1-persistentvolumeclaim) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>ClaimTemplates allows adding additional VolumeClaimTemplates for StatefulSet |
| clusterAdvertiseAddress<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-clusteradvertiseaddress" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-clusteradvertiseaddress">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ClusterAdvertiseAddress is the explicit address to advertise in cluster.<br />Needs to be provided for non RFC1918 [1] (public) addresses.<br />[1] RFC1918: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc1918 |
| clusterDomainName<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-clusterdomainname" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-clusterdomainname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ClusterDomainName defines domain name suffix for in-cluster dns addresses<br />aka .cluster.local<br />used to build pod peer addresses for in-cluster communication |
| componentVersion<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-componentversion" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-componentversion">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ComponentVersion defines default images tag for all components.<br />it can be overwritten with component specific image.tag value. |
| configMaps<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-configmaps" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-configmaps">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigMaps is a list of ConfigMaps in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/configs/CONFIGMAP_NAME folder |
| configNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-confignamespaceselector" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-confignamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/> ConfigNamespaceSelector defines namespace selector for VMAlertmanagerConfig.<br />Works in combination with Selector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAlertmanager namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| configRawYaml<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-configrawyaml" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-configrawyaml">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigRawYaml - raw configuration for alertmanager,<br />it helps it to start without secret.<br />priority -> hardcoded ConfigRaw -> ConfigRaw, provided by user -> ConfigSecret. |
| configReloadAuthKeySecret<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-configreloadauthkeysecret" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-configreloadauthkeysecret">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloadAuthKeySecret defines optional secret reference authKey for /-/reload API requests.<br />Given secret reference will be added to the application and vm-config-reloader as volume<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0570">v0.57.0</a> |
| configReloaderExtraArgs<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-configreloaderextraargs" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-configreloaderextraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloaderExtraArgs that will be passed to  VMAuths config-reloader container<br />for example resync-interval: "30s" |
| configReloaderImage<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-configreloaderimage" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-configreloaderimage">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloaderImage defines image:tag for config-reloader container |
| configReloaderImageTag<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-configreloaderimagetag" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-configreloaderimagetag">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloaderImageTag defines image:tag for config-reloader container<br/><b>Deprecated: </b>since version <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0670">v0.67.0</a> will be removed in <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0690">v0.69.0</a> use <a href="#vmalertmanagerspec-configreloaderimage">configReloaderImage</a> instead<br/> |
| configReloaderResources<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-configreloaderresources" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-configreloaderresources">#</a><br/>_[ResourceRequirements (v1)](#v1-resourcerequirements)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloaderResources config-reloader container resource request and limits, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/<br />if not defined default resources from operator config will be used |
| configSecret<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-configsecret" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-configsecret">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigSecret is the name of a Kubernetes Secret in the same namespace as the<br />VMAlertmanager object, which contains configuration for this VMAlertmanager,<br />configuration must be inside secret key: alertmanager.yaml.<br />It must be created by user.<br />instance. Defaults to 'vmalertmanager-<alertmanager-name>'<br />The secret is mounted into /etc/alertmanager/config. |
| configSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-configselector" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-configselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigSelector defines selector for VMAlertmanagerConfig, result config will be merged with with Raw or Secret config.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAlertmanager namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| containers<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-containers" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-containers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Containers property allows to inject additions sidecars or to patch existing containers.<br />It can be useful for proxies, backup, etc. |
| disableAutomountServiceAccountToken<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableAutomountServiceAccountToken whether to disable serviceAccount auto mount by Kubernetes<br />Operator will conditionally create volumes and volumeMounts for containers if it requires k8s API access.<br />For example, vmagent and vm-config-reloader requires k8s API access.<br />Operator creates volumes with name: "kube-api-access", which can be used as volumeMount for extraContainers if needed.<br />And also adds VolumeMounts at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0540">v0.54.0</a> |
| disableNamespaceMatcher<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-disablenamespacematcher" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-disablenamespacematcher">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableNamespaceMatcher disables adding top route label matcher "namespace = <VMAlertmanagerConfig.namespace>" for VMAlertmanagerConfig<br />It may be useful if alert doesn't have namespace label for some reason |
| disableRouteContinueEnforce<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-disableroutecontinueenforce" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-disableroutecontinueenforce">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableRouteContinueEnforce cancel the behavior for VMAlertmanagerConfig that always enforce first-level route continue to true |
| disableSelfServiceScrape<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-disableselfservicescrape" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-disableselfservicescrape">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableSelfServiceScrape controls creation of VMServiceScrape by operator<br />for the application.<br />Has priority over `VM_DISABLESELFSERVICESCRAPECREATION` operator env variable |
| dnsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-dnsconfig" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-dnsconfig">#</a><br/>_[PodDNSConfig (v1)](#v1-poddnsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Specifies the DNS parameters of a pod.<br />Parameters specified here will be merged to the generated DNS<br />configuration based on DNSPolicy. |

| enableServiceLinks<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-enableservicelinks" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-enableservicelinks">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableServiceLinks indicates whether information about services should be injected into pod's<br />environment variables, matching the syntax of Docker links.<br />Optional: Defaults to true. |
| enforcedNamespaceLabel<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-enforcednamespacelabel" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-enforcednamespacelabel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnforcedNamespaceLabel defines the namespace label key for top route matcher for VMAlertmanagerConfig<br />Default is "namespace" |

This is<br />necessary to generate correct URLs. This is necessary if VMAlertmanager is not<br />served from root of a DNS name. |

| routePrefix<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-routeprefix" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-routeprefix">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RoutePrefix VMAlertmanager registers HTTP handlers for. This is useful,<br />if using ExternalURL and a proxy is rewriting HTTP routes of a request,<br />and the actual ExternalURL is still true, but the server serves requests<br />under a different route prefix. For example for use with `kubectl proxy`. |
| runtimeClassName<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-runtimeclassname" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-runtimeclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RuntimeClassName - defines runtime class for kubernetes pod.<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/ |
| schedulerName<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-schedulername" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-schedulername">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SchedulerName - defines kubernetes scheduler name |
| secrets<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-secrets" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-secrets">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Secrets is a list of Secrets in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/secrets/SECRET_NAME folder |
| securityContext<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-securitycontext" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-securitycontext">#</a><br/>_[SecurityContext (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-securitycontext)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SecurityContext holds pod-level security attributes and common container settings.<br />This defaults to the default PodSecurityContext. |
| selectAllByDefault<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-selectallbydefault" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-selectallbydefault">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SelectAllByDefault changes default behavior for empty CRD selectors, such ConfigSelector.<br />with selectAllByDefault: true and undefined ConfigSelector and ConfigNamespaceSelector<br />Operator selects all exist alertManagerConfigs<br />with selectAllByDefault: false - selects nothing |
| serviceAccountName<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-serviceaccountname" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-serviceaccountname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceAccountName is the name of the ServiceAccount to use to run the pods |
| serviceScrapeSpec<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-servicescrapespec" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-servicescrapespec">#</a><br/>_[VMServiceScrapeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeSpec that will be added to vmalertmanager VMServiceScrape spec |
| serviceSpec<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-servicespec" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-servicespec">#</a><br/>_[AdditionalServiceSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-additionalservicespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceSpec that will be added to vmalertmanager service spec |
| startupProbe<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-startupprobe" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-startupprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StartupProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| storage<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-storage" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-storage">#</a><br/>_[StorageSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-storagespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Storage is the definition of how storage will be used by the VMAlertmanager<br />instances. |
| templates<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-templates" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-templates">#</a><br/>_[ConfigMapKeyReference (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-configmapkeyreference) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Templates is a list of ConfigMap key references for ConfigMaps in the same namespace as the VMAlertmanager<br />object, which shall be mounted into the VMAlertmanager Pods.<br />The Templates are mounted into /etc/vm/templates/<configmap-name>/<configmap-key>. |
| terminationGracePeriodSeconds<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-terminationgraceperiodseconds" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-terminationgraceperiodseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TerminationGracePeriodSeconds period for container graceful termination |
| tolerations<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-tolerations" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-tolerations">#</a><br/>_[Toleration (v1)](#v1-toleration) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Tolerations If specified, the pod's tolerations. |
| topologySpreadConstraints<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-topologyspreadconstraints" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-topologyspreadconstraints">#</a><br/>_[TopologySpreadConstraint (v1)](#v1-topologyspreadconstraint) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TopologySpreadConstraints embedded kubernetes pod configuration option,<br />controls how pods are spread across your cluster among failure-domains<br />such as regions, zones, nodes, and other user-defined topology domains<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/ |
| tracingConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-tracingconfig" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-tracingconfig">#</a><br/>_[VMAlertmanagerTracingConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmalertmanagertracingconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TracingConfig defines tracing configuration for Alertmanager |
| useDefaultResources<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-usedefaultresources" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-usedefaultresources">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseDefaultResources controls resource settings<br />By default, operator sets built-in resource requirements |
| useLegacyNaming<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-uselegacynaming" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-uselegacynaming">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseLegacyNaming uses standalone Helm chart naming for managed resources:<br />the CR name is used directly instead of the default "<type>-<name>" convention.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0730">v0.73.0</a> |
| useStrictSecurity<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-usestrictsecurity" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-usestrictsecurity">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseStrictSecurity enables strict security mode for component<br />it restricts disk writes access<br />uses non-root user out of the box<br />drops not needed security permissions |
| useVMConfigReloader<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-usevmconfigreloader" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-usevmconfigreloader">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseVMConfigReloader replaces prometheus-like config-reloader<br />with vm one. It uses secrets watch instead of file watch<br />which greatly increases speed of config updates<br/><b>Deprecated: </b>will be removed in <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0670">v0.67.0</a><br/> |
| volumeMounts<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-volumemounts" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-volumemounts">#</a><br/>_[VolumeMount (v1)](#v1-volumemount) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VolumeMounts allows configuration of additional VolumeMounts on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />VolumeMounts specified will be appended to other VolumeMounts in the Application container |
| volumes<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-volumes" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-volumes">#</a><br/>_[Volume (v1)](#v1-volume) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Volumes allows configuration of additional volumes on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />Volumes specified will be appended to other volumes that are generated. |
| vpa<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-vpa" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-vpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedVPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedvpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configures vertical pod autoscaling. |
| webConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-webconfig" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec-webconfig">#</a><br/>_[VMAlertmanagerWebConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerwebconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>WebConfig defines configuration for webserver<br />https://github.com/prometheus/alertmanager/blob/main/docs/https.md |

#### VMAlertmanagerTracingConfig {#v1beta1-vmalertmanagertracingconfig}

VMAlertmanagerTracingConfig defines Tracing configuration for alertmanager

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| client_type<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagertracingconfig-client_type" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagertracingconfig-client_type">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ClientType defines tracing client protocol |
| compression<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagertracingconfig-compression" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagertracingconfig-compression">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Compression defines compression algorithm for tracing |
| endpoint<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagertracingconfig-endpoint" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagertracingconfig-endpoint">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Endpoint defines tracing URL where traces will be sent |
| headers<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagertracingconfig-headers" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagertracingconfig-headers">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Headers defines custom HTTP headers for tracing |
| insecure<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagertracingconfig-insecure" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagertracingconfig-insecure">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Insecure allows TLS configuration to be omitted |
| sampling_fraction<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagertracingconfig-sampling_fraction" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagertracingconfig-sampling_fraction">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SamplingFraction defines fraction of the requests that should be sampled |
| timeout<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagertracingconfig-timeout" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagertracingconfig-timeout">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Timeout defines tracing connection timeout |
| tls_config<a href="#v1beta1-vmalertmanagertracingconfig-tls_config" id="v1beta1-vmalertmanagertracingconfig-tls_config">#</a><br/>_[TLSClientConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-tlsclientconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TLSConfig defines tracing TLS config |

VMAuthLoadBalancerSpec defines configuration spec for VMAuth used as load-balancer
for VMCluster component

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| affinity<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-affinity" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-affinity">#</a><br/>_[Affinity (v1)](#v1-affinity)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Affinity If specified, the pod's scheduling constraints. |
| componentVersion<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-componentversion" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-componentversion">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ComponentVersion defines default images tag for this component.<br />it can be overwritten with component specific image.tag value. |
| configMaps<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-configmaps" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-configmaps">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigMaps is a list of ConfigMaps in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/configs/CONFIGMAP_NAME folder |
| containers<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-containers" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-containers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Containers property allows to inject additions sidecars or to patch existing containers.<br />It can be useful for proxies, backup, etc. |
| disableAutomountServiceAccountToken<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableAutomountServiceAccountToken whether to disable serviceAccount auto mount by Kubernetes<br />Operator will conditionally create volumes and volumeMounts for containers if it requires k8s API access.<br />For example, vmagent and vm-config-reloader requires k8s API access.<br />Operator creates volumes with name: "kube-api-access", which can be used as volumeMount for extraContainers if needed.<br />And also adds VolumeMounts at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0540">v0.54.0</a> |
| disableSelfServiceScrape<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-disableselfservicescrape" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-disableselfservicescrape">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableSelfServiceScrape controls creation of VMServiceScrape by operator<br />for the application.<br />Has priority over `VM_DISABLESELFSERVICESCRAPECREATION` operator env variable |
| dnsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-dnsconfig" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-dnsconfig">#</a><br/>_[PodDNSConfig (v1)](#v1-poddnsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Specifies the DNS parameters of a pod.<br />Parameters specified here will be merged to the generated DNS<br />configuration based on DNSPolicy. |
| dnsPolicy<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-dnspolicy" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-dnspolicy">#</a><br/>_[DNSPolicy (v1)](#v1-dnspolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DNSPolicy sets DNS policy for the pod |
| enableServiceLinks<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-enableservicelinks" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-enableservicelinks">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableServiceLinks indicates whether information about services should be injected into pod's<br />environment variables, matching the syntax of Docker links.<br />Optional: Defaults to true. |
| extraArgs<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-extraargs" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-extraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraArgs that will be passed to the application container<br />for example remoteWrite.tmpDataPath: /tmp |
| extraEnvs<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-extraenvs" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-extraenvs">#</a><br/>_[EnvVar (v1)](#v1-envvar) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvs that will be passed to the application container |
| extraEnvsFrom<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-extraenvsfrom" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-extraenvsfrom">#</a><br/>_[EnvFromSource (v1)](#v1-envfromsource) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvsFrom defines source of env variables for the application container<br />could either be secret or configmap |
| hostAliases<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-hostaliases" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-hostaliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliases provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork. |
| hostNetwork<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-hostnetwork" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-hostnetwork">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostNetwork controls whether the pod may use the node network namespace |
| host_aliases<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-host_aliases" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-host_aliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliasesUnderScore provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork.<br />Has Priority over hostAliases field |
| hpa<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-hpa" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-hpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedHPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedhpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HPA defines HorizontalPodAutoscaler configuration for vmauth lb deployment |
| image<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-image" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-image">#</a><br/>_[Image (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-image)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Image - docker image settings<br />if no specified operator uses default version from operator config |

| initContainers<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-initcontainers" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-initcontainers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InitContainers allows adding initContainers to the pod definition.<br />Any errors during the execution of an initContainer will lead to a restart of the Pod.<br />More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/ |
| license<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-license" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-license">#</a><br/>_[License (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-license)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>License configures enterprise features license key |
| livenessProbe<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-livenessprobe" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-livenessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LivenessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| logFormat<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-logformat" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-logformat">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogFormat for vmauth<br />default or json |
| logLevel<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-loglevel" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-loglevel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogLevel for vmauth container. |

| paused<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-paused" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-paused">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Paused If set to true all actions on the underlying managed objects are not<br />going to be performed, except for delete actions. |

Set to 0 to disable. |
