| rollingUpdate<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-rollingupdate" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-rollingupdate">#</a><br/>_[RollingUpdateDeployment (v1)](#v1-rollingupdatedeployment)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RollingUpdate - overrides deployment update params.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0640">v0.64.0</a> |
| runtimeClassName<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-runtimeclassname" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-runtimeclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RuntimeClassName - defines runtime class for kubernetes pod.<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/ |
| schedulerName<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-schedulername" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-schedulername">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SchedulerName - defines kubernetes scheduler name |
| secrets<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-secrets" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-secrets">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Secrets is a list of Secrets in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/secrets/SECRET_NAME folder |
| securityContext<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-securitycontext" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-securitycontext">#</a><br/>_[SecurityContext (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-securitycontext)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SecurityContext holds pod-level security attributes and common container settings.<br />This defaults to the default PodSecurityContext. |
| serviceScrapeSpec<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-servicescrapespec" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-servicescrapespec">#</a><br/>_[VMServiceScrapeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeSpec that will be added to vmauthlb VMServiceScrape spec |
| serviceSpec<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-servicespec" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-servicespec">#</a><br/>_[AdditionalServiceSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-additionalservicespec)_ | _(Required)_<br/>AdditionalServiceSpec defines service override configuration for vmauth lb deployment<br />it'll be only applied to vmclusterlb- service |
| startupProbe<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-startupprobe" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-startupprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StartupProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| terminationGracePeriodSeconds<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-terminationgraceperiodseconds" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-terminationgraceperiodseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TerminationGracePeriodSeconds period for container graceful termination |
| tolerations<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-tolerations" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-tolerations">#</a><br/>_[Toleration (v1)](#v1-toleration) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Tolerations If specified, the pod's tolerations. |
| topologySpreadConstraints<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-topologyspreadconstraints" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-topologyspreadconstraints">#</a><br/>_[TopologySpreadConstraint (v1)](#v1-topologyspreadconstraint) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TopologySpreadConstraints embedded kubernetes pod configuration option,<br />controls how pods are spread across your cluster among failure-domains<br />such as regions, zones, nodes, and other user-defined topology domains<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/ |
| updateStrategy<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-updatestrategy" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-updatestrategy">#</a><br/>_[DeploymentStrategyType (v1)](#v1-deploymentstrategytype)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UpdateStrategy - overrides default update strategy.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0640">v0.64.0</a> |
| useDefaultResources<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-usedefaultresources" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-usedefaultresources">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseDefaultResources controls resource settings<br />By default, operator sets built-in resource requirements |
| useStrictSecurity<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-usestrictsecurity" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-usestrictsecurity">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseStrictSecurity enables strict security mode for component<br />it restricts disk writes access<br />uses non-root user out of the box<br />drops not needed security permissions |
| volumeMounts<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-volumemounts" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-volumemounts">#</a><br/>_[VolumeMount (v1)](#v1-volumemount) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VolumeMounts allows configuration of additional VolumeMounts on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />VolumeMounts specified will be appended to other VolumeMounts in the Application container |
| volumes<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-volumes" id="v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec-volumes">#</a><br/>_[Volume (v1)](#v1-volume) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Volumes allows configuration of additional volumes on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />Volumes specified will be appended to other volumes that are generated. |

#### VMAuthSpec {#v1beta1-vmauthspec}

VMAuthSpec defines the desired state of VMAuth

Appears in: [VLDistributedAuth (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vldistributedauth), [VMAuth (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmauth), [VMDistributedAuth (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vmdistributedauth)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| access_log<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-access_log" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-access_log">#</a><br/>_[VMUserAccessLog (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmuseraccesslog)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>AccessLog configures per-user access logging.<br />When set, vmauth logs each request for this user with fields including<br />request_uri, status_code, duration_ms, username, etc.<br />See https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#access-log<br />available since v1.138.0 vmauth version<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0730">v0.73.0</a> |
| affinity<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-affinity" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-affinity">#</a><br/>_[Affinity (v1)](#v1-affinity)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Affinity If specified, the pod's scheduling constraints. |
| arbitraryFSAccessThroughSMs<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsms" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsms">#</a><br/>_[ArbitraryFSAccessThroughSMsConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsmsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ArbitraryFSAccessThroughSMs configures whether configuration<br />can contain paths to arbitrary files on the file system<br />e.g bearer token files, basic auth password files, tls certs file paths |
| componentVersion<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-componentversion" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-componentversion">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ComponentVersion defines default images tag for all components.<br />it can be overwritten with component specific image.tag value. |
| configMaps<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-configmaps" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-configmaps">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigMaps is a list of ConfigMaps in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/configs/CONFIGMAP_NAME folder |
| configReloadAuthKeySecret<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-configreloadauthkeysecret" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-configreloadauthkeysecret">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloadAuthKeySecret defines optional secret reference authKey for /-/reload API requests.<br />Given secret reference will be added to the application and vm-config-reloader as volume<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0570">v0.57.0</a> |
| configReloaderExtraArgs<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-configreloaderextraargs" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-configreloaderextraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloaderExtraArgs that will be passed to  VMAuths config-reloader container<br />for example resync-interval: "30s" |
| configReloaderImage<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-configreloaderimage" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-configreloaderimage">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloaderImage defines image:tag for config-reloader container |
| configReloaderImageTag<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-configreloaderimagetag" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-configreloaderimagetag">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloaderImageTag defines image:tag for config-reloader container<br/><b>Deprecated: </b>since version <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0670">v0.67.0</a> will be removed in <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0690">v0.69.0</a> use <a href="#vmauthspec-configreloaderimage">configReloaderImage</a> instead<br/> |
| configReloaderResources<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-configreloaderresources" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-configreloaderresources">#</a><br/>_[ResourceRequirements (v1)](#v1-resourcerequirements)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloaderResources config-reloader container resource request and limits, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/<br />if not defined default resources from operator config will be used |
| configSecret<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-configsecret" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-configsecret">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>ConfigSecret is the name of a Kubernetes Secret in the same namespace as the<br />VMAuth object, which contains auth configuration for vmauth,<br />configuration must be inside secret key: config.yaml.<br />It must be created and managed manually.<br />If it's defined, configuration for vmauth becomes unmanaged and operator'll not create any related secrets/config-reloaders<br/><b>Deprecated: </b>since version <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0490">v0.49.0</a> will be removed in <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0690">v0.69.0</a> use <a href="#vmauthspec-externalconfig">externalConfig</a> instead<br/> |
| containers<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-containers" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-containers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Containers property allows to inject additions sidecars or to patch existing containers.<br />It can be useful for proxies, backup, etc. |
| defaultTargetRefs<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-defaulttargetrefs" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-defaulttargetrefs">#</a><br/>_[TargetRef (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-targetref) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>DefaultTargetRefs list of named targetRefs, which may be referenced by VMUser and at unauthorizedUserAccessSpec. |
| default_url<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-default_url" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-default_url">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Required)_<br/>DefaultURLs backend url for non-matching paths filter<br />usually used for default backend with error message |
| disableAutomountServiceAccountToken<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableAutomountServiceAccountToken whether to disable serviceAccount auto mount by Kubernetes<br />Operator will conditionally create volumes and volumeMounts for containers if it requires k8s API access.<br />For example, vmagent and vm-config-reloader requires k8s API access.<br />Operator creates volumes with name: "kube-api-access", which can be used as volumeMount for extraContainers if needed.<br />And also adds VolumeMounts at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0540">v0.54.0</a> |
| disableSelfServiceScrape<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-disableselfservicescrape" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-disableselfservicescrape">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableSelfServiceScrape controls creation of VMServiceScrape by operator<br />for the application.<br />Has priority over `VM_DISABLESELFSERVICESCRAPECREATION` operator env variable |
| discover_backend_ips<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-discover_backend_ips" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-discover_backend_ips">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>DiscoverBackendIPs instructs discovering URLPrefix backend IPs via DNS. |
| dnsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-dnsconfig" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-dnsconfig">#</a><br/>_[PodDNSConfig (v1)](#v1-poddnsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Specifies the DNS parameters of a pod.<br />Parameters specified here will be merged to the generated DNS<br />configuration based on DNSPolicy. |
| dnsPolicy<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-dnspolicy" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-dnspolicy">#</a><br/>_[DNSPolicy (v1)](#v1-dnspolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DNSPolicy sets DNS policy for the pod |
| drop_src_path_prefix_parts<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-drop_src_path_prefix_parts" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-drop_src_path_prefix_parts">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DropSrcPathPrefixParts is the number of `/`-delimited request path prefix parts to drop before proxying the request to backend.<br />See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#dropping-request-path-prefix) for more details. |
| dump_request_on_errors<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-dump_request_on_errors" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-dump_request_on_errors">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DumpRequestOnErrors instructs vmauth to return detailed request params to the client<br />if routing rules don't allow to forward request to the backends.<br />Useful for debugging `src_hosts` and `src_headers` based routing rules<br />available since v1.107.0 vmauth version |
| enableServiceLinks<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-enableservicelinks" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-enableservicelinks">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableServiceLinks indicates whether information about services should be injected into pod's<br />environment variables, matching the syntax of Docker links.<br />Optional: Defaults to true. |
| externalConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-externalconfig" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-externalconfig">#</a><br/>_[ExternalConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-externalconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExternalConfig defines a source of external VMAuth configuration.<br />If it's defined, configuration for vmauth becomes unmanaged and operator'll not create any related secrets/config-reloaders |
| extraArgs<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-extraargs" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-extraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraArgs that will be passed to the application container<br />for example remoteWrite.tmpDataPath: /tmp |
| extraEnvs<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-extraenvs" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-extraenvs">#</a><br/>_[EnvVar (v1)](#v1-envvar) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvs that will be passed to the application container |
| extraEnvsFrom<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-extraenvsfrom" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-extraenvsfrom">#</a><br/>_[EnvFromSource (v1)](#v1-envfromsource) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvsFrom defines source of env variables for the application container<br />could either be secret or configmap |
| headers<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-headers" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-headers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Headers represent additional http headers, that vmauth uses<br />in form of ["header_key: header_value"]<br />multiple values for header key:<br />["header_key: value1,value2"]<br />it's available since 1.68.0 version of vmauth |
| hostAliases<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-hostaliases" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-hostaliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliases provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork. |
| hostNetwork<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-hostnetwork" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-hostnetwork">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostNetwork controls whether the pod may use the node network namespace |
| host_aliases<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-host_aliases" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-host_aliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliasesUnderScore provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork.<br />Has Priority over hostAliases field |
| hpa<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-hpa" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-hpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedHPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedhpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configures horizontal pod autoscaling. |
| httpRoute<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-httproute" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-httproute">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedHTTPRoute (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedhttproute)_ | _(Required)_<br/>HTTPRoute enables httproute configuration for VMAuth. |
| image<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-image" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-image">#</a><br/>_[Image (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-image)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Image - docker image settings<br />if no specified operator uses default version from operator config |
| imagePullSecrets<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-imagepullsecrets" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-imagepullsecrets">#</a><br/>_[LocalObjectReference (v1)](#v1-localobjectreference) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ImagePullSecrets An optional list of references to secrets in the same namespace<br />to use for pulling images from registries<br />see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images/#specifying-imagepullsecrets-on-a-pod |
| ingress<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-ingress" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-ingress">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedIngress (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedingress)_ | _(Required)_<br/>Ingress enables ingress configuration for VMAuth. |
| initContainers<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-initcontainers" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-initcontainers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InitContainers allows adding initContainers to the pod definition.<br />Any errors during the execution of an initContainer will lead to a restart of the Pod.<br />More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/ |
| internalListenPort<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-internallistenport" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-internallistenport">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InternalListenPort instructs vmauth to serve internal routes at given port<br />available from v1.111.0 vmauth version<br />related doc https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#security<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0560">v0.56.0</a> |
| ip_filters<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-ip_filters" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-ip_filters">#</a><br/>_[VMUserIPFilters (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmuseripfilters)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>IPFilters defines per target src ip filters<br />supported only with enterprise version of [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#ip-filters) |
| license<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-license" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-license">#</a><br/>_[License (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-license)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>License allows to configure license key to be used for enterprise features.<br />Using license key is supported starting from VictoriaMetrics v1.94.0.<br />See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/enterprise/) |
| livenessProbe<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-livenessprobe" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-livenessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LivenessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| load_balancing_policy<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-load_balancing_policy" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-load_balancing_policy">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LoadBalancingPolicy defines load balancing policy to use for backend urls.<br />Supported policies: least_loaded, first_available.<br />See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#load-balancing) for more details (default "least_loaded") |
| logFormat<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-logformat" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-logformat">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogFormat for VMAuth to be configured with. |
| logLevel<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-loglevel" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-loglevel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogLevel for victoria metrics single to be configured with. |
| managedMetadata<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-managedmetadata" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-managedmetadata">#</a><br/>_[ManagedObjectsMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-managedobjectsmetadata)_ | _(Required)_<br/>ManagedMetadata defines metadata that will be added to the all objects<br />created by operator for the given CustomResource |
| max_concurrent_requests<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-max_concurrent_requests" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-max_concurrent_requests">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MaxConcurrentRequests defines max concurrent requests per user<br />300 is default value for vmauth |
| minReadySeconds<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-minreadyseconds" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-minreadyseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MinReadySeconds defines a minimum number of seconds to wait before starting update next pod<br />if previous in healthy state<br />Has no effect for VLogs and VMSingle |
| networkPolicy<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-networkpolicy" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-networkpolicy">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedNetworkPolicy (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddednetworkpolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NetworkPolicy defines network access rules for pods created by this CR. |
| nodeSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-nodeselector" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-nodeselector">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeSelector Define which Nodes the Pods are scheduled on. |
| paused<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-paused" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-paused">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Paused If set to true all actions on the underlying managed objects are not<br />going to be performed, except for delete actions. |
| podDisruptionBudget<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-poddisruptionbudget" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-poddisruptionbudget">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedPodDisruptionBudgetSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedpoddisruptionbudgetspec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodDisruptionBudget created by operator |
| podMetadata<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-podmetadata" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-podmetadata">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedObjectMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedobjectmetadata)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodMetadata configures Labels and Annotations which are propagated to the VMAuth pods. |
| port<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-port" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-port">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Port listen address |
| preStopSleepSeconds<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-prestopsleepseconds" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-prestopsleepseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PreStopSleepSeconds defines the number of seconds to sleep in the preStop lifecycle hook.<br />It gives time for load balancers to remove the pod from rotation before the pod is terminated.<br />Defaults to 15 for applicable components. Set to 0 to disable. |
| priorityClassName<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-priorityclassname" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-priorityclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PriorityClassName class assigned to the Pods |
| readinessGates<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-readinessgates" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-readinessgates">#</a><br/>_[PodReadinessGate (v1)](#v1-podreadinessgate) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>ReadinessGates defines pod readiness gates |
| readinessProbe<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-readinessprobe" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-readinessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReadinessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| replicaCount<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-replicacount" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-replicacount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReplicaCount is the expected size of the Application. |
| resources<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-resources" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-resources">#</a><br/>_[ResourceRequirements (v1)](#v1-resourcerequirements)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Resources container resource request and limits, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/<br />if not defined default resources from operator config will be used |
| response_headers<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-response_headers" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-response_headers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ResponseHeaders represent additional http headers, that vmauth adds for request response<br />in form of ["header_key: header_value"]<br />multiple values for header key:<br />["header_key: value1,value2"]<br />it's available since 1.93.0 version of vmauth |
| retry_status_codes<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-retry_status_codes" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-retry_status_codes">#</a><br/>_integer array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RetryStatusCodes defines http status codes in numeric format for request retries<br />e.g. [429,503] |
| revisionHistoryLimitCount<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-revisionhistorylimitcount" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-revisionhistorylimitcount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The number of old ReplicaSets to retain to allow rollback in deployment or<br />maximum number of revisions that will be maintained in the Deployment revision history.<br />Has no effect at StatefulSets<br />Defaults to 10. |
| rollingUpdate<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-rollingupdate" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-rollingupdate">#</a><br/>_[RollingUpdateDeployment (v1)](#v1-rollingupdatedeployment)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RollingUpdate - overrides deployment update params.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0640">v0.64.0</a> |
| runtimeClassName<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-runtimeclassname" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-runtimeclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RuntimeClassName - defines runtime class for kubernetes pod.<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/ |
| schedulerName<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-schedulername" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-schedulername">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SchedulerName - defines kubernetes scheduler name |
| secrets<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-secrets" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-secrets">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Secrets is a list of Secrets in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/secrets/SECRET_NAME folder |
| securityContext<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-securitycontext" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-securitycontext">#</a><br/>_[SecurityContext (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-securitycontext)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SecurityContext holds pod-level security attributes and common container settings.<br />This defaults to the default PodSecurityContext. |
| selectAllByDefault<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-selectallbydefault" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-selectallbydefault">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SelectAllByDefault changes default behavior for empty CRD selectors, such userSelector.<br />with selectAllByDefault: true and empty userSelector and userNamespaceSelector<br />Operator selects all exist users<br />with selectAllByDefault: false - selects nothing |
| serviceAccountName<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-serviceaccountname" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-serviceaccountname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceAccountName is the name of the ServiceAccount to use to run the pods |
| serviceScrapeSpec<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-servicescrapespec" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-servicescrapespec">#</a><br/>_[VMServiceScrapeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeSpec that will be added to vmauth VMServiceScrape spec |
| serviceSpec<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-servicespec" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-servicespec">#</a><br/>_[AdditionalServiceSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-additionalservicespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceSpec that will be added to vmsingle service spec |
| startupProbe<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-startupprobe" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-startupprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StartupProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| terminationGracePeriodSeconds<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-terminationgraceperiodseconds" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-terminationgraceperiodseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TerminationGracePeriodSeconds period for container graceful termination |
| tlsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-tlsconfig" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-tlsconfig">#</a><br/>_[TLSConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-tlsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TLSConfig defines tls configuration for the backend connection |
| tolerations<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-tolerations" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-tolerations">#</a><br/>_[Toleration (v1)](#v1-toleration) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Tolerations If specified, the pod's tolerations. |
| topologySpreadConstraints<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-topologyspreadconstraints" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-topologyspreadconstraints">#</a><br/>_[TopologySpreadConstraint (v1)](#v1-topologyspreadconstraint) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TopologySpreadConstraints embedded kubernetes pod configuration option,<br />controls how pods are spread across your cluster among failure-domains<br />such as regions, zones, nodes, and other user-defined topology domains<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/ |
| unauthorizedAccessConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-unauthorizedaccessconfig" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-unauthorizedaccessconfig">#</a><br/>_[UnauthorizedAccessConfigURLMap (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-unauthorizedaccessconfigurlmap) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>UnauthorizedAccessConfig configures access for un authorized users<br/><b>Deprecated: </b>since version <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0510">v0.51.0</a> will be removed in v1.0.0 use <a href="#vmauthspec-unauthorizeduseraccessspec">unauthorizedUserAccessSpec</a> instead<br/> |
| unauthorizedUserAccessSpec<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-unauthorizeduseraccessspec" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-unauthorizeduseraccessspec">#</a><br/>_[VMAuthUnauthorizedUserAccessSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UnauthorizedUserAccessSpec defines unauthorized_user config section of vmauth config |
| updateStrategy<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-updatestrategy" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-updatestrategy">#</a><br/>_[DeploymentStrategyType (v1)](#v1-deploymentstrategytype)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UpdateStrategy - overrides default update strategy.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0640">v0.64.0</a> |
| useDefaultResources<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-usedefaultresources" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-usedefaultresources">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseDefaultResources controls resource settings<br />By default, operator sets built-in resource requirements |
| useLegacyNaming<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-uselegacynaming" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-uselegacynaming">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseLegacyNaming uses standalone Helm chart naming for managed resources:<br />the CR name is used directly instead of the default "<type>-<name>" convention.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0730">v0.73.0</a> |
| useProxyProtocol<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-useproxyprotocol" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-useproxyprotocol">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>UseProxyProtocol enables proxy protocol for vmauth<br />https://www.haproxy.org/download/2.3/doc/proxy-protocol.txt |
| useStrictSecurity<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-usestrictsecurity" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-usestrictsecurity">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseStrictSecurity enables strict security mode for component<br />it restricts disk writes access<br />uses non-root user out of the box<br />drops not needed security permissions |
| useVMConfigReloader<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-usevmconfigreloader" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-usevmconfigreloader">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseVMConfigReloader replaces prometheus-like config-reloader<br />with vm one. It uses secrets watch instead of file watch<br />which greatly increases speed of config updates<br/><b>Deprecated: </b>will be removed in <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0670">v0.67.0</a><br/> |
| userNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-usernamespaceselector" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-usernamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UserNamespaceSelector Namespaces to be selected for  VMAuth discovery.<br />Works in combination with Selector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAuth namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| userSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-userselector" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-userselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UserSelector defines VMUser to be selected for config file generation.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAuth namespace.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| volumeMounts<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-volumemounts" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-volumemounts">#</a><br/>_[VolumeMount (v1)](#v1-volumemount) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VolumeMounts allows configuration of additional VolumeMounts on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />VolumeMounts specified will be appended to other VolumeMounts in the Application container |
| volumes<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-volumes" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-volumes">#</a><br/>_[Volume (v1)](#v1-volume) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Volumes allows configuration of additional volumes on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />Volumes specified will be appended to other volumes that are generated. |
| vpa<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-vpa" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-vpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedVPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedvpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configures vertical pod autoscaling. |
| waitForConfigReload<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthspec-waitforconfigreload" id="v1beta1-vmauthspec-waitforconfigreload">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>WaitForConfigReload instructs the operator to verify, via the config-reloader<br />sidecar's own reload-confirmation metric, that every replica has actually reloaded<br />before marking dependent objects (e.g. VMUser) as applied.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0740">v0.74.0</a> |

#### VMAuthUnauthorizedUserAccessSpec {#v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec}

VMAuthUnauthorizedUserAccessSpec defines unauthorized_user section configuration for vmauth

Appears in: [VMAuthSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmauthspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| access_log<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-access_log" id="v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-access_log">#</a><br/>_[VMUserAccessLog (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmuseraccesslog)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>AccessLog configures per-user access logging.<br />When set, vmauth logs each request for this user with fields including<br />request_uri, status_code, duration_ms, username, etc.<br />See https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#access-log<br />available since v1.138.0 vmauth version<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0730">v0.73.0</a> |
| default_url<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-default_url" id="v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-default_url">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Required)_<br/>DefaultURLs backend url for non-matching paths filter<br />usually used for default backend with error message |
| discover_backend_ips<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-discover_backend_ips" id="v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-discover_backend_ips">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>DiscoverBackendIPs instructs discovering URLPrefix backend IPs via DNS. |
| drop_src_path_prefix_parts<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-drop_src_path_prefix_parts" id="v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-drop_src_path_prefix_parts">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DropSrcPathPrefixParts is the number of `/`-delimited request path prefix parts to drop before proxying the request to backend.<br />See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#dropping-request-path-prefix) for more details. |
| dump_request_on_errors<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-dump_request_on_errors" id="v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-dump_request_on_errors">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DumpRequestOnErrors instructs vmauth to return detailed request params to the client<br />if routing rules don't allow to forward request to the backends.<br />Useful for debugging `src_hosts` and `src_headers` based routing rules<br />available since v1.107.0 vmauth version |
| headers<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-headers" id="v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-headers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Headers represent additional http headers, that vmauth uses<br />in form of ["header_key: header_value"]<br />multiple values for header key:<br />["header_key: value1,value2"]<br />it's available since 1.68.0 version of vmauth |
| ip_filters<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-ip_filters" id="v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-ip_filters">#</a><br/>_[VMUserIPFilters (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmuseripfilters)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>IPFilters defines per target src ip filters<br />supported only with enterprise version of [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#ip-filters) |
| load_balancing_policy<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-load_balancing_policy" id="v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-load_balancing_policy">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LoadBalancingPolicy defines load balancing policy to use for backend urls.<br />Supported policies: least_loaded, first_available.<br />See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#load-balancing) for more details (default "least_loaded") |
| max_concurrent_requests<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-max_concurrent_requests" id="v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-max_concurrent_requests">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MaxConcurrentRequests defines max concurrent requests per user<br />300 is default value for vmauth |
| metric_labels<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-metric_labels" id="v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-metric_labels">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MetricLabels - additional labels for metrics exported by vmauth for given user. |
| response_headers<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-response_headers" id="v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-response_headers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ResponseHeaders represent additional http headers, that vmauth adds for request response<br />in form of ["header_key: header_value"]<br />multiple values for header key:<br />["header_key: value1,value2"]<br />it's available since 1.93.0 version of vmauth |
| retry_status_codes<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-retry_status_codes" id="v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-retry_status_codes">#</a><br/>_integer array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RetryStatusCodes defines http status codes in numeric format for request retries<br />e.g. [429,503] |
| targetRefs<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-targetrefs" id="v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-targetrefs">#</a><br/>_[TargetRef (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-targetref) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>TargetRefs - reference to endpoints, which user may access. |
| tlsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-tlsconfig" id="v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-tlsconfig">#</a><br/>_[TLSConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-tlsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TLSConfig defines tls configuration for the backend connection |
| url_map<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-url_map" id="v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-url_map">#</a><br/>_[UnauthorizedAccessConfigURLMap (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-unauthorizedaccessconfigurlmap) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>URLMap defines url map for destination<br/><b>Deprecated: </b>since version <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0670">v0.67.0</a> will be removed in <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0690">v0.69.0</a> use <a href="#vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-targetrefs">targetRefs</a> instead<br/> |
| url_prefix<a href="#v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-url_prefix" id="v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-url_prefix">#</a><br/>_[StringOrArray (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-stringorarray)_ | _(Required)_<br/>URLPrefix defines url prefix for destination<br/><b>Deprecated: </b>since version <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0670">v0.67.0</a> will be removed in <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0690">v0.69.0</a> use <a href="#vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec-targetrefs">targetRefs</a> instead<br/> |

#### VMBackup {#v1beta1-vmbackup}

Appears in: [VMSingleSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmsinglespec), [VMStorage (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmstorage)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| acceptEULA<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-accepteula" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-accepteula">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>AcceptEULA accepts enterprise feature usage, must be set to true.<br />otherwise backupmanager cannot be added to single/cluster version.<br />https://victoriametrics.com/legal/esa/<br/><b>Deprecated: </b>since version <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0610">v0.61.0</a> will be removed in <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0690">v0.69.0</a> use <a href="#vmclusterspec-license">license</a> instead<br/> |
| concurrency<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-concurrency" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-concurrency">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Defines number of concurrent workers. Higher concurrency may reduce backup duration (default 10) |
| credentialsSecret<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-credentialssecret" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-credentialssecret">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>CredentialsSecret is secret in the same namespace for access to remote storage<br />The secret is mounted into /etc/vm/creds. |
| customS3Endpoint<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-customs3endpoint" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-customs3endpoint">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Custom S3 endpoint for use with S3-compatible storages (e.g. MinIO). S3 is used if not set |
| destination<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-destination" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-destination">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Defines destination for backup |
| destinationDisableSuffixAdd<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-destinationdisablesuffixadd" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-destinationdisablesuffixadd">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DestinationDisableSuffixAdd - disables suffix adding for cluster version backups<br />each vmstorage backup must have unique backup folder<br />so operator adds POD_NAME as suffix for backup destination folder. |
| disableDaily<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-disabledaily" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-disabledaily">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Defines if daily backups disabled (default false) |
| disableHourly<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-disablehourly" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-disablehourly">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Defines if hourly backups disabled (default false) |
| disableMonthly<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-disablemonthly" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-disablemonthly">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Defines if monthly backups disabled (default false) |
| disableWeekly<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-disableweekly" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-disableweekly">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Defines if weekly backups disabled (default false) |
| extraArgs<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-extraargs" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-extraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>extra args like maxBytesPerSecond default 0 |
| extraEnvs<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-extraenvs" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-extraenvs">#</a><br/>_[EnvVar (v1)](#v1-envvar) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |
| extraEnvsFrom<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-extraenvsfrom" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-extraenvsfrom">#</a><br/>_[EnvFromSource (v1)](#v1-envfromsource) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvsFrom defines source of env variables for the application container<br />could either be secret or configmap |
| image<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-image" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-image">#</a><br/>_[Image (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-image)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Image - docker image settings for VMBackuper |
| logFormat<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-logformat" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-logformat">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogFormat for VMBackup to be configured with.<br />default or json |
| logLevel<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-loglevel" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-loglevel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogLevel for VMBackup to be configured with. |
| port<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-port" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-port">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Port for health check connections |
| resources<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-resources" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-resources">#</a><br/>_[ResourceRequirements (v1)](#v1-resourcerequirements)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Resources container resource request and limits, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/<br />if not defined default resources from operator config will be used |
| restore<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-restore" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-restore">#</a><br/>_[VMRestore (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmrestore)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Restore Allows to enable restore options for pod<br />Read [more](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmbackupmanager/#restore-commands) |
| snapshotCreateURL<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-snapshotcreateurl" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-snapshotcreateurl">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SnapshotCreateURL overwrites url for snapshot create |
| snapshotDeleteURL<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-snapshotdeleteurl" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-snapshotdeleteurl">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SnapshotDeleteURL overwrites url for snapshot delete |
| volumeMounts<a href="#v1beta1-vmbackup-volumemounts" id="v1beta1-vmbackup-volumemounts">#</a><br/>_[VolumeMount (v1)](#v1-volumemount) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VolumeMounts allows configuration of additional VolumeMounts on the output Deployment definition.<br />VolumeMounts specified will be appended to other VolumeMounts in the vmbackupmanager container,<br />that are generated as a result of StorageSpec objects. |

#### VMCluster {#v1beta1-vmcluster}

VMCluster is fast, cost-effective and scalable time-series database.
Cluster version with

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |

| kind<br/>_string_ | (Required)<br/>`VMCluster` |
| metadata<a href="#v1beta1-vmcluster-metadata" id="v1beta1-vmcluster-metadata">#</a><br/>_[ObjectMeta (v1)](#v1-objectmeta)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Refer to Kubernetes API documentation for fields of `metadata`. |

#### VMClusterDiscovery {#v1beta1-vmclusterdiscovery}

VMClusterDiscovery configures automatic vmstorage node discovery for vminsert and vmselect.
It maps to the -storageNode.discoveryInterval and -storageNode.filter flags.

Appears in: [VMClusterSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmclusterspec), [VMInsert (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vminsert), [VMSelect (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmselect)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| enabled<a href="#v1beta1-vmclusterdiscovery-enabled" id="v1beta1-vmclusterdiscovery-enabled">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>Enabled turns on automatic vmstorage node discovery via DNS SRV records.<br />This is an enterprise feature and requires a valid license key.<br />See https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/#automatic-vmstorage-discovery |
| filter<a href="#v1beta1-vmclusterdiscovery-filter" id="v1beta1-vmclusterdiscovery-filter">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Filter is an optional regexp filter applied to discovered vmstorage addresses.<br />Only addresses matching the filter are used; non-matching addresses are ignored. |
| interval<a href="#v1beta1-vmclusterdiscovery-interval" id="v1beta1-vmclusterdiscovery-interval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Interval is the interval for refreshing the vmstorage node list resolved from DNS SRV records.<br />The minimum supported value is 1s.<br />Defaults to 2s if not set. |

#### VMClusterSpec {#v1beta1-vmclusterspec}

VMClusterSpec defines the desired state of VMCluster

Appears in: [VMCluster (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmcluster), [VMDistributedZoneCluster (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vmdistributedzonecluster)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| clusterDomainName<a href="#v1beta1-vmclusterspec-clusterdomainname" id="v1beta1-vmclusterspec-clusterdomainname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ClusterDomainName defines domain name suffix for in-cluster dns addresses<br />aka .cluster.local<br />used by vminsert and vmselect to build vmstorage address |
| clusterVersion<a href="#v1beta1-vmclusterspec-clusterversion" id="v1beta1-vmclusterspec-clusterversion">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ClusterVersion defines default images tag for all components.<br />it can be overwritten with component specific image.tag value. |
| discovery<a href="#v1beta1-vmclusterspec-discovery" id="v1beta1-vmclusterspec-discovery">#</a><br/>_[VMClusterDiscovery (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmclusterdiscovery)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Discovery configures automatic vmstorage node discovery for vminsert and vmselect.<br />This is an enterprise feature and requires a valid license key.<br />See https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/#automatic-vmstorage-discovery |
| downsampling<a href="#v1beta1-vmclusterspec-downsampling" id="v1beta1-vmclusterspec-downsampling">#</a><br/>_[DownsamplingConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-downsamplingconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Downsampling defines downsampling rules applied to vmselect and vmstorage components.<br />Requires enterprise license. See https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/#downsampling |
| imagePullSecrets<a href="#v1beta1-vmclusterspec-imagepullsecrets" id="v1beta1-vmclusterspec-imagepullsecrets">#</a><br/>_[LocalObjectReference (v1)](#v1-localobjectreference) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ImagePullSecrets An optional list of references to secrets in the same namespace<br />to use for pulling images from registries<br />see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images/#specifying-imagepullsecrets-on-a-pod |
| license<a href="#v1beta1-vmclusterspec-license" id="v1beta1-vmclusterspec-license">#</a><br/>_[License (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-license)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>License allows to configure license key to be used for enterprise features.<br />Using license key is supported starting from VictoriaMetrics v1.94.0.<br />See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/enterprise/) |
| managedMetadata<a href="#v1beta1-vmclusterspec-managedmetadata" id="v1beta1-vmclusterspec-managedmetadata">#</a><br/>_[ManagedObjectsMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-managedobjectsmetadata)_ | _(Required)_<br/>ManagedMetadata defines metadata that will be added to the all objects<br />created by operator for the given CustomResource |
| paused<a href="#v1beta1-vmclusterspec-paused" id="v1beta1-vmclusterspec-paused">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Paused If set to true all actions on the underlying managed objects are not<br />going to be performed, except for delete actions. |
| replicationFactor<a href="#v1beta1-vmclusterspec-replicationfactor" id="v1beta1-vmclusterspec-replicationfactor">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReplicationFactor defines how many copies of data make among<br />distinct storage nodes |
| requestsLoadBalancer<a href="#v1beta1-vmclusterspec-requestsloadbalancer" id="v1beta1-vmclusterspec-requestsloadbalancer">#</a><br/>_[VMAuthLoadBalancer (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancer)_ | _(Required)_<br/>RequestsLoadBalancer configures load-balancing for vminsert and vmselect requests.<br />It helps to evenly spread load across pods.<br />Usually it's not possible with Kubernetes TCP-based services.<br />See more [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/resources/vmcluster/#requests-load-balancing) |
| retentionPeriod<a href="#v1beta1-vmclusterspec-retentionperiod" id="v1beta1-vmclusterspec-retentionperiod">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RetentionPeriod defines how long to retain stored metrics, specified as a duration (e.g., "1d", "1w", "1m").<br />Data with timestamps outside the RetentionPeriod is automatically deleted. The minimum allowed value is 1d, or 24h.<br />The default value is 1 (one month).<br />See [retention](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#retention) docs for details. |
| serviceAccountName<a href="#v1beta1-vmclusterspec-serviceaccountname" id="v1beta1-vmclusterspec-serviceaccountname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceAccountName is the name of the ServiceAccount to use to run the<br />VMSelect, VMStorage and VMInsert Pods. |
| useLegacyNaming<a href="#v1beta1-vmclusterspec-uselegacynaming" id="v1beta1-vmclusterspec-uselegacynaming">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseLegacyNaming switches component resource naming from the default prefix convention<br />(<component>-<name>, e.g. "vmselect-myapp") to a suffix convention (<name>-<component>,<br />e.g. "myapp-vmselect"). Useful when migrating from standalone Helm charts.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0730">v0.73.0</a> |
| useStrictSecurity<a href="#v1beta1-vmclusterspec-usestrictsecurity" id="v1beta1-vmclusterspec-usestrictsecurity">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseStrictSecurity enables strict security mode for component<br />it restricts disk writes access<br />uses non-root user out of the box<br />drops not needed security permissions |
| vminsert<a href="#v1beta1-vmclusterspec-vminsert" id="v1beta1-vmclusterspec-vminsert">#</a><br/>_[VMInsert (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vminsert)_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |
| vmselect<a href="#v1beta1-vmclusterspec-vmselect" id="v1beta1-vmclusterspec-vmselect">#</a><br/>_[VMSelect (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmselect)_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |
| vmstorage<a href="#v1beta1-vmclusterspec-vmstorage" id="v1beta1-vmclusterspec-vmstorage">#</a><br/>_[VMStorage (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmstorage)_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |

#### VMNodeScrape {#v1beta1-vmnodescrape}

VMNodeScrape defines discovery for targets placed on kubernetes nodes,
usually its node-exporters and other host services.
InternalIP is used as __address__ for scraping.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| apiVersion<br/>_string_ | (Required)<br/>`operator.victoriametrics.com/v1beta1` |
| kind<br/>_string_ | (Required)<br/>`VMNodeScrape` |
| metadata<a href="#v1beta1-vmnodescrape-metadata" id="v1beta1-vmnodescrape-metadata">#</a><br/>_[ObjectMeta (v1)](#v1-objectmeta)_ | _(Required)_<br/>Refer to Kubernetes API documentation for fields of `metadata`. |
| spec<a href="#v1beta1-vmnodescrape-spec" id="v1beta1-vmnodescrape-spec">#</a><br/>_[VMNodeScrapeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmnodescrapespec)_ | _(Required)_<br/> |

#### VMNodeScrapeSpec {#v1beta1-vmnodescrapespec}

VMNodeScrapeSpec defines specification for VMNodeScrape.

Appears in: [VMNodeScrape (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmnodescrape)

| --- | --- |
| authorization<a href="#v1beta1-vmnodescrapespec-authorization" id="v1beta1-vmnodescrapespec-authorization">#</a><br/>_[Authorization (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-authorization)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Authorization with http header Authorization |
| basicAuth<a href="#v1beta1-vmnodescrapespec-basicauth" id="v1beta1-vmnodescrapespec-basicauth">#</a><br/>_[BasicAuth (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-basicauth)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>BasicAuth allow an endpoint to authenticate over basic authentication |
| bearerTokenFile<a href="#v1beta1-vmnodescrapespec-bearertokenfile" id="v1beta1-vmnodescrapespec-bearertokenfile">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>File to read bearer token for scraping targets. |

The secret<br />needs to be in the same namespace as the scrape object and accessible by<br />the victoria-metrics operator. |

| max_scrape_size<a href="#v1beta1-vmnodescrapespec-max_scrape_size" id="v1beta1-vmnodescrapespec-max_scrape_size">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MaxScrapeSize defines a maximum size of scraped data for a job |
| metricRelabelConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmnodescrapespec-metricrelabelconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmnodescrapespec-metricrelabelconfigs">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MetricRelabelConfigs to apply to samples after scrapping. |

| path<a href="#v1beta1-vmnodescrapespec-path" id="v1beta1-vmnodescrapespec-path">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HTTP path to scrape for metrics. |
