| bearerTokenSecret<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-bearertokensecret" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-bearertokensecret">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Secret to mount to read bearer token for scraping targets. The secret<br />needs to be in the same namespace as the scrape object and accessible by<br />the victoria-metrics operator. |
| consulAgentSDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-consulagentsdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-consulagentsdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[ConsulAgentSDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-consulagentsdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConsulAgentSDConfigs defines a list of Consul Agent service discovery configurations. |
| consulSDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-consulsdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-consulsdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[ConsulSDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-consulsdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConsulSDConfigs defines a list of Consul service discovery configurations. |
| digitalOceanSDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-digitaloceansdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-digitaloceansdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[DigitalOceanSDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-digitaloceansdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DigitalOceanSDConfigs defines a list of DigitalOcean service discovery configurations. |
| dnsSDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-dnssdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-dnssdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[DNSSDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-dnssdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DNSSDConfigs defines a list of DNS service discovery configurations. |
| dockerSDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-dockersdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-dockersdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[DockerSDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-dockersdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DockerSDConfigs defines a list of Docker service discovery configurations. |
| dockerSwarmSDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-dockerswarmsdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-dockerswarmsdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[DockerSwarmSDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-dockerswarmsdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DockerSwarmSDConfigs defines a list of Docker Swarm service discovery configurations. |
| ec2SDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-ec2sdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-ec2sdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[EC2SDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-ec2sdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EC2SDConfigs defines a list of EC2 service discovery configurations. |
| eurekaSDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-eurekasdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-eurekasdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[EurekaSDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-eurekasdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EurekaSDConfigs defines a list of Eureka service discovery configurations. |
| fileSDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-filesdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-filesdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[FileSDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-filesdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>FileSDConfigs defines a list of file service discovery configurations. |
| follow_redirects<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-follow_redirects" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-follow_redirects">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>FollowRedirects controls redirects for scraping. |
| gceSDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-gcesdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-gcesdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[GCESDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-gcesdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>GCESDConfigs defines a list of GCE service discovery configurations. |
| hetznerSDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-hetznersdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-hetznersdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[HetznerSDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-hetznersdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HetznerSDConfigs defines a list of Hetzner service discovery configurations. |
| honorLabels<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-honorlabels" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-honorlabels">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HonorLabels chooses the metric's labels on collisions with target labels. |
| honorTimestamps<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-honortimestamps" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-honortimestamps">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HonorTimestamps controls whether vmagent or vmsingle respects the timestamps present in scraped data. |
| httpSDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-httpsdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-httpsdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[HTTPSDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-httpsdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HTTPSDConfigs defines a list of HTTP service discovery configurations. |
| interval<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-interval" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-interval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Interval at which metrics should be scraped |
| kubernetesSDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-kubernetessdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-kubernetessdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[KubernetesSDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-kubernetessdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>KubernetesSDConfigs defines a list of Kubernetes service discovery configurations. |
| kumaSDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-kumasdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-kumasdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[KumaSDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-kumasdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>KumaSDConfigs defines a list of Kuma service discovery configurations. |
| marathonSDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-marathonsdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-marathonsdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[MarathonSDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-marathonsdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MarathonSDConfigs defines a list of Marathon service discovery configurations. |
| max_scrape_size<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-max_scrape_size" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-max_scrape_size">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MaxScrapeSize defines a maximum size of scraped data for a job |
| metricRelabelConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-metricrelabelconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-metricrelabelconfigs">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MetricRelabelConfigs to apply to samples after scrapping. |
| nomadSDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-nomadsdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-nomadsdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[NomadSDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-nomadsdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NomadSDConfigs defines a list of Nomad service discovery configurations. |
| oauth2<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-oauth2" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-oauth2">#</a><br/>_[OAuth2 (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-oauth2)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OAuth2 defines auth configuration |
| openstackSDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-openstacksdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-openstacksdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[OpenStackSDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-openstacksdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OpenStackSDConfigs defines a list of OpenStack service discovery configurations. |
| ovhcloudSDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-ovhcloudsdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-ovhcloudsdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[OVHCloudSDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-ovhcloudsdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OVHCloudSDConfigs defines a list of OVH Cloud service discovery configurations. |
| params<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-params" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-params">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string array)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Optional HTTP URL parameters |
| path<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-path" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-path">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HTTP path to scrape for metrics. |
| proxyURL<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-proxyurl" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-proxyurl">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProxyURL eg http://proxyserver:2195 Directs scrapes to proxy through this endpoint. |
| puppetDBSDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-puppetdbsdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-puppetdbsdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[PuppetDBSDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-puppetdbsdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PuppetDBSDConfigs defines a list of PuppetDB service discovery configurations. |
| relabelConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-relabelconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-relabelconfigs">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RelabelConfigs to apply to samples during service discovery. |
| sampleLimit<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-samplelimit" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-samplelimit">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SampleLimit defines per-scrape limit on number of scraped samples that will be accepted. |
| scheme<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-scheme" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-scheme">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HTTP scheme to use for scraping. |
| scrapeClass<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-scrapeclass" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-scrapeclass">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeClass defined scrape class to apply |
| scrapeTimeout<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-scrapetimeout" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-scrapetimeout">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Timeout after which the scrape is ended |
| scrape_interval<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-scrape_interval" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-scrape_interval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeInterval is the same as Interval and has priority over it.<br />one of scrape_interval or interval can be used |
| seriesLimit<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-serieslimit" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-serieslimit">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SeriesLimit defines per-scrape limit on number of unique time series<br />a single target can expose during all the scrapes on the time window of 24h. |
| staticConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-staticconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-staticconfigs">#</a><br/>_[StaticConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-staticconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StaticConfigs defines a list of static targets with a common label set. |
| tlsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-tlsconfig" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-tlsconfig">#</a><br/>_[TLSConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-tlsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TLSConfig configuration to use when scraping the endpoint |
| vm_scrape_params<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-vm_scrape_params" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-vm_scrape_params">#</a><br/>_[VMScrapeParams (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmscrapeparams)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VMScrapeParams defines VictoriaMetrics specific scrape parameters |
| vultrSDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-vultrsdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-vultrsdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[VultrSDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vultrsdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VultrSDConfigs defines a list of Vultr service discovery configurations. |
| yandexCloudSDConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-yandexcloudsdconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec-yandexcloudsdconfigs">#</a><br/>_[YandexCloudSDConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-yandexcloudsdconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>YandexCloudSDConfigs defines a list of Yandex Cloud service discovery configurations. |

#### VMScrapeParams {#v1beta1-vmscrapeparams}

VMScrapeParams defines scrape target configuration that compatible only with VictoriaMetrics scrapers
VMAgent and VMSingle

Appears in: [Endpoint (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-endpoint), [EndpointScrapeParams (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-endpointscrapeparams), [PodMetricsEndpoint (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-podmetricsendpoint), [TargetEndpoint (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-targetendpoint), [VMNodeScrapeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmnodescrapespec), [VMProbeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmprobespec), [VMScrapeConfigSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| disable_compression<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeparams-disable_compression" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeparams-disable_compression">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableCompression |
| disable_keep_alive<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeparams-disable_keep_alive" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeparams-disable_keep_alive">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>disable_keepalive allows disabling HTTP keep-alive when scraping targets.<br />By default, HTTP keep-alive is enabled, so TCP connections to scrape targets<br />could be reused.<br />See https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/#scrape_config-enhancements |
| headers<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeparams-headers" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeparams-headers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Headers allows sending custom headers to scrape targets<br />must be in of semicolon separated header with it's value<br />eg:<br />headerName: headerValue<br />vmagent and vmsingle support since 1.79.0 version |
| no_stale_markers<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeparams-no_stale_markers" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeparams-no_stale_markers">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |
| proxy_client_config<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeparams-proxy_client_config" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeparams-proxy_client_config">#</a><br/>_[ProxyClientConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-proxyclientconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProxyClientConfig configures proxy auth settings for scraping<br />See feature description https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/#scraping-targets-via-a-proxy |
| scrape_align_interval<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeparams-scrape_align_interval" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeparams-scrape_align_interval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |
| scrape_offset<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeparams-scrape_offset" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeparams-scrape_offset">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |
| stream_parse<a href="#v1beta1-vmscrapeparams-stream_parse" id="v1beta1-vmscrapeparams-stream_parse">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |

#### VMSelect {#v1beta1-vmselect}

VMSelect defines configuration section for vmselect components of the victoria-metrics cluster

Appears in: [VMClusterSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmclusterspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| affinity<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-affinity" id="v1beta1-vmselect-affinity">#</a><br/>_[Affinity (v1)](#v1-affinity)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Affinity If specified, the pod's scheduling constraints. |
| cacheMountPath<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-cachemountpath" id="v1beta1-vmselect-cachemountpath">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>CacheMountPath allows to add cache persistent for VMSelect,<br />will use "/cache" as default if not specified. |
| claimTemplates<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-claimtemplates" id="v1beta1-vmselect-claimtemplates">#</a><br/>_[PersistentVolumeClaim (v1)](#v1-persistentvolumeclaim) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>ClaimTemplates allows adding additional VolumeClaimTemplates for StatefulSet |
| clusterNativeListenPort<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-clusternativelistenport" id="v1beta1-vmselect-clusternativelistenport">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ClusterNativePort for multi-level cluster setup.<br />More [details](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/#multi-level-cluster-setup) |
| componentVersion<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-componentversion" id="v1beta1-vmselect-componentversion">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ComponentVersion defines default images tag for this component.<br />it can be overwritten with component specific image.tag value. |
| configMaps<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-configmaps" id="v1beta1-vmselect-configmaps">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigMaps is a list of ConfigMaps in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/configs/CONFIGMAP_NAME folder |
| containers<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-containers" id="v1beta1-vmselect-containers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Containers property allows to inject additions sidecars or to patch existing containers.<br />It can be useful for proxies, backup, etc. |
| disableAutomountServiceAccountToken<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken" id="v1beta1-vmselect-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableAutomountServiceAccountToken whether to disable serviceAccount auto mount by Kubernetes<br />Operator will conditionally create volumes and volumeMounts for containers if it requires k8s API access.<br />For example, vmagent and vm-config-reloader requires k8s API access.<br />Operator creates volumes with name: "kube-api-access", which can be used as volumeMount for extraContainers if needed.<br />And also adds VolumeMounts at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0540">v0.54.0</a> |
| disableSelfServiceScrape<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-disableselfservicescrape" id="v1beta1-vmselect-disableselfservicescrape">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableSelfServiceScrape controls creation of VMServiceScrape by operator<br />for the application.<br />Has priority over `VM_DISABLESELFSERVICESCRAPECREATION` operator env variable |
| discovery<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-discovery" id="v1beta1-vmselect-discovery">#</a><br/>_[VMClusterDiscovery (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmclusterdiscovery)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Discovery overrides the cluster-level discovery config for vmselect. |
| dnsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-dnsconfig" id="v1beta1-vmselect-dnsconfig">#</a><br/>_[PodDNSConfig (v1)](#v1-poddnsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Specifies the DNS parameters of a pod.<br />Parameters specified here will be merged to the generated DNS<br />configuration based on DNSPolicy. |
| dnsPolicy<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-dnspolicy" id="v1beta1-vmselect-dnspolicy">#</a><br/>_[DNSPolicy (v1)](#v1-dnspolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DNSPolicy sets DNS policy for the pod |
| enableServiceLinks<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-enableservicelinks" id="v1beta1-vmselect-enableservicelinks">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableServiceLinks indicates whether information about services should be injected into pod's<br />environment variables, matching the syntax of Docker links.<br />Optional: Defaults to true. |
| extraArgs<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-extraargs" id="v1beta1-vmselect-extraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraArgs that will be passed to the application container<br />for example remoteWrite.tmpDataPath: /tmp |
| extraEnvs<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-extraenvs" id="v1beta1-vmselect-extraenvs">#</a><br/>_[EnvVar (v1)](#v1-envvar) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvs that will be passed to the application container |
| extraEnvsFrom<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-extraenvsfrom" id="v1beta1-vmselect-extraenvsfrom">#</a><br/>_[EnvFromSource (v1)](#v1-envfromsource) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvsFrom defines source of env variables for the application container<br />could either be secret or configmap |
| extraStorageNodes<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-extrastoragenodes" id="v1beta1-vmselect-extrastoragenodes">#</a><br/>_[VMStorageNode (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmstoragenode) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraStorageNodes - defines additional storage nodes to VMSelect,<br />available for select only. Useful for adding an existing vmsingle nodes<br />to the cluster in a read-only mode.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0740">v0.74.0</a> |
| hostAliases<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-hostaliases" id="v1beta1-vmselect-hostaliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliases provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork. |
| hostNetwork<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-hostnetwork" id="v1beta1-vmselect-hostnetwork">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostNetwork controls whether the pod may use the node network namespace |
| host_aliases<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-host_aliases" id="v1beta1-vmselect-host_aliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliasesUnderScore provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork.<br />Has Priority over hostAliases field |
| hpa<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-hpa" id="v1beta1-vmselect-hpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedHPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedhpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configures horizontal pod autoscaling.<br />Note, enabling this option disables vmselect to vmselect communication. In most cases it's not an issue. |
| image<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-image" id="v1beta1-vmselect-image">#</a><br/>_[Image (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-image)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Image - docker image settings<br />if no specified operator uses default version from operator config |
| imagePullSecrets<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-imagepullsecrets" id="v1beta1-vmselect-imagepullsecrets">#</a><br/>_[LocalObjectReference (v1)](#v1-localobjectreference) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ImagePullSecrets An optional list of references to secrets in the same namespace<br />to use for pulling images from registries<br />see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images/#specifying-imagepullsecrets-on-a-pod |
| initContainers<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-initcontainers" id="v1beta1-vmselect-initcontainers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InitContainers allows adding initContainers to the pod definition.<br />Any errors during the execution of an initContainer will lead to a restart of the Pod.<br />More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/ |
| livenessProbe<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-livenessprobe" id="v1beta1-vmselect-livenessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LivenessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| logFormat<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-logformat" id="v1beta1-vmselect-logformat">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogFormat for VMSelect to be configured with.<br />default or json |
| logLevel<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-loglevel" id="v1beta1-vmselect-loglevel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogLevel for VMSelect to be configured with. |
| minReadySeconds<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-minreadyseconds" id="v1beta1-vmselect-minreadyseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MinReadySeconds defines a minimum number of seconds to wait before starting update next pod<br />if previous in healthy state<br />Has no effect for VLogs and VMSingle |
| networkPolicy<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-networkpolicy" id="v1beta1-vmselect-networkpolicy">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedNetworkPolicy (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddednetworkpolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NetworkPolicy defines network access rules for pods created by this CR. |
| nodeSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-nodeselector" id="v1beta1-vmselect-nodeselector">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeSelector Define which Nodes the Pods are scheduled on. |
| paused<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-paused" id="v1beta1-vmselect-paused">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Paused If set to true all actions on the underlying managed objects are not<br />going to be performed, except for delete actions. |
| persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-persistentvolumeclaimretentionpolicy" id="v1beta1-vmselect-persistentvolumeclaimretentionpolicy">#</a><br/>_[StatefulSetPersistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy (v1)](#v1-statefulsetpersistentvolumeclaimretentionpolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PersistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy allows configuration of PVC retention policy |
| podDisruptionBudget<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-poddisruptionbudget" id="v1beta1-vmselect-poddisruptionbudget">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedPodDisruptionBudgetSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedpoddisruptionbudgetspec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodDisruptionBudget created by operator |
| podMetadata<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-podmetadata" id="v1beta1-vmselect-podmetadata">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedObjectMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedobjectmetadata)_ | _(Required)_<br/>PodMetadata configures Labels and Annotations which are propagated to the VMSelect pods. |
| port<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-port" id="v1beta1-vmselect-port">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Port listen address |
| preStopSleepSeconds<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-prestopsleepseconds" id="v1beta1-vmselect-prestopsleepseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PreStopSleepSeconds defines the number of seconds to sleep in the preStop lifecycle hook.<br />It gives time for load balancers to remove the pod from rotation before the pod is terminated.<br />Defaults to 15 for applicable components. Set to 0 to disable. |
| priorityClassName<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-priorityclassname" id="v1beta1-vmselect-priorityclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PriorityClassName class assigned to the Pods |
| readinessGates<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-readinessgates" id="v1beta1-vmselect-readinessgates">#</a><br/>_[PodReadinessGate (v1)](#v1-podreadinessgate) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>ReadinessGates defines pod readiness gates |
| readinessProbe<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-readinessprobe" id="v1beta1-vmselect-readinessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReadinessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| replicaCount<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-replicacount" id="v1beta1-vmselect-replicacount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReplicaCount is the expected size of the Application. |
| resources<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-resources" id="v1beta1-vmselect-resources">#</a><br/>_[ResourceRequirements (v1)](#v1-resourcerequirements)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Resources container resource request and limits, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/<br />if not defined default resources from operator config will be used |
| revisionHistoryLimitCount<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-revisionhistorylimitcount" id="v1beta1-vmselect-revisionhistorylimitcount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The number of old ReplicaSets to retain to allow rollback in deployment or<br />maximum number of revisions that will be maintained in the Deployment revision history.<br />Has no effect at StatefulSets<br />Defaults to 10. |
| rollingUpdateStrategy<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-rollingupdatestrategy" id="v1beta1-vmselect-rollingupdatestrategy">#</a><br/>_[StatefulSetUpdateStrategyType (v1)](#v1-statefulsetupdatestrategytype)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RollingUpdateStrategy defines strategy for application updates<br />Default is OnDelete, in this case operator handles update process<br />Can be changed for RollingUpdate |
| rollingUpdateStrategyBehavior<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-rollingupdatestrategybehavior" id="v1beta1-vmselect-rollingupdatestrategybehavior">#</a><br/>_[StatefulSetUpdateStrategyBehavior (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-statefulsetupdatestrategybehavior)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RollingUpdateStrategyBehavior defines customized behavior for rolling updates.<br />It applies if the RollingUpdateStrategy is set to OnDelete, which is the default. |
| runtimeClassName<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-runtimeclassname" id="v1beta1-vmselect-runtimeclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RuntimeClassName - defines runtime class for kubernetes pod.<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/ |
| schedulerName<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-schedulername" id="v1beta1-vmselect-schedulername">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SchedulerName - defines kubernetes scheduler name |
| secrets<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-secrets" id="v1beta1-vmselect-secrets">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Secrets is a list of Secrets in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/secrets/SECRET_NAME folder |
| securityContext<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-securitycontext" id="v1beta1-vmselect-securitycontext">#</a><br/>_[SecurityContext (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-securitycontext)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SecurityContext holds pod-level security attributes and common container settings.<br />This defaults to the default PodSecurityContext. |
| serviceScrapeSpec<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-servicescrapespec" id="v1beta1-vmselect-servicescrapespec">#</a><br/>_[VMServiceScrapeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeSpec that will be added to vmselect VMServiceScrape spec |
| serviceSpec<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-servicespec" id="v1beta1-vmselect-servicespec">#</a><br/>_[AdditionalServiceSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-additionalservicespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceSpec that will be added to vmselect service spec |
| startupProbe<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-startupprobe" id="v1beta1-vmselect-startupprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StartupProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| storage<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-storage" id="v1beta1-vmselect-storage">#</a><br/>_[StorageSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-storagespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StorageSpec - add persistent volume claim for cacheMountPath<br />its needed for persistent cache |
| terminationGracePeriodSeconds<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-terminationgraceperiodseconds" id="v1beta1-vmselect-terminationgraceperiodseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TerminationGracePeriodSeconds period for container graceful termination |
| tolerations<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-tolerations" id="v1beta1-vmselect-tolerations">#</a><br/>_[Toleration (v1)](#v1-toleration) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Tolerations If specified, the pod's tolerations. |
| topologySpreadConstraints<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-topologyspreadconstraints" id="v1beta1-vmselect-topologyspreadconstraints">#</a><br/>_[TopologySpreadConstraint (v1)](#v1-topologyspreadconstraint) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TopologySpreadConstraints embedded kubernetes pod configuration option,<br />controls how pods are spread across your cluster among failure-domains<br />such as regions, zones, nodes, and other user-defined topology domains<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/ |
| useDefaultResources<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-usedefaultresources" id="v1beta1-vmselect-usedefaultresources">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseDefaultResources controls resource settings<br />By default, operator sets built-in resource requirements |
| useStrictSecurity<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-usestrictsecurity" id="v1beta1-vmselect-usestrictsecurity">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseStrictSecurity enables strict security mode for component<br />it restricts disk writes access<br />uses non-root user out of the box<br />drops not needed security permissions |
| volumeMounts<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-volumemounts" id="v1beta1-vmselect-volumemounts">#</a><br/>_[VolumeMount (v1)](#v1-volumemount) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>VolumeMounts allows configuration of additional VolumeMounts on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />VolumeMounts specified will be appended to other VolumeMounts in the Application container |
| volumes<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-volumes" id="v1beta1-vmselect-volumes">#</a><br/>_[Volume (v1)](#v1-volume) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Volumes allows configuration of additional volumes on the output Deployment/StatefulSet definition.<br />Volumes specified will be appended to other volumes that are generated. |
| vpa<a href="#v1beta1-vmselect-vpa" id="v1beta1-vmselect-vpa">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedVPA (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedvpa)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Configures vertical pod autoscaling. |

#### VMServiceScrape {#v1beta1-vmservicescrape}

VMServiceScrape is scrape configuration for endpoints associated with
kubernetes service,
it generates scrape configuration for vmagent based on selectors.
result config will scrape service endpoints

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| apiVersion<br/>_string_ | (Required)<br/>`operator.victoriametrics.com/v1beta1` |
| kind<br/>_string_ | (Required)<br/>`VMServiceScrape` |
| metadata<a href="#v1beta1-vmservicescrape-metadata" id="v1beta1-vmservicescrape-metadata">#</a><br/>_[ObjectMeta (v1)](#v1-objectmeta)_ | _(Required)_<br/>Refer to Kubernetes API documentation for fields of `metadata`. |
| spec<a href="#v1beta1-vmservicescrape-spec" id="v1beta1-vmservicescrape-spec">#</a><br/>_[VMServiceScrapeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec)_ | _(Required)_<br/> |

#### VMServiceScrapeSpec {#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec}

VMServiceScrapeSpec defines the desired state of VMServiceScrape

Appears in: [VLAgentSpec (v1)](#v1-vlagentspec), [VLInsert (v1)](#v1-vlinsert), [VLSelect (v1)](#v1-vlselect), [VLSingleSpec (v1)](#v1-vlsinglespec), [VLStorage (v1)](#v1-vlstorage), [VLogsSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vlogsspec), [VMAgentSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmagentspec), [VMAlertSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmalertspec), [VMAlertmanagerSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmalertmanagerspec), [VMAnomalySpec (v1)](#v1-vmanomalyspec), [VMAuthLoadBalancerSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmauthloadbalancerspec), [VMAuthSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmauthspec), [VMInsert (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vminsert), [VMSelect (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmselect), [VMServiceScrape (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmservicescrape), [VMSingleSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmsinglespec), [VMStorage (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmstorage), [VTInsert (v1)](#v1-vtinsert), [VTSelect (v1)](#v1-vtselect), [VTSingleSpec (v1)](#v1-vtsinglespec), [VTStorage (v1)](#v1-vtstorage)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| attach_metadata<a href="#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-attach_metadata" id="v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-attach_metadata">#</a><br/>_[AttachMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-attachmetadata)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>AttachMetadata configures metadata attaching from service discovery |
| discoveryRole<a href="#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-discoveryrole" id="v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-discoveryrole">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DiscoveryRole - defines kubernetes_sd role for objects discovery.<br />by default, its endpoints.<br />can be changed to service or endpointslices.<br />note, that with service setting, you have to use port: "name"<br />and cannot use targetPort for endpoints. |
| endpoints<a href="#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-endpoints" id="v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-endpoints">#</a><br/>_[Endpoint (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-endpoint) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>A list of endpoints allowed as part of this ServiceScrape. |
| jobLabel<a href="#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-joblabel" id="v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-joblabel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The label to use to retrieve the job name from. |
| namespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-namespaceselector" id="v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-namespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[NamespaceSelector (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-namespaceselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Selector to select which namespaces the Endpoints objects are discovered from. |
| podTargetLabels<a href="#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-podtargetlabels" id="v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-podtargetlabels">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodTargetLabels transfers labels on the Kubernetes Pod onto the target. |
| sampleLimit<a href="#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-samplelimit" id="v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-samplelimit">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SampleLimit defines per-scrape limit on number of scraped samples that will be accepted. |
| scrapeClass<a href="#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-scrapeclass" id="v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-scrapeclass">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeClass defined scrape class to apply |
| selector<a href="#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-selector" id="v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-selector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Selector to select Endpoints objects by corresponding Service labels. |
| seriesLimit<a href="#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-serieslimit" id="v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-serieslimit">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SeriesLimit defines per-scrape limit on number of unique time series<br />a single target can expose during all the scrapes on the time window of 24h. |
| targetLabels<a href="#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-targetlabels" id="v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec-targetlabels">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TargetLabels transfers labels on the Kubernetes Service onto the target. |

#### VMSingle {#v1beta1-vmsingle}

VMSingle  is fast, cost-effective and scalable time-series database.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| apiVersion<br/>_string_ | (Required)<br/>`operator.victoriametrics.com/v1beta1` |
| kind<br/>_string_ | (Required)<br/>`VMSingle` |

#### VMSingleSpec {#v1beta1-vmsinglespec}

VMSingleSpec defines the desired state of VMSingle

Appears in: [VMDistributedZoneSingle (v1alpha1)](#v1alpha1-vmdistributedzonesingle), [VMSingle (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmsingle)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| additionalScrapeConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-additionalscrapeconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-additionalscrapeconfigs">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>AdditionalScrapeConfigs As scrape configs are appended, the user is responsible to make sure it<br />is valid. Note that using this feature may expose the possibility to<br />break upgrades of VMAgent or VMSingle. It is advised to review VMAgent or VMSingle release<br />notes to ensure that no incompatible scrape configs are going to break<br />VMAgent or VMSingle after the upgrade. |
| affinity<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-affinity" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-affinity">#</a><br/>_[Affinity (v1)](#v1-affinity)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Affinity If specified, the pod's scheduling constraints. |
| apiServerConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-apiserverconfig" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-apiserverconfig">#</a><br/>_[APIServerConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-apiserverconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>APIServerConfig allows specifying a host and auth methods to access apiserver.<br />If left empty, VMSingle is assumed to run inside of the cluster<br />and will discover API servers automatically and use the pod's CA certificate<br />and bearer token file at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/. |
| arbitraryFSAccessThroughSMs<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsms" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsms">#</a><br/>_[ArbitraryFSAccessThroughSMsConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-arbitraryfsaccessthroughsmsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ArbitraryFSAccessThroughSMs configures whether configuration<br />based on EndpointAuth can access arbitrary files on the file system<br />of the VMAgent or VMSingle container e.g. bearer token files, basic auth, tls certs |
| componentVersion<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-componentversion" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-componentversion">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ComponentVersion defines default images tag for all components.<br />it can be overwritten with component specific image.tag value. |
| configMaps<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-configmaps" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-configmaps">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigMaps is a list of ConfigMaps in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/configs/CONFIGMAP_NAME folder |
| configReloadAuthKeySecret<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-configreloadauthkeysecret" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-configreloadauthkeysecret">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloadAuthKeySecret defines optional secret reference authKey for /-/reload API requests.<br />Given secret reference will be added to the application and vm-config-reloader as volume<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0570">v0.57.0</a> |
| configReloaderExtraArgs<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-configreloaderextraargs" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-configreloaderextraargs">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloaderExtraArgs that will be passed to  VMAuths config-reloader container<br />for example resync-interval: "30s" |
| configReloaderImage<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-configreloaderimage" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-configreloaderimage">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloaderImage defines image:tag for config-reloader container |
| configReloaderImageTag<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-configreloaderimagetag" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-configreloaderimagetag">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloaderImageTag defines image:tag for config-reloader container<br/><b>Deprecated: </b>since version <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0670">v0.67.0</a> will be removed in <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0690">v0.69.0</a> use <a href="#vmsinglespec-configreloaderimage">configReloaderImage</a> instead<br/> |
| configReloaderResources<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-configreloaderresources" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-configreloaderresources">#</a><br/>_[ResourceRequirements (v1)](#v1-resourcerequirements)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ConfigReloaderResources config-reloader container resource request and limits, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/<br />if not defined default resources from operator config will be used |
| containers<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-containers" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-containers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Containers property allows to inject additions sidecars or to patch existing containers.<br />It can be useful for proxies, backup, etc. |
| disableAutomountServiceAccountToken<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-disableautomountserviceaccounttoken">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableAutomountServiceAccountToken whether to disable serviceAccount auto mount by Kubernetes<br />Operator will conditionally create volumes and volumeMounts for containers if it requires k8s API access.<br />For example, vmagent and vm-config-reloader requires k8s API access.<br />Operator creates volumes with name: "kube-api-access", which can be used as volumeMount for extraContainers if needed.<br />And also adds VolumeMounts at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0540">v0.54.0</a> |
| disableSelfServiceScrape<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-disableselfservicescrape" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-disableselfservicescrape">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DisableSelfServiceScrape controls creation of VMServiceScrape by operator<br />for the application.<br />Has priority over `VM_DISABLESELFSERVICESCRAPECREATION` operator env variable |
| dnsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-dnsconfig" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-dnsconfig">#</a><br/>_[PodDNSConfig (v1)](#v1-poddnsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Specifies the DNS parameters of a pod.<br />Parameters specified here will be merged to the generated DNS<br />configuration based on DNSPolicy. |
| dnsPolicy<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-dnspolicy" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-dnspolicy">#</a><br/>_[DNSPolicy (v1)](#v1-dnspolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DNSPolicy sets DNS policy for the pod |
| downsampling<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-downsampling" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-downsampling">#</a><br/>_[DownsamplingConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-downsamplingconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Downsampling defines downsampling rules for VMSingle.<br />Requires enterprise license. See https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#downsampling |
| enableKubernetesAPISelectors<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-enablekubernetesapiselectors" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-enablekubernetesapiselectors">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableKubernetesAPISelectors instructs vmagent or vmsingle to use CRD scrape objects spec.selectors for<br />Kubernetes API list and watch requests.<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/#list-and-watch-filtering<br />It could be useful to reduce Kubernetes API server resource usage for serving less than 100 CRD scrape objects in total. |
| enableServiceLinks<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-enableservicelinks" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-enableservicelinks">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnableServiceLinks indicates whether information about services should be injected into pod's<br />environment variables, matching the syntax of Docker links.<br />Optional: Defaults to true. |
| enforcedNamespaceLabel<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-enforcednamespacelabel" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-enforcednamespacelabel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>EnforcedNamespaceLabel enforces adding a namespace label of origin for each alert<br />and metric that is user created. The label value will always be the namespace of the object that is<br />being created. |
| externalLabelName<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-externallabelname" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-externallabelname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExternalLabelName Name of external label used to denote scraping agent instance<br />name. Defaults to the value of `prometheus`. External label will<br />_not_ be added when value is set to empty string (`""`). |
| externalLabels<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-externallabels" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-externallabels">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExternalLabels The labels to add to any time series scraped by vmagent or vmsingle.<br />it doesn't affect metrics ingested directly by push API's |

| extraEnvs<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-extraenvs" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-extraenvs">#</a><br/>_[EnvVar (v1)](#v1-envvar) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ExtraEnvs that will be passed to the application container |

| globalScrapeMetricRelabelConfigs<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-globalscrapemetricrelabelconfigs" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-globalscrapemetricrelabelconfigs">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>GlobalScrapeMetricRelabelConfigs is a global metric relabel configuration, which is applied to each scrape job. |

| hostAliases<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-hostaliases" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-hostaliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliases provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork. |
| hostNetwork<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-hostnetwork" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-hostnetwork">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostNetwork controls whether the pod may use the node network namespace |
| host_aliases<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-host_aliases" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-host_aliases">#</a><br/>_[HostAlias (v1)](#v1-hostalias) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HostAliasesUnderScore provides mapping for ip and hostname,<br />that would be propagated to pod,<br />cannot be used with HostNetwork.<br />Has Priority over hostAliases field |
| ignoreNamespaceSelectors<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-ignorenamespaceselectors" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-ignorenamespaceselectors">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>IgnoreNamespaceSelectors if set to true will ignore NamespaceSelector settings from<br />scrape objects, and they will only discover endpoints<br />within their current namespace. Defaults to false. |
| image<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-image" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-image">#</a><br/>_[Image (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-image)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Image - docker image settings<br />if no specified operator uses default version from operator config |
| imagePullSecrets<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-imagepullsecrets" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-imagepullsecrets">#</a><br/>_[LocalObjectReference (v1)](#v1-localobjectreference) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ImagePullSecrets An optional list of references to secrets in the same namespace<br />to use for pulling images from registries<br />see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images/#specifying-imagepullsecrets-on-a-pod |
| ingestOnlyMode<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-ingestonlymode" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-ingestonlymode">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>IngestOnlyMode switches vmagent or vmsingle into unmanaged mode<br />it disables any config generation for scraping<br />Currently it prevents vmagent or vmsingle from managing tls and auth options for remote write |
| initContainers<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-initcontainers" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-initcontainers">#</a><br/>_[Container (v1)](#v1-container) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InitContainers allows adding initContainers to the pod definition.<br />Any errors during the execution of an initContainer will lead to a restart of the Pod.<br />More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/ |
| inlineRelabelConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-inlinerelabelconfig" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-inlinerelabelconfig">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InlineRelabelConfig - defines GlobalRelabelConfig for vmagent, can be defined directly at CRD. |
| inlineScrapeConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-inlinescrapeconfig" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-inlinescrapeconfig">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>InlineScrapeConfig As scrape configs are appended, the user is responsible to make sure it<br />is valid. Note that using this feature may expose the possibility to<br />break upgrades of VMAgent or VMSingle. It is advised to review VMAgent or VMSingle release<br />notes to ensure that no incompatible scrape configs are going to break<br />VMAgent or VMSingle after the upgrade.<br />it should be defined as single yaml file.<br />inlineScrapeConfig: \|<br />    - job_name: "prometheus"<br />      static_configs:<br />      - targets: ["localhost:9090"] |
| insertPorts<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-insertports" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-insertports">#</a><br/>_[InsertPorts (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-insertports)_ | _(Required)_<br/>InsertPorts - additional listen ports for data ingestion. |
| license<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-license" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-license">#</a><br/>_[License (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-license)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>License allows to configure license key to be used for enterprise features.<br />Using license key is supported starting from VictoriaMetrics v1.94.0.<br />See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/enterprise/) |
| livenessProbe<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-livenessprobe" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-livenessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LivenessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| logFormat<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-logformat" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-logformat">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogFormat for VMSingle to be configured with. |
| logLevel<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-loglevel" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-loglevel">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LogLevel for victoria metrics single to be configured with. |
| managedMetadata<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-managedmetadata" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-managedmetadata">#</a><br/>_[ManagedObjectsMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-managedobjectsmetadata)_ | _(Required)_<br/>ManagedMetadata defines metadata that will be added to the all objects<br />created by operator for the given CustomResource |
| maxScrapeInterval<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-maxscrapeinterval" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-maxscrapeinterval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>MaxScrapeInterval allows limiting maximum scrape interval for VMServiceScrape, VMPodScrape and other scrapes<br />If interval is higher than defined limit, `maxScrapeInterval` will be used. |
| minReadySeconds<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-minreadyseconds" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-minreadyseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MinReadySeconds defines a minimum number of seconds to wait before starting update next pod<br />if previous in healthy state<br />Has no effect for VLogs and VMSingle |
| minScrapeInterval<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-minscrapeinterval" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-minscrapeinterval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>MinScrapeInterval allows limiting minimal scrape interval for VMServiceScrape, VMPodScrape and other scrapes<br />If interval is lower than defined limit, `minScrapeInterval` will be used. |
| networkPolicy<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-networkpolicy" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-networkpolicy">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedNetworkPolicy (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddednetworkpolicy)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NetworkPolicy defines network access rules for pods created by this CR. |
| nodeScrapeNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-nodescrapenamespaceselector" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-nodescrapenamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeScrapeNamespaceSelector defines Namespaces to be selected for VMNodeScrape discovery.<br />Works in combination with Selector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| nodeScrapeRelabelTemplate<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-nodescraperelabeltemplate" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-nodescraperelabeltemplate">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeScrapeRelabelTemplate defines relabel config, that will be added to each VMNodeScrape.<br />it's useful for adding specific labels to all targets |
| nodeScrapeSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-nodescrapeselector" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-nodescrapeselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeScrapeSelector defines VMNodeScrape to be selected for scraping.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| nodeSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-nodeselector" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-nodeselector">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>NodeSelector Define which Nodes the Pods are scheduled on. |
| overrideHonorLabels<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-overridehonorlabels" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-overridehonorlabels">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OverrideHonorLabels if set to true overrides all user configured honor_labels.<br />If HonorLabels is set in scrape objects to true, this overrides honor_labels to false. |
| overrideHonorTimestamps<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-overridehonortimestamps" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-overridehonortimestamps">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OverrideHonorTimestamps allows to globally enforce honoring timestamps in all scrape configs. |
| paused<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-paused" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-paused">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Paused If set to true all actions on the underlying managed objects are not<br />going to be performed, except for delete actions. |
| podMetadata<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-podmetadata" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-podmetadata">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedObjectMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedobjectmetadata)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodMetadata configures Labels and Annotations which are propagated to the VMSingle pods. |
| podScrapeNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-podscrapenamespaceselector" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-podscrapenamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodScrapeNamespaceSelector defines Namespaces to be selected for VMPodScrape discovery.<br />Works in combination with Selector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| podScrapeRelabelTemplate<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-podscraperelabeltemplate" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-podscraperelabeltemplate">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodScrapeRelabelTemplate defines relabel config, that will be added to each VMPodScrape.<br />it's useful for adding specific labels to all targets |
| podScrapeSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-podscrapeselector" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-podscrapeselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PodScrapeSelector defines PodScrapes to be selected for target discovery.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| port<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-port" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-port">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Port listen address |
| preStopSleepSeconds<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-prestopsleepseconds" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-prestopsleepseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PreStopSleepSeconds defines the number of seconds to sleep in the preStop lifecycle hook.<br />It gives time for load balancers to remove the pod from rotation before the pod is terminated.<br />Defaults to 15 for applicable components. Set to 0 to disable. |
| priorityClassName<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-priorityclassname" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-priorityclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PriorityClassName class assigned to the Pods |
| probeNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-probenamespaceselector" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-probenamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProbeNamespaceSelector defines Namespaces to be selected for VMProbe discovery.<br />Works in combination with Selector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| probeScrapeRelabelTemplate<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-probescraperelabeltemplate" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-probescraperelabeltemplate">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProbeScrapeRelabelTemplate defines relabel config, that will be added to each VMProbeScrape.<br />it's useful for adding specific labels to all targets |
| probeSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-probeselector" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-probeselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProbeSelector defines VMProbe to be selected for target probing.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| readinessGates<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-readinessgates" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-readinessgates">#</a><br/>_[PodReadinessGate (v1)](#v1-podreadinessgate) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>ReadinessGates defines pod readiness gates |
| readinessProbe<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-readinessprobe" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-readinessprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReadinessProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| relabelConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-relabelconfig" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-relabelconfig">#</a><br/>_[ConfigMapKeySelector (v1)](#v1-configmapkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RelabelConfig ConfigMap with global relabel config -remoteWrite.relabelConfig<br />This relabeling is applied to all the collected metrics before sending them to remote storage. |
| removePvcAfterDelete<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-removepvcafterdelete" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-removepvcafterdelete">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RemovePvcAfterDelete - if true, controller adds ownership to pvc<br />and after VMSingle object deletion - pvc will be garbage collected<br />by controller manager |
| replicaCount<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-replicacount" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-replicacount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ReplicaCount is the expected size of the Application. |
| resources<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-resources" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-resources">#</a><br/>_[ResourceRequirements (v1)](#v1-resourcerequirements)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Resources container resource request and limits, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/<br />if not defined default resources from operator config will be used |
| retentionFilters<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-retentionfilters" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-retentionfilters">#</a><br/>_[RetentionFiltersConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-retentionfiltersconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RetentionFilters defines per-series retention filters for VMSingle.<br />Requires enterprise license. See https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#retention-filters |
| retentionPeriod<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-retentionperiod" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-retentionperiod">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RetentionPeriod defines how long to retain stored metrics, specified as a duration (e.g., "1d", "1w", "1m").<br />Data with timestamps outside the RetentionPeriod is automatically deleted. The minimum allowed value is 1d, or 24h.<br />The default value is 1 (one month).<br />See [retention](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#retention) docs for details. |
| revisionHistoryLimitCount<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-revisionhistorylimitcount" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-revisionhistorylimitcount">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The number of old ReplicaSets to retain to allow rollback in deployment or<br />maximum number of revisions that will be maintained in the Deployment revision history.<br />Has no effect at StatefulSets<br />Defaults to 10. |
| runtimeClassName<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-runtimeclassname" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-runtimeclassname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RuntimeClassName - defines runtime class for kubernetes pod.<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/ |
| sampleLimit<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-samplelimit" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-samplelimit">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SampleLimit defines global per target limit of scraped samples |
| schedulerName<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-schedulername" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-schedulername">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SchedulerName - defines kubernetes scheduler name |
| scrapeClasses<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-scrapeclasses" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-scrapeclasses">#</a><br/>_[ScrapeClass (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-scrapeclass) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeClasses defines the list of scrape classes to expose to scraping objects such as<br />PodScrapes, ServiceScrapes, Probes and ScrapeConfigs. |
| scrapeConfigNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-scrapeconfignamespaceselector" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-scrapeconfignamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeConfigNamespaceSelector defines Namespaces to be selected for VMScrapeConfig discovery.<br />Works in combination with Selector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| scrapeConfigRelabelTemplate<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-scrapeconfigrelabeltemplate" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-scrapeconfigrelabeltemplate">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeConfigRelabelTemplate defines relabel config, that will be added to each VMScrapeConfig.<br />it's useful for adding specific labels to all targets |
| scrapeConfigSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-scrapeconfigselector" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-scrapeconfigselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeConfigSelector defines VMScrapeConfig to be selected for target discovery.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector. |
| scrapeInterval<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-scrapeinterval" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-scrapeinterval">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeInterval defines how often scrape targets by default |
| scrapeTimeout<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-scrapetimeout" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-scrapetimeout">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ScrapeTimeout defines global timeout for targets scrape |
| secrets<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-secrets" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-secrets">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Secrets is a list of Secrets in the same namespace as the Application<br />object, which shall be mounted into the Application container<br />at /etc/vm/secrets/SECRET_NAME folder |
| securityContext<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-securitycontext" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-securitycontext">#</a><br/>_[SecurityContext (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-securitycontext)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SecurityContext holds pod-level security attributes and common container settings.<br />This defaults to the default PodSecurityContext. |
| selectAllByDefault<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-selectallbydefault" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-selectallbydefault">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SelectAllByDefault changes default behavior for empty CRD selectors, such ServiceScrapeSelector.<br />with selectAllByDefault: true and empty serviceScrapeSelector and ServiceScrapeNamespaceSelector<br />Operator selects all exist serviceScrapes<br />with selectAllByDefault: false - selects nothing |
| serviceAccountName<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-serviceaccountname" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-serviceaccountname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceAccountName is the name of the ServiceAccount to use to run the pods |
| serviceScrapeNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-servicescrapenamespaceselector" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-servicescrapenamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeNamespaceSelector Namespaces to be selected for VMServiceScrape discovery.<br />Works in combination with Selector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| serviceScrapeRelabelTemplate<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-servicescraperelabeltemplate" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-servicescraperelabeltemplate">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeRelabelTemplate defines relabel config, that will be added to each VMServiceScrape.<br />it's useful for adding specific labels to all targets |
| serviceScrapeSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-servicescrapeselector" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-servicescrapeselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeSelector defines ServiceScrapes to be selected for target discovery.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| serviceScrapeSpec<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-servicescrapespec" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-servicescrapespec">#</a><br/>_[VMServiceScrapeSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmservicescrapespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceScrapeSpec that will be added to vmsingle VMServiceScrape spec |
| serviceSpec<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-servicespec" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-servicespec">#</a><br/>_[AdditionalServiceSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-additionalservicespec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ServiceSpec that will be added to vmsingle service spec |
| startupProbe<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-startupprobe" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-startupprobe">#</a><br/>_[Probe (v1)](#v1-probe)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StartupProbe that will be added to CR pod |
| staticScrapeNamespaceSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-staticscrapenamespaceselector" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-staticscrapenamespaceselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StaticScrapeNamespaceSelector defines Namespaces to be selected for VMStaticScrape discovery.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces.<br />If both nil - behaviour controlled by selectAllByDefault |
| staticScrapeRelabelTemplate<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-staticscraperelabeltemplate" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-staticscraperelabeltemplate">#</a><br/>_[RelabelConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-relabelconfig) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StaticScrapeRelabelTemplate defines relabel config, that will be added to each VMStaticScrape.<br />it's useful for adding specific labels to all targets |
| staticScrapeSelector<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-staticscrapeselector" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-staticscrapeselector">#</a><br/>_[LabelSelector (v1)](#v1-labelselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StaticScrapeSelector defines VMStaticScrape to be selected for target discovery.<br />Works in combination with NamespaceSelector.<br />If both nil - match everything.<br />NamespaceSelector nil - only objects at VMAgent or VMSingle namespace.<br />Selector nil - only objects at NamespaceSelector namespaces. |
| storage<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-storage" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-storage">#</a><br/>_[PersistentVolumeClaimSpec (v1)](#v1-persistentvolumeclaimspec)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Storage is the definition of how storage will be used by the VMSingle<br />by default it`s empty dir<br />this option is ignored if storageDataPath is set |
| storageDataPath<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-storagedatapath" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-storagedatapath">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StorageDataPath disables spec.storage option and overrides arg for victoria-metrics binary --storageDataPath,<br />its users responsibility to mount proper device into given path.<br />It requires to provide spec.volumes and spec.volumeMounts with at least 1 value |
| storageMetadata<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-storagemetadata" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-storagemetadata">#</a><br/>_[EmbeddedObjectMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-embeddedobjectmetadata)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>StorageMeta defines annotations and labels attached to PVC for given vmsingle CR |
| streamAggrConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-streamaggrconfig" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-streamaggrconfig">#</a><br/>_[StreamAggrConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-streamaggrconfig)_ | _(Required)_<br/>StreamAggrConfig defines stream aggregation configuration for VMSingle |
| terminationGracePeriodSeconds<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-terminationgraceperiodseconds" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-terminationgraceperiodseconds">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TerminationGracePeriodSeconds period for container graceful termination |
| tolerations<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-tolerations" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-tolerations">#</a><br/>_[Toleration (v1)](#v1-toleration) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Tolerations If specified, the pod's tolerations. |
| topologySpreadConstraints<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-topologyspreadconstraints" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-topologyspreadconstraints">#</a><br/>_[TopologySpreadConstraint (v1)](#v1-topologyspreadconstraint) array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TopologySpreadConstraints embedded kubernetes pod configuration option,<br />controls how pods are spread across your cluster among failure-domains<br />such as regions, zones, nodes, and other user-defined topology domains<br />https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/ |

| useStrictSecurity<a href="#v1beta1-vmsinglespec-usestrictsecurity" id="v1beta1-vmsinglespec-usestrictsecurity">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseStrictSecurity enables strict security mode for component<br />it restricts disk writes access<br />uses non-root user out of the box<br />drops not needed security permissions |

It uses secrets watch instead of file watch<br />which greatly increases speed of config updates<br/><b>Deprecated: </b>will be removed in <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0670">v0.67.0</a><br/> |

Defaults to the value of `prometheus`. External label will<br />_not_ be added when value is set to empty string (`""`).<br/><b>Deprecated: </b>since version <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0670">v0.67.0</a> will be removed in <a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0690">v0.69.0</a> use <a href="#vmsinglespec-externallabelname">externalLabelName</a> instead<br/> |

| Field | Description |

| jobName<a href="#v1beta1-vmstaticscrapespec-jobname" id="v1beta1-vmstaticscrapespec-jobname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>JobName name of job. |

#### VMUserAccessLog {#v1beta1-vmuseraccesslog}

VMUserAccessLog defines per-user access log configuration for vmauth.

Appears in: [VMAuthSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmauthspec), [VMAuthUnauthorizedUserAccessSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec), [VMUserConfigOptions (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions), [VMUserSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmuserspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| filters<a href="#v1beta1-vmuseraccesslog-filters" id="v1beta1-vmuseraccesslog-filters">#</a><br/>_[VMUserAccessLogFilters (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmuseraccesslogfilters)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Filters defines optional filters that control which requests are logged. |

#### VMUserAccessLogFilters {#v1beta1-vmuseraccesslogfilters}

VMUserAccessLogFilters defines filters for vmauth per-user access log.

Appears in: [VMUserAccessLog (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmuseraccesslog)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| skip_status_codes<a href="#v1beta1-vmuseraccesslogfilters-skip_status_codes" id="v1beta1-vmuseraccesslogfilters-skip_status_codes">#</a><br/>_integer array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SkipStatusCodes lists HTTP status codes whose responses are excluded from the access log.<br />For example, [200, 204] suppresses logging of successful responses. |

#### VMUserConfigOptions {#v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions}

VMUserConfigOptions defines configuration options for VMUser object

Appears in: [VMAuthSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmauthspec), [VMAuthUnauthorizedUserAccessSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmauthunauthorizeduseraccessspec), [VMUserSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmuserspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| access_log<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-access_log" id="v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-access_log">#</a><br/>_[VMUserAccessLog (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmuseraccesslog)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>AccessLog configures per-user access logging.<br />When set, vmauth logs each request for this user with fields including<br />request_uri, status_code, duration_ms, username, etc.<br />See https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#access-log<br />available since v1.138.0 vmauth version<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0730">v0.73.0</a> |
| default_url<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-default_url" id="v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-default_url">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Required)_<br/>DefaultURLs backend url for non-matching paths filter<br />usually used for default backend with error message |
| discover_backend_ips<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-discover_backend_ips" id="v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-discover_backend_ips">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>DiscoverBackendIPs instructs discovering URLPrefix backend IPs via DNS. |
| drop_src_path_prefix_parts<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-drop_src_path_prefix_parts" id="v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-drop_src_path_prefix_parts">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DropSrcPathPrefixParts is the number of `/`-delimited request path prefix parts to drop before proxying the request to backend.<br />See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#dropping-request-path-prefix) for more details. |
| dump_request_on_errors<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-dump_request_on_errors" id="v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-dump_request_on_errors">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DumpRequestOnErrors instructs vmauth to return detailed request params to the client<br />if routing rules don't allow to forward request to the backends.<br />Useful for debugging `src_hosts` and `src_headers` based routing rules<br />available since v1.107.0 vmauth version |
| headers<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-headers" id="v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-headers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Headers represent additional http headers, that vmauth uses<br />in form of ["header_key: header_value"]<br />multiple values for header key:<br />["header_key: value1,value2"]<br />it's available since 1.68.0 version of vmauth |
| ip_filters<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-ip_filters" id="v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-ip_filters">#</a><br/>_[VMUserIPFilters (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmuseripfilters)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>IPFilters defines per target src ip filters<br />supported only with enterprise version of [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#ip-filters) |
| load_balancing_policy<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-load_balancing_policy" id="v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-load_balancing_policy">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LoadBalancingPolicy defines load balancing policy to use for backend urls.<br />Supported policies: least_loaded, first_available.<br />See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#load-balancing) for more details (default "least_loaded") |
| max_concurrent_requests<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-max_concurrent_requests" id="v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-max_concurrent_requests">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MaxConcurrentRequests defines max concurrent requests per user<br />300 is default value for vmauth |
| response_headers<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-response_headers" id="v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-response_headers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ResponseHeaders represent additional http headers, that vmauth adds for request response<br />in form of ["header_key: header_value"]<br />multiple values for header key:<br />["header_key: value1,value2"]<br />it's available since 1.93.0 version of vmauth |
| retry_status_codes<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-retry_status_codes" id="v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-retry_status_codes">#</a><br/>_integer array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RetryStatusCodes defines http status codes in numeric format for request retries<br />e.g. [429,503] |
| tlsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-tlsconfig" id="v1beta1-vmuserconfigoptions-tlsconfig">#</a><br/>_[TLSConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-tlsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TLSConfig defines tls configuration for the backend connection |
