#### VMUserJWT {#v1beta1-vmuserjwt}

VMUserJWT defines configuration for JWT

Appears in: [VMUserSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmuserspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| defaultVMAccessClaim<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserjwt-defaultvmaccessclaim" id="v1beta1-vmuserjwt-defaultvmaccessclaim">#</a><br/>_[VMAccessClaim (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmaccessclaim)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DefaultVMAccessClaim defines vm_access claim parameters to use when a JWT<br />doesn't carry a vm_access claim of its own. Set to an empty object to opt in<br />a token that only needs to pass matchClaims/oidc verification without vm_access.<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0740">v0.74.0</a> |
| matchClaims<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserjwt-matchclaims" id="v1beta1-vmuserjwt-matchclaims">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Required)_<br/>MatchClaims enables claim based routing |
| oidc<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserjwt-oidc" id="v1beta1-vmuserjwt-oidc">#</a><br/>_[VMUserOIDC (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmuseroidc)_ | _(Required)_<br/>OIDC defines OIDC configuration section |
| publicKeyRefs<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserjwt-publickeyrefs" id="v1beta1-vmuserjwt-publickeyrefs">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>PublicKeyRefs defines a list of Secret selectors that reference public keys |
| publicKeys<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserjwt-publickeys" id="v1beta1-vmuserjwt-publickeys">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Required)_<br/>PublicKeys defines a list of public keys that are used for signature verification |
| skipVerify<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserjwt-skipverify" id="v1beta1-vmuserjwt-skipverify">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>SkipVerify skips signature verification for testing purposes |

#### VMUserSpec {#v1beta1-vmuserspec}

VMUserSpec defines the desired state of VMUser

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| access_log<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-access_log" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-access_log">#</a><br/>_[VMUserAccessLog (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmuseraccesslog)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>AccessLog configures per-user access logging.<br />When set, vmauth logs each request for this user with fields including<br />request_uri, status_code, duration_ms, username, etc.<br />See https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#access-log<br />available since v1.138.0 vmauth version<br/><b>Available from: </b><a href="https://docs.victoriametrics.com/operator/changelog/#v0730">v0.73.0</a> |
| bearerToken<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-bearertoken" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-bearertoken">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>BearerToken Authorization header value for accessing protected endpoint. |
| default_url<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-default_url" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-default_url">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Required)_<br/>DefaultURLs backend url for non-matching paths filter<br />usually used for default backend with error message |
| disable_secret_creation<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-disable_secret_creation" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-disable_secret_creation">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>DisableSecretCreation skips related secret creation for vmuser |
| discover_backend_ips<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-discover_backend_ips" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-discover_backend_ips">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Required)_<br/>DiscoverBackendIPs instructs discovering URLPrefix backend IPs via DNS. |
| drop_src_path_prefix_parts<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-drop_src_path_prefix_parts" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-drop_src_path_prefix_parts">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DropSrcPathPrefixParts is the number of `/`-delimited request path prefix parts to drop before proxying the request to backend.<br />See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#dropping-request-path-prefix) for more details. |
| dump_request_on_errors<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-dump_request_on_errors" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-dump_request_on_errors">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>DumpRequestOnErrors instructs vmauth to return detailed request params to the client<br />if routing rules don't allow to forward request to the backends.<br />Useful for debugging `src_hosts` and `src_headers` based routing rules<br />available since v1.107.0 vmauth version |
| generatePassword<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-generatepassword" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-generatepassword">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>GeneratePassword instructs operator to generate password for user<br />if spec.password if empty. |
| headers<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-headers" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-headers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Headers represent additional http headers, that vmauth uses<br />in form of ["header_key: header_value"]<br />multiple values for header key:<br />["header_key: value1,value2"]<br />it's available since 1.68.0 version of vmauth |
| ip_filters<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-ip_filters" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-ip_filters">#</a><br/>_[VMUserIPFilters (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmuseripfilters)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>IPFilters defines per target src ip filters<br />supported only with enterprise version of [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#ip-filters) |
| jwt<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-jwt" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-jwt">#</a><br/>_[VMUserJWT (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmuserjwt)_ | _(Required)_<br/>JWT defines JWT based auth for a user |
| load_balancing_policy<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-load_balancing_policy" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-load_balancing_policy">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>LoadBalancingPolicy defines load balancing policy to use for backend urls.<br />Supported policies: least_loaded, first_available.<br />See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#load-balancing) for more details (default "least_loaded") |
| managedMetadata<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-managedmetadata" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-managedmetadata">#</a><br/>_[ManagedObjectsMetadata (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-managedobjectsmetadata)_ | _(Required)_<br/>ManagedMetadata defines metadata that will be added to the all objects<br />created by operator for the given CustomResource |
| max_concurrent_requests<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-max_concurrent_requests" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-max_concurrent_requests">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MaxConcurrentRequests defines max concurrent requests per user<br />300 is default value for vmauth |
| metric_labels<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-metric_labels" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-metric_labels">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MetricLabels - additional labels for metrics exported by vmauth for given user. |
| name<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-name" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-name">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Name of the VMUser object. |
| password<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-password" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-password">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Password basic auth password for accessing protected endpoint. |
| passwordRef<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-passwordref" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-passwordref">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>PasswordRef allows fetching password from user-create secret by its name and key. |
| response_headers<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-response_headers" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-response_headers">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ResponseHeaders represent additional http headers, that vmauth adds for request response<br />in form of ["header_key: header_value"]<br />multiple values for header key:<br />["header_key: value1,value2"]<br />it's available since 1.93.0 version of vmauth |
| retry_status_codes<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-retry_status_codes" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-retry_status_codes">#</a><br/>_integer array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>RetryStatusCodes defines http status codes in numeric format for request retries<br />e.g. [429,503] |
| targetRefs<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-targetrefs" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-targetrefs">#</a><br/>_[TargetRef (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-targetref) array_ | _(Required)_<br/>TargetRefs - reference to endpoints, which user may access. |
| tlsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-tlsconfig" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-tlsconfig">#</a><br/>_[TLSConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-tlsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TLSConfig defines tls configuration for the backend connection |
| tokenRef<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-tokenref" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-tokenref">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TokenRef allows fetching token from user-created secrets by its name and key. |
| useLegacyNaming<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-uselegacynaming" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-uselegacynaming">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>UseLegacyNaming uses standalone Helm chart naming for managed resources:<br />the CR name is used directly instead of the default "<type>-<name>" convention. |
| username<a href="#v1beta1-vmuserspec-username" id="v1beta1-vmuserspec-username">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Username basic auth user name for accessing protected endpoint,<br />will be replaced with metadata.name of VMUser if omitted. |

#### VictorOpsConfig {#v1beta1-victoropsconfig}

VictorOpsConfig configures notifications via VictorOps.
See https://prometheus.io/docs/alerting/latest/configuration/#victorops_config

Appears in: [Receiver (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-receiver)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| api_key<a href="#v1beta1-victoropsconfig-api_key" id="v1beta1-victoropsconfig-api_key">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The secret's key that contains the API key to use when talking to the VictorOps API.<br />It must be at them same namespace as CRD<br />fallback to global setting if empty |
| api_url<a href="#v1beta1-victoropsconfig-api_url" id="v1beta1-victoropsconfig-api_url">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The VictorOps API URL. |
| custom_fields<a href="#v1beta1-victoropsconfig-custom_fields" id="v1beta1-victoropsconfig-custom_fields">#</a><br/>_object (keys:string, values:string)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Adds optional custom fields<br />https://github.com/prometheus/alertmanager/blob/v0.24.0/config/notifiers.go#L537 |
| entity_display_name<a href="#v1beta1-victoropsconfig-entity_display_name" id="v1beta1-victoropsconfig-entity_display_name">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Contains summary of the alerted problem. |
| http_config<a href="#v1beta1-victoropsconfig-http_config" id="v1beta1-victoropsconfig-http_config">#</a><br/>_[HTTPConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-httpconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The HTTP client's configuration. |
| message_type<a href="#v1beta1-victoropsconfig-message_type" id="v1beta1-victoropsconfig-message_type">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Describes the behavior of the alert (CRITICAL, WARNING, INFO). |
| monitoring_tool<a href="#v1beta1-victoropsconfig-monitoring_tool" id="v1beta1-victoropsconfig-monitoring_tool">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The monitoring tool the state message is from. |
| routing_key<a href="#v1beta1-victoropsconfig-routing_key" id="v1beta1-victoropsconfig-routing_key">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>A key used to map the alert to a team. |
| send_resolved<a href="#v1beta1-victoropsconfig-send_resolved" id="v1beta1-victoropsconfig-send_resolved">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SendResolved controls notify about resolved alerts. |
| state_message<a href="#v1beta1-victoropsconfig-state_message" id="v1beta1-victoropsconfig-state_message">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Contains long explanation of the alerted problem. |

#### VultrSDConfig {#v1beta1-vultrsdconfig}

VultrSDConfig configurations allows retrieving scrape targets from Vultr instances.
See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/sd_configs/#vultr_sd_configs)

Appears in: [VMScrapeConfigSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| authorization<a href="#v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-authorization" id="v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-authorization">#</a><br/>_[Authorization (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-authorization)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Authorization header to use on every scrape request. |
| basicAuth<a href="#v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-basicauth" id="v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-basicauth">#</a><br/>_[BasicAuth (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-basicauth)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>BasicAuth information to use on every scrape request. |
| firewallGroupID<a href="#v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-firewallgroupid" id="v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-firewallgroupid">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>FirewallGroupID is an optional query arguments to filter instances by firewall group id. |

| hostname<a href="#v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-hostname" id="v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-hostname">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Hostname is an optional query arguments to filter instances by hostname. |
| label<a href="#v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-label" id="v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-label">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Label is an optional query arguments to filter instances by label. |
| mainIP<a href="#v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-mainip" id="v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-mainip">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>MainIP is an optional query arguments to filter instances by main ip address. |
| oauth2<a href="#v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-oauth2" id="v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-oauth2">#</a><br/>_[OAuth2 (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-oauth2)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>OAuth2 defines auth configuration |
| port<a href="#v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-port" id="v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-port">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Port is an optional port to scrape metrics from. |
| proxyURL<a href="#v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-proxyurl" id="v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-proxyurl">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProxyURL eg http://proxyserver:2195 Directs scrapes to proxy through this endpoint. |
| proxy_client_config<a href="#v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-proxy_client_config" id="v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-proxy_client_config">#</a><br/>_[ProxyClientConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-proxyclientconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>ProxyClientConfig configures proxy auth settings for scraping<br />See [feature description](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/#scraping-targets-via-a-proxy) |
| region<a href="#v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-region" id="v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-region">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Region is an optional query arguments to filter instances by region id. |
| tlsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-tlsconfig" id="v1beta1-vultrsdconfig-tlsconfig">#</a><br/>_[TLSConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-tlsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TLS configuration to use on every scrape request |

#### WebhookConfig {#v1beta1-webhookconfig}

WebhookConfig configures notifications via a generic receiver supporting the webhook payload.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| http_config<a href="#v1beta1-webhookconfig-http_config" id="v1beta1-webhookconfig-http_config">#</a><br/>_[HTTPConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-httpconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HTTP client configuration. |
| max_alerts<a href="#v1beta1-webhookconfig-max_alerts" id="v1beta1-webhookconfig-max_alerts">#</a><br/>_integer_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Maximum number of alerts to be sent per webhook message. When 0, all alerts are included. |
| send_resolved<a href="#v1beta1-webhookconfig-send_resolved" id="v1beta1-webhookconfig-send_resolved">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SendResolved controls notify about resolved alerts. |
| timeout<a href="#v1beta1-webhookconfig-timeout" id="v1beta1-webhookconfig-timeout">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>Timeout is the maximum time allowed to invoke the webhook<br />available since v0.28.0 alertmanager version |
| url<a href="#v1beta1-webhookconfig-url" id="v1beta1-webhookconfig-url">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>URL to send requests to,<br />one of `urlSecret` and `url` must be defined. |
| url_secret<a href="#v1beta1-webhookconfig-url_secret" id="v1beta1-webhookconfig-url_secret">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>URLSecret defines secret name and key at the CRD namespace.<br />It must contain the webhook URL.<br />one of `urlSecret` and `url` must be defined. |

#### WechatConfig {#v1beta1-wechatconfig}

WechatConfig configures notifications via Wechat.
See https://prometheus.io/docs/alerting/latest/configuration/#wechat_config

Appears in: [Receiver (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-receiver)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| agent_id<a href="#v1beta1-wechatconfig-agent_id" id="v1beta1-wechatconfig-agent_id">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |
| api_secret<a href="#v1beta1-wechatconfig-api_secret" id="v1beta1-wechatconfig-api_secret">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The secret's key that contains the WeChat API key.<br />The secret needs to be in the same namespace as the AlertmanagerConfig<br />fallback to global alertmanager setting if empty |
| api_url<a href="#v1beta1-wechatconfig-api_url" id="v1beta1-wechatconfig-api_url">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The WeChat API URL.<br />fallback to global alertmanager setting if empty |
| corp_id<a href="#v1beta1-wechatconfig-corp_id" id="v1beta1-wechatconfig-corp_id">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>The corp id for authentication.<br />fallback to global alertmanager setting if empty |
| http_config<a href="#v1beta1-wechatconfig-http_config" id="v1beta1-wechatconfig-http_config">#</a><br/>_[HTTPConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-httpconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>HTTP client configuration. |
| message<a href="#v1beta1-wechatconfig-message" id="v1beta1-wechatconfig-message">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>API request data as defined by the WeChat API. |
| message_type<a href="#v1beta1-wechatconfig-message_type" id="v1beta1-wechatconfig-message_type">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |
| send_resolved<a href="#v1beta1-wechatconfig-send_resolved" id="v1beta1-wechatconfig-send_resolved">#</a><br/>_boolean_ | _(Optional)_<br/>SendResolved controls notify about resolved alerts. |
| to_party<a href="#v1beta1-wechatconfig-to_party" id="v1beta1-wechatconfig-to_party">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |
| to_tag<a href="#v1beta1-wechatconfig-to_tag" id="v1beta1-wechatconfig-to_tag">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |
| to_user<a href="#v1beta1-wechatconfig-to_user" id="v1beta1-wechatconfig-to_user">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/> |

#### YandexCloudSDConfig {#v1beta1-yandexcloudsdconfig}

YandexCloudSDConfig configurations allows retrieving scrape targets from Yandex Cloud.
See [here](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/sd_configs/#yandexcloud_sd_configs)

Appears in: [VMScrapeConfigSpec (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-vmscrapeconfigspec)

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| apiEndpoint<a href="#v1beta1-yandexcloudsdconfig-apiendpoint" id="v1beta1-yandexcloudsdconfig-apiendpoint">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Optional)_<br/>APIEndpoint is the Yandex Cloud API endpoint. |
| folderIDs<a href="#v1beta1-yandexcloudsdconfig-folderids" id="v1beta1-yandexcloudsdconfig-folderids">#</a><br/>_string array_ | _(Optional)_<br/>FolderIDs are the Yandex Cloud folder IDs to discover resources in. |
| service<a href="#v1beta1-yandexcloudsdconfig-service" id="v1beta1-yandexcloudsdconfig-service">#</a><br/>_string_ | _(Required)_<br/>Service is the Yandex Cloud service to discover targets for. |
| tlsConfig<a href="#v1beta1-yandexcloudsdconfig-tlsconfig" id="v1beta1-yandexcloudsdconfig-tlsconfig">#</a><br/>_[TLSConfig (v1beta1)](#v1beta1-tlsconfig)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>TLSConfig to use on every scrape request. |
| yandexPassportOAuthToken<a href="#v1beta1-yandexcloudsdconfig-yandexpassportoauthtoken" id="v1beta1-yandexcloudsdconfig-yandexpassportoauthtoken">#</a><br/>_[SecretKeySelector (v1)](#v1-secretkeyselector)_ | _(Optional)_<br/>YandexPassportOAuthToken is the Yandex Passport OAuth token. |
